English: Mr. Esau said that another student who was running to the kitchen saw the fire at 2:30 a.m.

Swahili: Hakuna mwanafunzi yeyote aliyeumia kwenye mkasa huo wa moto wakati ambapo upelelezi/uchunguzi ulikuwa unaendelea/
English: No student was injured in the fire incident while the investigation was ongoing.

Swahili: Hali ya kaunti ya Kisumu: wauguzi waliokwenda kwenye maandamano
English: Situation in Kisumu county: nurses who went on strike

Swahili: Tena wale ambao hawajarudi kazini katika kaunti ya Kisumu wameambiwa wabebe mizigo yao pekee yao
English: And those who have not returned to work in Kisumu County have been told to carry their luggage alone.

Swahili: Kwa sababu hiyo ya eneo la Obunga kuendelea kwa njia inayofaa na vile vile inaweza kuisha kwa miezi michache inayokuja. Mheshimiwa Aloice Okunoamewasihi wauzaji kuwa watulivu kwa sababu bado wanajengewa
English: The project is expected to be completed in the next few months, and the market will continue to grow steadily.

Swahili: Ukulima: maendeleo ya barabara: mheshimiwa Aloice Ager amesema kuwa wizara ya barabara imetengeneza takriban kilomita mia tatu tisini na tano ya barabara ambayo ilikuwa imeharibika katika kaunti hiyo nzima, aliongezea kwa kusema kuwa wizara hiyo ya barabara
English: Agriculture: road development: Mr Aloice Ager said that the Ministry of Road has built about 395 kilometres of road which had been damaged throughout the county, adding that the Ministry of Road

Swahili: Wizara ya barabara imeshafanya kazi kwa bidii na kujenga barabara inayotoshea kilomita kumi inayopitia katika wadi zote ndani ya kaunti nzima ya Kisumu.
English: The Ministry of Road Transport has worked hard to build a 10-kilometer road through all the wards in Kisumu County.

Swahili: Chama cha ANC katika kauti ya Kisumu: Uongozi wa chama cha Amani National Congress (ANC) tawi la kaunti ya Kisumu umeanza kuweka mikakati ya kutengeneza kazi ya chama hicho
English: ANC in Kisumu: The leadership of the Peace National Congress (ANC) branch of Kisumu county has begun to develop strategies to reform the party's work.

Swahili: Alipokuwa akizungumza na vyombo vya habari katika mji wa Kisumu, mheshimiwa Shadrack Okindo aliwaambia tamaa yake ya kuenda kuwania kiti cha ugavana wa kaunti ya Kisumu akitumia tikiti ya ANC.
English: Speaking to the media in Kisumu, Mr. Shadrack Okindo told them of his desire to run for the governorship of Kisumu county using an ANC ticket.

Swahili: Aliwaeleza sababu zake za kuwaomba raia ili wamkubalie kuingia katika chama hicho cha ANC.
English: He explained his reasons for asking the citizens to accept him to join the ANC.

Swahili: Mwishowe alimsifia mwenyekiti wa chama cha ANC mheshimiwa Musalia Mudavadi kwa kuwa na ndoto nzuri ya kujenga nchi ya Kenya iwapo raia watampa nafasi ya kuwa rais wa nchi ya Kenya.
English: Finally, he praised the ANC chairman, Mr Musalia Mudavadi, for his dream of building a Kenyan country if the citizens give him the chance to become president of Kenya.

Swahili: Kamati ya chama cha Jubilee limemng'oa  mbunge wa eneo la Soy - Cleb Kositany kwenye cheo cha unaibu wa katibu mkuu wa chama hicho kutokana na vyeti viliyoandikwa.
English: The Jubilee Party Committee has removed Soy - Cleb Kositany, a local MP, from the shameful position of party secretary general due to written certificates.

Swahili: Katika chama hicho Ositany amekuwa mmoja wa  wanakamati ya usimamizi wa nchi katika chama chao.
English: In the party, Ositany has been one of the country's national executive committee members.

Swahili: Kati ya wabunge wa Tangatanga wanaomuunga mkono naibu wa rais, William Ruto ambaye sasa hajakuwa akikubaliana na rais Uhuru Kenyatta katika mambo ya siasa.
English: Among the Tangatanga lawmakers who support the vice president, William Ruto, who is now not in agreement with President Uhuru Kenyatta on political issues.

Swahili: Waziri wa Afya wa humu nchini Mutahi Kagwe alizuru eneo linalotumika kuhifadhi dawa katika mtaa wa Kitengela, kaunti ya Kajiado.
English: The local Minister of Health Mutahi Kagwe visited a drug storage facility in Kitengela Street, Kajiado county.

Swahili: Chanjo zinatarajiwa kuingia humu nchini usiku huu wa leo baada ya waziri wa afya kutoka kukagua mkondo utakaofuatwa katika kuhifadhi chanjo za Astra Zeneca.
English: Vaccines are expected to arrive in the country tonight after the health minister reviews the flow of Astra Zeneca vaccines.

Swahili: Alisema ya kuwa nchi zingine zimeshaweka mikakati yote itakayotumika kuhifadhi dawa hizo.
English: He said that some countries have set up all the strategies to store the drugs.

Swahili: Amewaunganisha wahudumu wa afya, maafisa wa usalama pamoja na walimu wa humu nchini.
English: He has brought together health workers, security officials and teachers in the country.

Swahili: Chanjo hizo zitawasili katika uwanja wa ndege wa JKIA kabla ya kusafirishwa nchini kote
English: The vaccines will arrive at JKIA airport before being shipped across the country

Swahili: Shirika la afya duniani (WHO) pamoja na wizara ya afya zitahifadhi chanjo hizo katika friji zenye ubaridi wa hali ya juu.
English: The World Health Organization (WHO) and the health ministry will store the vaccines in refrigerators with a high-cold temperature.

Swahili: Waziri Kagwe aliongeza kwa kusema kuwa chanjo hizo hazitawatosha raia wote humu nchini kwa hivyo wananchi waendelee kufuata sheria za kujikinga dhidi ya Uviko 19.
English: Minister Kagwe added that the vaccines will not be enough for all citizens here in the country so citizens should continue to follow the rules to protect themselves against Influenza 19.

Swahili: Kuna matumaini ya kuwa rais Uhuru Kenyatta ataungana na viongozi wengine pamoja na raia wa Taita.
English: There is hope that President Uhuru Kenyatta will join other leaders and citizens of Taita.

Swahili: Mwenyekiti wa chama cha ODM, Raila Odinga ameendelea kushawishi na kuhimiza raia kuhusu kiti cha urais katika uchaguzi wa 2022(elfu mbili ishirini na mbili)
English: The chairman of the ODM party, Raila Odinga has continued to persuade and encourage citizens about the presidential seat in the 2022 election (two thousand twenty-two)

Swahili: Wengi wa vijana waliozungumza kwenye mstari wa mbele katika kaunti ya Taita waliendelea kusifia ripoti ya BBI kwani walifurahishwa zaidi na hali ya juu ya demokrasia iliyo katika chama cha ODM
English: Many of the young speakers at the frontline in Taita County continued to praise the BBI report as they were more pleased with the high level of democracy in the ODM party.

Swahili: Walisema ya kuwa wanachama wa chama hicho ndio watakaoamua atakayepewa tiketi ya chama hicho katika uchaguzi mkuu wa mwaka elfu mbili na ishirini na mbili (2022)
English: They said that the party's members will decide who gets the party ticket in the general election of 2022.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa BBI alikwenda kortini akitaka korti iitupilie mbali kesi iliyopelekwa mahakamani na wakili Charles Kanjama akipinga mikakati iliyofuatwa na kamati hiyo.
English: The BBI's secretary general went to court to ask the court to dismiss a case brought by lawyer Charles Kanjama against the committee's strategy.

Swahili: Katika kuunga mkono mabadiliko katika sheria, wakili Paul Mwangi ameiomba mahakama kuitupilia mbali kesi hiyo ili zile zilizowasilishwa hapo awali ziweze kusikizwa na kuamuliwa.
English: In support of the law's changes, lawyer Paul Mwangi has asked the court to drop the case so that the previously submitted cases can be heard and decided.

Swahili: Seneta wa kaunti ya Baringo, Gedion Moi alipanga upya mkutano mwingine wa hadhara  ili kuendelea kuwahimiza wananchi wa kanti ya Baringo siku ya leo ili waiunge mkono BBI katika kura ya maoni humu nchini.
English: Baringo County Senator Gedion Moi has rescheduled another public meeting to continue urging Baringo's residents today to support BBI in the referendum in this country.

Swahili: Wamewahimiza wananchi kumuunga mkono Gedion Moi kama mojawapo wa viongozi wanaowasaidia raia wa Baringo.
English: They have urged the citizens to support Gedion Moi as one of the leaders who supports the Baringo people.

Swahili: ///Wakulima wa humu nchini kupitia kongamano la umoja wa wakulima wadogo wamewasilisha kesi kortini ili kupinga makubaliano yaliyokuwa kati ya Kenya na Uingereza kwa kuwa masuala ya biashara hayakutiliwa maanani.
English: ///Farmers in this country through a small farmers' union conference have filed a lawsuit against the agreement between Kenya and Britain because trade issues were not taken into account.

Swahili: Korti hiyo inatarajiwa kuanza kusikiliza kesi hiyo ambapo mawakili wanamhusisha sonko na makosa ya kuunga mkono maovu humu nchini pamoja na kutatiza hali ya amani.
English: The court is expected to begin hearing the case where lawyers are accusing him of greed and crimes of supporting the country's violence and disturbing the peace.

Swahili: Mahakama iliamua baada ya Mike Sonko kukosa kufika mbele ya mahakama hiyo kama ilivyokubaliwa na jaji wa Kiambu aliyemuachilia kwa dhamana ya shilingi laki tatu(300000)
English: The court ruled after Mike Sonko failed to appear before the court as agreed by the Kiambu judge who released him on bail of 300,000 shillings.

Swahili: Korti ilikashifu vikali kosa lingine la kupigwa kwa watu kwenye eneo la  Buruburu.
English: The court strongly condemned another offense of beatings in the Buruburu area.

Swahili: Baadaye, polisi walielekezwa kufanya utafiti katika afisi ya mkurugenzi wa mashtaka ya umma ya humu nchini.
English: Later, police were directed to investigate the country's public prosecutor's office.

Swahili: Mkurugenzi wa mashtaka ya umma(DPP), Noordin Hajji alisema kuwa ana ushahidi wa kutosha kuhusu kesi hiyo ya ubadhirifu wa milioni mia mbili thelathini na tatu (233) inayomkabili gavana wa Garissa mheshimiwa Ali Korane.
English: Public Prosecutor (DPP), Noordin Hajji, said he has sufficient evidence in the 233 million bribery case against Garissa governor Ali Korane.

Swahili: Mercy Gateru ambaye ni wakili katika kesi hiyo aliiambia korti ya Nairobi leo hii ya kuwa amepata ushahidi zaidi ya kumfungulia Korane mashtaka pamoja na wale alioshtakiwa nao.
English: Mercy Gateru, who is the lawyer in the case, told the Nairobi court today that she has found more evidence to prosecute the Quran along with her co-accused.

Swahili: Alimwambia jaji wa kesi hiyo Douglas Ogoti kuwa alipokuwa akifanya uchunguzi kwa washahidi waliohusika na kesi hiyo.
English: He told the judge Douglas Ogoti that he was investigating witnesses involved in the case.

Swahili: Walipata ushahidi zaidi ambao utawasaidia katika kuamua kesi hiyo.
English: They found further evidence that would help them in the case.

Swahili: Jaji Ogoti aliwapa mawakili hao nafasi ya wiki mbili ili kuwasilisha kwa pamoja ripoti ya kesi hiyo ya gavana Korane mwezi ujao wa nne( Aprili) kutokana na ushahidi mpya uliowasilishwa kortini leo hii.
English: Judge Ogoti gave the lawyers two weeks to submit a joint report on the governor's case next April (after new evidence was presented today in court).

Swahili: Gavana Korane alikamatwa mwezi wa tisa mwaka uliopita baada ya kuhusishwa na makosa ya uharifu wa pesa alizopewa na benki kuu ya dunia kuboresha hali ya mji wa Garissa.
English: Governor Korane was arrested in September last year after being implicated in corruption charges related to money given to him by the world's central bank to improve the situation in Garissa.

Swahili: Mwanaye mbunge wa Bahati ambaye ni Kimani Ngunjiri ameaga dunia kutokana na ugonjwa wa Uviko 19 kulingana na ripoti iliyotolewa na mbunge huyo.
English: His son, Kimani Ngunjiri, has died of the illness, according to a report by the MP.

Swahili: Kimani Ngunjiri amewaomba raia wa Kenya haswa kutoka katika eneo la Bahati kumweka kwenye  maombi haswa katika wakati huu mgumu.
English: Kimani Ngunjiri has asked Kenyans especially from the Bahati area to put him in prayer especially during this difficult time.

Swahili: Arthur amekuwa akipokea matibabu kutoka katika hospitali ya Aghakhan mjini Mombasa, amefariki akiwa na miaka thelathini na miwili.
English: Arthur, who has been receiving treatment at Aghakhan Hospital in Mombasa, died at the age of 32.

Swahili: Kutokana na kifo hicho, viongozi wengi humu nchini wakiongozwa na naibu wa rais William Ruto pamoja na wabunge wa humu nchini akiwemo Ndindi Nyoro wa Kiharu wametuma rambirambi zao kwa familia na marafiki wa mbunge huyo.
English: As a result of the death, many leaders in the country led by Vice President William Ruto and members of parliament including Ndindi Soft Kiharu have sent their condolences to the parliamentarian's family and friends.

Swahili: Arthur amewaacha watoto wawili pamoja na mkewe mmoja.
English: Arthur left behind two children and one wife.

Swahili: Kisumu - Waliokuwa wakifanya kazi katika kambi  ya Posta ya mawasiliano ya Kenya katika maeneo ya Nyanza sasa wameiomba tume inayosimamia mishahara ya waliostaafu kuingilia kati mambo ya kuchelewa kwa mshahara wao/ kiinuamgongo.
English: Kism - People who worked at the Kenyan Postal Communications Camp in Nyanza areas have now asked the pensioner pay commission to intervene in their late pay/back issues.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na mheshimiwa Maurice Obimbo aliyeachishwa kazi mwaka wa elfu moja mia tisa tisini na nne(1994) amesema kwamba wamekuwa wakituma ombi lao kupitia tume ya Posta inayojulikana kama Teleposta Pension Scheme ambayo imekuwa ikifanya kazi chini ya Retirement Benefits Authority(RBA)
English: Led by the retired Mr Maurice Obimbo in 1994 said that they have been sending their applications through the postal commission known as Teleposta Pension Scheme which has been operating under the Retirement Benefits Authority (RBA)

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Obimbo alipokuwa akiongea na wanahabari mjini Kisumu alieleza kuwa wameweka mikakati tosha ya hesabu zote za pesa ambazo wanafaa kuwalipa waliostaafu, huku akiiomba RBA kuwasaidia kupata pesa hizo.
English: Mr Obimbo, speaking to reporters in Kisumu, explained that they have set out a set of strategies for all the bills they should pay pensioners, while asking the RBA to help them get the money.

Swahili: Korti ya Ndhiwa, kaunti ya Homabay imekata maamuzi kuwa mwanamke wa miaka ishirini na tatu aliyemuua /aliyemkata shingo mwanawe wa mwaka mmoja kwasababu ya kukataa kunyonya afanyiwe uchunguzi wa kiakili.
English: The Ndhwa court, Homabay county has ruled that a 23-year-old woman who killed/cut her one-year-old son's neck because she refused to be breastfed should be subjected to a mental examination.

Swahili: Mwanamke huyo Night Akoth anahusihwa na makosa hayo aliyomfanyia mtoto wake wa tatu Brighton Ochieng.
English: Night Akoth is affected by the mistakes she made against her third son Brighton Ochieng.

Swahili: Aliyafanya makosa hayo siku ya Jumamosi na akafikishwa mbele ya mahakama kwa jaji Mary Ochieng wa korti ya Ndhiwa ambaye alitoa maelekezo ya kumpiwa akili.
English: He committed the offences on Saturday and was brought before the court by Judge Mary Ochieng of Ndhwa court who gave instructions for his reasonableness.

Swahili: Mratibu wa kuhakikisha chanjo zimewasili humu nchini Daktari Willis Akwale amesema kuwa dozi milioni 1.25 zitafika humu nchini hapo kesho.
English: Dr Willis Akwale, the country's vaccine control coordinator, said 1.25 million doses will arrive tomorrow.

Swahili: Hata hivyo Akwale amewaelezea wananchi kuwa hawatalazimishwa kuchukua chanjo hiyo ya kujikinga dhidi ya virusi vya Korona.
English: However, Akwale has explained to the citizens that they will not be forced to take the vaccine to protect themselves against the coronavirus.

Swahili: Kuzuru kwa Akwale katika maeneo hayo kumetokea wiki mbili baada ya naibu wa rais kukita kambi maeneo hayo.
English: Akwale's visit to the areas came two weeks after the vice president camped in the areas.

Swahili: Hivyo basi kulingana na mheshimiwa Raila Odinga alieleza kuwa BBI itahakikisha ugavi sawa wa rasilimali humu nchini.
English: So according to Mr. Raila Odinga, BBI will ensure the equitable supply of resources here in the country.

Swahili: Seneta wa Kisumu Fred Outa ameeleza kuwa chama cha ODM kinapanga kuandaa mkutano kama njia ya kuweka mikakati ya kura ya maoni.
English: Kisumu Senator Fred Outa has explained that the ODM party plans to hold a meeting as a way to set out the voting strategies.

Swahili: Akizungumza kule Ahero alipokutana na wanachama wa ODM kutoka kwenye wadi tano za Ahero zinazounda Nyando, mheshimiwa Outa alieleza kuwa kwa sasa wananchi wanafaa kuangazia macho yao.
English: Speaking at Ahero meeting with ODM members from the five Ahero wards that make up Nyando, Mr. Outa explained that for now citizens should be keeping their eyes open.

Swahili: Alisema ya kuwa atazunguka kauti ndogo zote saba za Kisumu ili kukutana na wanachama wa ODM wakipanga jinsi watakavyopiga kura kwenye kura ya maoni.
English: He said he would go around all seven small Kisumu constituencies to meet with ODM members planning how they would vote in the referendum.

Swahili: Outa alieleza kuwa baada ya mkutano waliokuwa nao Nyando sasa wanapanga kuelekea Seme huku akisema kuwa nia yao ni kuhakikisha kuwa wananchi watapiga kura kwa utaratibu (bila tashwishi) ya kuunga mkono BBI.
English: Outa explained that after the meeting they had with Nyando they are now planning to go to Seme while saying that their intention is to ensure that citizens vote in a systematic (without a doubt) way to support BBI.

Swahili: Naibu wa rais William Ruto amesema kuwa ataendelea kuzuru maeneo tofauti humu nchini.
English: Vice President William Ruto has said he will continue to visit different parts of the country.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Ruto alirejelea tamko lake la hapo awali kwa kusema kwamba yeye pia alichaguliwa na jina lake lilikuwa kwenye debe vile vile  kama Rais Uhuru Kenyatta.
English: Mr. Ruto referred to his earlier statement by saying that he was also elected and his name was on the board as well as President Uhuru Kenyatta.

Swahili: Akizungumza Murang'a, mheshimiwa Ruto amewakashifu wale ambao hawafurahishwi na mkondo wa mienendo yake wa siasa.
English: Speaking at Murang'a, Mr. Ruto has criticized those who are not happy with the current political dynamics.

Swahili: Ruto ameeleza kuwa nia yake kuu ni kuona kuwa maisha ya wakaazi wa Murang'a yanaweza kubadilika.
English: Ruto has explained that her main goal is to see that the lives of the residents of Murang'a can change.

Swahili: Aliendelea kwa kusema kuwa serikali itakayoundwa baada ya uchaguzi mkuu wa 2022 itakuwa ya wananchi wote humu nchini haswa wale wenye mapato mya chini.
English: He went on to say that the government that will be formed after the 2022 general election will be for all citizens here in the country especially those with low incomes.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa serikali imeshapiga hatua kwenye maendeleo ya hapa na pale yakiwemo elimu, kuunganisha umeme (stima) pamoja na kuwapa wananchi kazi katika kaunti hiyo ya Murang'a.
English: He said that the government has taken steps to develop local development including education, electricity connectivity and employment in the Murang'a district.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika hafla hiyo ya maombi katika kanisa fulani katika eneo bunge la Gatanga, Ruto aliendelea kuwashukuru wakaazi wa eneo hilo.
English: Speaking at the prayer event in a church in the Gatanga parliamentary area, Ruto continued to thank the local residents.

Swahili: Wataelekea kwenye kura za maoni huku wakipanga jinsi watakavyopiga kura hiyo.
English: They will go to the polls while planning how they will vote.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Stephen Odhiambo Yogo amechaguliwa tena kama katibu wa KUPPET katika kaunti ya Homabay
English: Mr. Stephen Odhiambo Yogo has been re-elected as the Secretary of KUPPET in Homabay County

Swahili: Akizungumza na kituo cha habari cha Dala fmbaada ya kuchaguliwa  amesema kuwa atatimiza malengo aliyowapa wanachama wenzake wa eneo la Homabay.
English: Speaking to the Dala news channel after the election, he said he would achieve the goals he had set for his fellow members of the Homabay region.

Swahili: Amewahimiza wenzake kufanya kazi kwa pamoja wakati wa kampeni na uchaguzi.
English: He has encouraged his colleagues to work together during campaigns and elections.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Yogo amewasifu walimu waliofika kwenye uchaguzi uliofanywa katika uwanja wa Rachuonyo - Kendubay.
English: Mr. Yogo has praised the teachers who came to the polling station in Rachuonyo - Kendubay.

Swahili: Kwingineko, mheshimiwa Yogo ameeleza kuwa mipango iko tayari kuhakikisha kuwa mitihani ya darasa la nane na kidato cha nne inafanywa bila hitilafu yoyote.
English: Elsewhere, Mr. Yogo has explained that plans are ready to ensure that the eighth and fourth grade exams are conducted without any errors.

Swahili: Kambi ya Assure Commercial Services Limited ilipewa kandarasi ya shilingi milioni mia tatu arubaini na saba (347) ya kusambaza barakoa humu nchini
English: Camp Assure Commercial Services Limited was awarded a contract of 347 million shillings for the distribution of snacks in the country.

Swahili: Kambi hiyo ilipata kandarasi hiyo licha ya kuwa ilikuwa ikijihusisha na utengenezaji wa vifaa vya samani kama vile viti.
English: The camp was awarded the contract, although it was involved in the manufacture of furniture such as chairs.

Swahili: Hali ya usalama umedumishwa kaskazini mwa magharibi ya eneo la Zamfara nchini Nigeria .
English: Security has been maintained in the northwest of the Zamfara region of Nigeria.

Swahili: Inasemekana ya kuwa wanafunzi mia mbili sabini na tisa waliachiliwa huru baada ya wengine kuachiliwa huru juma lililopita.
English: Two hundred and seventy-nine students were reportedly released after others were released last week.

Swahili: Idadi yote ya wanafunzi walioachiliwa huru kufikia sasa ni mia tatu kumi na saba.
English: The total number of students released so far is three hundred and seventeen.

Swahili: Haijulikani kama wahalifu hao walilipwa pesa ili wawaachilie huru wanafunzi hao.
English: It is not known whether the criminals were paid money to release the students.

Swahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta aliongoza hafla ya mazishi ya mbunge wa Juja mwenda zake Francis Waititu .
English: President Uhuru Kenyatta presided over the funeral of fellow Juja MP Francis Waititu.

Swahili: Rais alihudhuria hafla hiyo pamoja na viongozi anuwai tajika.
English: The President attended the event along with various wealthy leaders.

Swahili: Mbunge huyo aliaga dunia kutoka na ugonjwa wa saratani ya akili.
English: The lawmaker had saved the world from brain cancer.

Swahili: Viongozi waliochaguliwa kuongoza umoja wa walimu wa KUPPET ya kauti ya Homabay wamehimizwa kutimiza yale malengo waliyowapa walimu
English: Leaders elected to lead the KUPPET teachers' union of Homabay's guitar have been encouraged to achieve the goals they set for teachers

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa KUPPET wa humu nchini Akello Misori amewasihi maafisa wa KUPPET kujenga jumba litakalobeba afisi za walimu.
English: AKELLO MISORI, the head of KUPPET, has urged KUPPET officials to build a building to house teachers' offices.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Misori aliripoti nia ya serikali kuweka makubaliano na walimu.
English: Mr. Misori reported the government's intention to make agreements with teachers.

Swahili: Naibu wa katibu mkuu wa KUPPET - Homabay,Peter Omollo Makasewe amesema kuwa ahadi walizopewa walimu zitatimizwa.
English: KUPPET - Homabay Deputy Secretary General Peter Omollo Makasewe has said that the promises made to teachers will be fulfilled.

Swahili: Migogoro imekuwa katika msitu wa Wire licha ya msitu huo kuleta manufaa kwa wakaazi wa eneo hilo haswa wa Kaunti ndogo ya Rachuonyo.
English: The conflict has been in the Wire Forest despite the forest bringing benefits to the local inhabitants especially the small Rachuonyo County.

Swahili: Naibu wa rais wa Zimbabwe mheshimiwa Kembo amejiuzulu.
English: Zimbabwe's vice president, Mr. Kembo, has resigned.

Swahili: Kembo amejiuzulu wiki moja baada ya kuhusishwa na tuhuma za kimapenzi.
English: Kembo resigned a week after being implicated in a sexual allegation.

Swahili: Hili lilitokea baada ya gazeti la taifa la Zimbabwe kuandika jinsi ambavyo amekuwa akijihusisha na wanawake haswa wanaofanya kazi katika afisi yake.
English: This came after a Zimbabwean national newspaper wrote how she has been involved with women, especially those working in her office.

Swahili: Utawala wa chuo kikuu cha Nairobi ulitangaza mabadiliko ya kazi yao ikiwemo kupunguza matawi mengine ya chuo hicho kutoka idadi ya thelathini na tano hadi jumla ya kumi na moja na kadhalika
English: The administration of the University of Nairobi announced changes to their work including reducing the number of other branches of the university from 35 to a total of 11 and so on.

Swahili: Watu wawili wamepoteza maisha yao katika ajali ya barabara.
English: Two people have lost their lives in a road accident.

Swahili: Ajali hiyo ilihusisha matatu na pikipiki kwenye barabara ya Katito- Kendubay katika eneo la Nyamarimba jana jioni.
English: The accident involved a three-car and a motorcycle on the Katito-Kendubay road in the Nyamarimba area last evening.

Swahili: Gari hilo lilikuwa likijaribu kulipita gari lingine kabla ya kumgonga mtu mmoja kando ya barabara oamoja na gari lililosimamishwa kando ya barabara hiyo.
English: The car was trying to pass another car before hitting a man on the side of a road with a car parked on the side of the road.

Swahili: Mtu mmoja aliyefariki katika ajali hiyo alipelekwa/alifikishwa katika chumba cha kuhifadhia maiti.
English: One person who died in the accident was taken to a mortuary.

Swahili: Idadi ya watu nane waliojeruhiwa walipelekwa katika hospitali ya kaunti ndogo ya Nyakach na baadaye wakaachiliwa kurudi nyumbani.
English: A total of eight wounded were taken to a hospital in Nyakach's small county and later released home.

Swahili: Mtu/ Kijana mmoja wa miaka ishirini na mitatu alijitia kitanzi ndani ya nyumba ya rafiki yake katika kata ndogo ya Ombeyi, kaunti ya Kisumu.
English: A man/Twenty-three-year-old man locked himself in a friend's house in the small town of Ombeyi, Kisumu county.

Swahili: Ripoti iliyotolewa na polisi inasema kuwa Joseph Odhiambo Ouma alijitia kitanzi ndani ya nyumba ya Benard Otieno Ogolo.
English: A police report says that Joseph Odhiambo Ouma locked himself in the house of Benard Otieno Ogolo.

Swahili: Mama ya kijana aliyejitia kitanzi alisema kuwa mwanaye alitaka kuuza shamba lao ili atafute leseni ya udereva ila nduguye alimkataza.
English: The mother of the young man who had taken a loop said that her son wanted to sell their farm to get a driver's license but his brother refused.

Swahili: Alisema kuwa walikuwa na mkutano wa kifamilia kuhusu jambo hilo hata hivyo shughuli hiyo iligonga mwamba.
English: He said that they had a family meeting on the subject but the activity hit a rock.

Swahili: Alipokuwa akisema hayo, naibu wa chifu wa kata ndogo ya Obumba, mheshimiwa Amos alisema kuwa kijana huyo alijitia kitanzi ghafla baada ya kukatazwa kuuza shamba.
English: In this speech, the deputy chief of Obumba's subdivision, Mr. Amos, said that the young man had suddenly become trapped after being denied the land.

Swahili: Baadaye alienda kwa nyumba ya jirani yao ambayo amekua akilinda na kujitia kitanzi huku akitumia kamba ya kumfungia ng'ombe.
English: Later, she went to the home of her neighbor who had grown up guarding and locking herself with a rope to tie her cattle.

Swahili: Polisi na maafisa wa eneo la Ombeyi waliuchukua mwili wake na kuupeleka katika chumba cha kuhifadhia maiti kule Ahero.
English: Police and Ombeyi area officials took her body and transported it to the mortuary in Ahero.

Swahili: Kupitia kwa wizara ya usalama ambayo imedharauliwa zaidi kutokana na tamko la Fred Matiang'i la kuwatuma maafisa wa polisi katika vijiji vya huko ili wasaidie katika kudumisha hali ya usalama ambayo imeendelea kudorora zaidi kupindukia.
English: Through the security ministry, which has been undermined by Fred Matiang'i's announcement to send police officers to the villages to help maintain the security situation that has continued to escalate.

Swahili: Nanok akiongea na wanahabari asubuhi ya leo katika afisi yake iliyo katika kaunti ya Turkana  alisema kwamba idadi ya shule nne kufikia sasa zimefungwa katika kaunti hiyo kutokana na amri/ mwelekeo iliyotolewa na wizara ya elimu baada ya vijiji ishirini na mbili kuchomwa katika maeneo hayo.
English: Speaking to reporters this morning at his headquarters in Turkana county, Nanok said that a total of four schools have so far been closed in the county due to the order/direction issued by the education ministry after twenty-two villages were burned in the areas.

Swahili: Alisema kuwa George Natembeya ambaye ni afisa wa mkoa wa  Bonde la Ufa anafaa kustaafu kwani ameshindwa kuweka mikakati faafu ya usalama kutokana na kuwa uvamizi uanendelea kupita kiasi kule Kapedo.
English: He said that George Natembeya, an official in the Ufa Valley region, should retire as he has failed to implement effective security strategies due to the excessive encroachment on the Kapedo.

Swahili: Nnanok alisema kuwa vita hivyo vinahusiana na ung'ang'aniaji wa mipaka kati ya jamii za Turkana na Pokot, vile vile alisema kuwa hawatakubali jambo hilo.
English: Nnanok said the war was related to the border breach between the Turkana and Pokot communities, as well as that they would not accept this.

Swahili: Mhubiri mmoja kutoka eneo la Ndia kaunti ya Kirinyaga amekamatwa kwa tuhuma za kumnajisi wanawe wawili mmoja wao akiwa wa miaka kumi na minne, hukumu zitatolewa moja baada ya nyingine.
English: A preacher from Ndia, Kirinyaga county, has been arrested on suspicion of raping his two sons when they were fourteen, and sentences will be handed down one after another.

Swahili: Mhubiri John Gichira wa miaka hamsini na moja alikiri/alikubali mashtaka hayo juzi akiwa kortini kwa kusema kuwa ni nguvu za shetani ndizo zilizomsukuma kujamiana na wanawe aliowazaa.
English: The 51-year-old preacher John Gichira admitted/accepted the charges yesterday in court saying that it was the devil's powers that drove him to be like his sons.

Swahili: Gichira alikamatwa kule Mbeere Kusini katika kaunti ya Meru alikokuwa amejificha baada ya kusikia fununu kuwa anatafutwa.
English: Gichira was arrested in Mbeere South in Meru County where he had been hiding after hearing rumors that he was wanted.

Swahili: Wasichana hao wawili walikuwa wajawazito ambapo mwanawe mkubwa alijifungua huku yule mdogo wa miaka ishirini na minne akiwa bado na ujauzito wa miezi saba.
English: The two girls were pregnant when her eldest son gave birth while the youngest, aged twenty-four, was still seven months pregnant.

Swahili: Aliyekuwa mbunge wa Laikipia Mutahi Kimaru amefikishwa katika mahakama ya Nairobi leo hii kwa tuhuma za wizi wa hati miliki ya ardhi yenye thamani ya shilingi milioni kumi na nane nukta tano (18.5)
English: Former MP from Laikipia Mutahi Kimaru has been brought before a Nairobi court today on suspicion of theft of a land patent worth 18 million shillings (18.5 million points)

Swahili: Ardhi hiyo iliyo mjini Nanyuki inasemekana kuwa ni ya George Odinga na David Mortons Silverstain.
English: The land in Nanyuki is said to be owned by George Odinga and David Mortons Silverstain.

Swahili: Mawakili wa kesi hiyo waliiambia mahakama kuwa Kimaru alifanya makosa hayo kwa kupitia wizara ya ardhi katika mwaka wa elfu mbili kumi na sita jijini Nairobi.
English: The lawyers in the case told the court that Kimaru had committed the crime through the land ministry in Nairobi in the year two thousand sixteen.

Swahili: Zaidi ya hayo, alifunguliwa shtaka lingine la kupanga mbinu ya kuuza sehemu ya ardhi hiyo kwa naibu wa msajili wa mahakama ya juu ya Nanyuki Martha Mutuku huku akimshawishi kuwa hiyo ilikuwa ni ardhi yake.
English: In addition, he was charged with conspiring to sell the land to the deputy clerk of the Nanyuki High Court, Martha Mutuku, while persuading her that it was her land.

Swahili: Aliachiliwa kwa dhamana ya shilingi milioni moja au pesa taslimu ya dhamana ya laki tatu , kesi hiyo itaendelea tarehe ishirini na nane wa mwezi huu.
English: He was released on bail of one million shillings or three lakh in cash, the trial will continue on the 28th of this month.

Swahili: Tume ya shughuli za usafiri (NTSA) imeshauriwa kuanza mikakati ya kipekee ya kuwaelimisha  watumizi wa barabara jinsi ya kutumia na kulinda sheria za barabara.
English: The Transportation Safety and Safety Commission (NTSA) has been advised to launch special strategies to educate road users on how to use and protect road traffic laws.

Swahili: Baadhi ya wafanyikazi katika sekta hiyo ya matatu wamesema kuwa hiyo ndiyombinu itakayosaidia kupunguza ajali za barabarani zilizotokea katika mwaka uliopita wa 2020.
English: Some workers in the third sector have said that this is a strategy that will help reduce road accidents that occurred in the past year of 2020.

Swahili: Katika mazungumzo hayo ya kipekee na wanahabari jijini Nairobi, walisema kuwa tume hiyo imekuwa ikipokea fedha kila mwaka kutoka kwa serikali na hivyo basi wanafaa kuzitumia pesa hizo katika kutoa mafunzo hayo.
English: In this special interview with journalists in Nairobi, they said that the commission has been receiving funding from the government every year and therefore they should spend the money on the training.

Swahili: Wenye magari wametishia kuanda mgomo baada ya wiki moja.
English: The owners of the vehicles threatened to strike in a week.

Swahili: Mvutano umezidi baina ya gavana wa Machakos Dr. Alfred Mutua na mbunge wa Kangundo Fabian Mule kuhusiana na masuala ya maendeleo katika kaunti hiyo.
English: Tensions have escalated between Machakos governor Dr. Alfred Mutua and Kangundo MP Fabian Mule over development issues in the county.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo bunge lake la Kangundo alisema kuwa gavana Alfred Mutua hajakuwa akifanya maendeleo katika eneo bunge hilo .
English: Speaking in his Kangundo parliamentary area, he said that governor Alfred Mutua was not making progress in the parliamentary area.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa miradi nyingi za maendeleo zinazoonekana hapo ni zile zilizofanywa na serikali kwa kupitia fedha za maendeleo za kata (CDF)
English: He said that many of the development projects seen there are those carried out by the government through the county development fund (CDF).

Swahili: Wenye magari wamesema kuwa uzembe wa NTSA sio sawa bali itawaletea hasara tupu.
English: Owners have said that NTSA's negligence is not good but will cause them no loss.

Swahili: Baadhi ya wawaniaji wa kiti cha ubunge cha Kabondo Kasipul kwenye uchaguzi wa elfu mbili ishirini na mbili hawajafurahishwa na tabia ya viongozi wa dini ya kujihusisha na siasa  katika maeneo hayo.
English: Some of the candidates for the Kabondo Kasipul parliamentary seat in the 222 elections are not happy with the religious leaders' political attitude in these areas.

Swahili: Idadi ya watu elfu thelathini na nane wameripotiwa kufariki Marekani katiki kipindi cha wiki mbili za kwanza za mwezi wa Novemba kutokana na virusi vya Korona.
English: Thirty-eight thousand people have been reported to have died in the United States during the first two weeks of November from the coronavirus.

Swahili: Taasisi utafiti wa matibabu ya magonjwa nchini Marekani (CDC) wameripoti kuwa idadi hiyo huenda ikaongezeka hadi watu elfu tisini kwa majuma mawili yajayo.
English: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) reports that the number may rise to 90,000 in the next two weeks.

Swahili: Idadi hiyo hata hivyo imeingiza uwoga mwingi kote nchini kwa wananchi wa huko.
English: The number has nevertheless caused a lot of alarm across the country for local residents.

Swahili: Hata hivyo Taasisi ya utafiti wa matibabu ya magonjwa (CDC) imesema kuwa hayo ndiyo yaliyotabiriwa na wataalam wa afya katika kipindi kifupi kilichopita.
English: However, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has said that this is exactly what health experts have predicted in the recent past.

Swahili: Ugonjwa huo wa Korona sasa umeendelea kuenea nchini humo baada ya watu milioni kumi nukta mbili kupewa chanjo hiyo.
English: The coronavirus has now spread to the country after two vaccines were given to ten million people.

Swahili: Kagwe amewahimiza wazazi kuwakinga watoto wao dhidi ya ugonjwa wa Corona kulingana na zile kesi zilizoripotiwa.
English: Kagwe has urged parents to protect their children from the coronavirus according to the reported cases.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa hiyo ndiyo mbinu mbekee itakayowasaidia katika kupunguza uenezaji wa ugonjwa huo wa Uviko 19 miongoni mwa wanafunzi waliorudi shuleni juma lililopita.
English: He said that this is the only way to help them reduce the spread of the Influenza 19 disease among students who returned to school last week.

Swahili: Hata hivyo, Kagwe amewahimiza raia wa Kenya kuendelea kufuata zile sheria za kudhibiti uenezaji wa Korona.
English: However, Kagwe has urged Kenyans to continue to follow the rules to control the spread of the Corona virus.

Swahili: /// Kinara wa chama cha siasa cha ODM Raila Odinga katika kuhusisha vikundi vya viongozi wa vyama anuwai katika kaunti ya Nairobi ameandaa hafla ya kukutana na kundi la umoja wa vijana wa kaunti hiyo ambapo watakuwa wakijadili kwa kina kuhusu vipengele vya ripoti ya BBI.
English: /// The head of the political party ODM Raila Odinga in involving groups of multi-party leaders in Nairobi district has organised an event to meet with the youth unity group of the district where they will be discussing in detail the aspects of the BBI report.

Swahili: Raila alisema kuwa mkutano huo ulipangwa na kuitishwa kwa nia ya kuwapa vijana nafasi ya kutoa maoni yao mambo yanayowatatiza bila ya kuangalia chama cha siasa wanachochohusiana nacho.
English: Raila said the meeting was organized and convened with the intention of giving young people the opportunity to express their concerns regardless of which political party they belong to.

Swahili: Alitumia nafasi hiyo kuongea na kundi la viongozi ambao wamekuwa wakikashifu na kuikataa BBI huku akieleza kuwa BBI ndiyo njia pekee itakayosaidia katika kukabili shida ambazo waKenya wamekuwa wakipitia kwa kuwajumuisha vijana.
English: He used the opportunity to speak to a group of leaders who have been critical and rejecting BBI, explaining that BBI is the only way to help deal with the problems that Kenyans have been going through by including young people.

Swahili: Aliongeza pamoja na lengo lake la kuwapeleka wakenya katika kupiga kura ya maoni.
English: He added that he was also aiming to send Kenyans to vote.

Swahili: Chama cha Jubilee hakitakuwa na wawaniaji wa viti vya bunge vya Kabuchai, Matungu na kiti cha seneti cha Machakos katika uchaguzi mdogo uliopangwa.
English: The Jubilee Party will not have candidates for the Kabuchai parliamentary seats, Matungu and Machakos senate seats in the planned by-election.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa chama cha Jubilee, Raphael Tuju  amesema kuwa hatua hiyo imetokana na sababu za kazi za hapo awali ambazo wamekuwa wakifanya pamoja na vyama vya mrengo wa NASA vikiwemo ODM, WIPER, ANC na FORD KENYA.
English: The Jubilee Party's Secretary General, Raphael Tuju, said the move was based on previous work they have been doing with NASA's project groups including ODM, WIPER, ANC and FORD KENYA.

Swahili: Hata hivyo Tuju amesema kuwa chama hicho kinangoja sheria zitakazotolewa na mahakama  kuhusiana na shughuli za uchaguzi
English: However, Tuju said that the party is waiting for the court to issue laws regarding election activities.

Swahili: Tuju amesisitiza kuwa kuwa chama hicho kitaendelea kuwaunga mkono wawaniaji kwenye viti vya diwani vya wadi za London iliyo katika kaunti ya Nakuru pamoja na Huruma katika kaunti ya Nairobi.
English: Tuju has insisted that the party will continue to support the protesters in the London ward seats in Nakuru and Huruma in Nairobi.

Swahili: Tuju aliandamana pamoja na viongozi anuwai wa chama cha Jubilee katika mahojiano na wanahabari, hata hivyo hawakuweka wazi iwapo chama hicho kitamchukulia hatua kiongozi wa wengi katika bunge la seneti Irungu Kang'ata kulingana na matamshi yake mengine aliyoyatoa kuhusu ripoti ya BBI.
English: Tuju accompanied various leaders of the Jubilee party in interviews with journalists, but they were not clear whether the party would take action against Senate majority leader Irungu Kang'ata based on his other statements about the BBI report.

Swahili: Fatuma Dulo ni naibu wa kiongozi wa wengi katika bunge la seneti.
English: Fatuma Dulo is the deputy majority leader in the senate.

Swahili: Chama cha siasa cha Wiper kimemteua Agnes Kavindu Muthama mke wa aliyekuwa seneta wa kitambo Johnstohn Muthama kuenda kuwania kiti cha useneta siku ya tarehe kumi na nane mwezi wa tatu mwaka huu katika kaunti ya Machakos.
English: The Wiper Party has nominated Agnes Kavindu Muthama, the wife of former senator Johnstohn Muthama, to run for a Senate seat on March 18 in Machakos county.

Swahili: Uteuzi wa Kavindu ulifanyika leo hii na kinara wa chama hicho cha Wiper mheshimiwa Kalonzo Musyoka alipokuwa akizungumza na wanahabari leo mchana.
English: Kavindu's appointment was made today by the head of the Wiper party, Mr. Kalonzo Musyoka, while speaking to reporters this afternoon.

Swahili: Kavindu alikuwa mmoja wa wanakamati waliokuwa wakishughulikia ripoti ya BBI alipokuwa akipiga kampeni za kuwa mwakilishi wa kina mama katika kaunti hiyo mya Machakos, hata hivyo alishindwa na Joyce Kamnene wa chama cha Wiper.
English: Kavindu was one of the committee members handling the BBI report when he campaigned for the Machakos district's motherhood representative, but was defeated by Joyce Kamnene of the Wiper party.

Swahili: Alisema ya kuwa Bi. Kananu ni mwanasiasa bomba aliye na ndoto nzuri ya kuwaunganisha wawakilishi wa wanawake pamoja na vijana.
English: She said that Ms. Kananu is a pipe politician with a dream of bringing women's representatives together with young people.

Swahili: Kavindu atakuwa anashindana na wawaniaji ambao ni Mutua Katuku wa chama cha Maendeleo ChapChap na Benard wa chama cha UDA.
English: Kavindu will be competing against the rapists Mutua Katuku of the Progress party ChapChap and Benard of the UDA.

Swahili: Chama cha Third Way Alliancekimepeleka malalamishi yao mahakamani mjini Nairobi huku wakiitaka mahakama kuweka sheria zitakazowazuia madiwani katika kaunti ya Nairobi kumsitisha Anne Kananu katika kuchaguliwa kwenye cheo cha kuwa naibu wa gavana wa kaunti ya Nairobi.
English: The Third Way Alliance has filed a complaint in Nairobi, demanding that the court enact laws preventing the governors of Nairobi from preventing Anne Kananu from being elected as deputy governor of Nairobi.

Swahili: Naibu wa kinara wa chama hicho Angela Mwikali anaitaka mahakama kuitoa sheria hiyo huku akidai kuwa kumsitisha Kananu  inakwenda kinyume na sheria.
English: Deputy leader of the party, Angela Mwikali, is demanding the court pass the law, claiming that the suspension of Kananu is illegal.

Swahili: Mwikali alisema kuwa chama hicho kisiwakataze wakaazi wa Nairobi kuenda kujihusisha na uchaguzi mwingine ili wapate kiongozi wanayemtaka ikiwa tu watamchagua Kananu katika cheo hicho cha kuwa naibu wa kaunti hiyo ambaye anaweza kuwa gavana katika siku za usoni.
English: Mwikali said that the party should not prevent Nairobi residents from participating in another election to get the leader they want if they only choose Kananu from the position of deputy governor of the county who could be governor in the future.

Swahili: Chama hicho kimesema kuwa walipokuwa wakimng'atua sonko uongozini hakuwa na naibu  wake ndiyo maana nafasi za vyeo hivyo viwili vilitangazwa.
English: The party said that while they were pushing for his leadership, he did not have his deputy, which is why the positions of the two positions were announced.

Swahili: Imetokea juwa bado magavana wanasisitiza kuwa hawana pesa za kuwalipa wafanyikazi wa sekta ya matibabu ambao mpaka sasa wapo katika shughuli za maandamano ambayo imeingia siku ya thelathini na saba.
English: It happened yesterday that the governors still insist that they have no money to pay the medical workers who are still in the demonstration activities that have entered the 37th day.

Swahili: Oparanya amesema kuwa hawatakubali makubaliano yoyote yaliyowekwa baina ya serikali kuu na wahudumu wa afya kuhusu mambo ya mishahara, ameeleza kuwa hakuna jinsi ambavyo serikali kuu inaweza kufika katika makubaliano ilhali  kaunti zote humu nchini hazijaongezwa kiasi fulani cha fedha.
English: Oparanya has said that they will not accept any agreements between the central government and health officials on salaries, he has explained that there is no way the central government can reach an agreement if all the counties in the country have not been added to some amount of money.

Swahili: Oparanya ambaye ni gavana wa kaunti ya Kakamega ameendelea kuwakanya wahudumu hao wa afya ambao bado wako kwenye mgomo huku akisisistiza kuwa watachukuliwa hatua kali.
English: Kakamega county governor Oparanya has continued to protest against the health workers who are still on strike, insisting that strict measures will be taken.

Swahili: Mwanafunzi mwingine amekamatwa katika kaunti ya Nyamira baada ya kupatwa akimpiga naibu wa mwalimu mkuu wa shule yao.
English: Another student has been arrested in Nyamira county after being caught beating the school principal's deputy.

Swahili: Mwanafunzi huyo anayesoma katika shule ya Upili ya Kweroro iliyo kwenye maeneo ya Kitutu Msaba alijaribu kumkata mkono naibu wa mwalimu mkuu wa shule hiyo kwa kutumia silaha ya panga aliyoficha ndani ya nguo yake baada ya kuipenyeza shuleni.
English: The student at Kweroro High School in Kitutu Msaba tried to cut off the hand of the school's principal's deputy by using a sword he had hidden in his suit after penetrating the school.

Swahili: Kamishna wa kaunti ya Nyamira, Amos Mariba amedhibitisha ukweli wa mambo hayo akisema kuwa mshukiwa huyo alirudi tena na kuwadunga walimu wawili pamoja na wafanyikazi wa shule hiyo.
English: Nyamira County Commissioner Amos Mariba has confirmed the facts by saying that the suspect returned and stabbed two teachers and school staff.

Swahili: Mwanafunzi aliyewadunga kisu walimu wawili wa shule hiyo alifikishwa mahakamani leo.
English: A student who stabbed two teachers at the school was brought to trial today.

Swahili: Hata hivyo, mshukiwa huyo aliachiliwa kwa dhamana ya shilingi laki moja (100000) baada ya kukataa mashtaka aliyofunguliwa.
English: However, the suspect was released on a 100,000-square-dollar bail after denying the charges.

Swahili: Alishindwa kulipa pesa hizo na kisha mahakama ikaamua afungiwe katika jela ya watoto ya Manga - kaunti ya Nyamira hadi itakapofika tarehe kumi na saba atakaporudishwa mahakamani.
English: He failed to pay the fine and the court decided to put him in the Manga Children's Prison - Nyamira County - until the seventeenth day when he was brought back to trial.

Swahili: Washukiwa wanaofika idadi ya mia moja kumi na watatu walikamatwa kuanzia mwezi wa kumi mwaka uliopita.
English: A total of one hundred and thirteen suspects have been arrested since October last year.

Swahili: Odero aliongea kuhusu miogoro kati ya viongozi wa wizara ya uvuvi na kiongozi wa BMU katika Ziwa Viktoria katika kaunti ya Kisumu, Siaya na Homabay.
English: Odero spoke about the clashes between the heads of the fisheries ministry and the head of the BMU in Lake Victoria in Kisumu, Siaya and Homabay counties.

Swahili: Akiongea na Dala fm neti zilipokuwa zikichomwa, alisema kuwa washukiwa hao watafikishwa kwenye mahakama mbali mbali na pia wamepanga kuwapiga faini ya pesa nyingi mno.
English: Speaking to Dalafm while the networks were being lit, he said that the suspects would be taken to different courts and that they also plan to fine them a lot of money.

Swahili: Alitoa onyo kali kwa wenyeji wa mashua pamoja na wavuvi wote ili wafuate sheria za uvuvi za ziwa hilo huku akisema kuwa watazidi kutilia maanani zaidi sheria hizo za ziwani ili waweze kuwaondoa wajosaji?wahalifu humo.
English: He warned the boat owners and all fishermen to follow the lake's fishing laws while saying that they would pay more attention to the lake's laws so that they could remove offenders from the lake.

Swahili: Mwenyekiti wa BMU ya Kisumu - John Ouya ameisifu kazi nzuri iliyofanywa na Kenya Coast Guard ya kurejesha utulivu katika ziwa la Viktoria katika kaunti ya Kisumu.
English: BMU Kisumu Chairman John Ouya has praised the excellent work done by the Kenya Coast Guard to restore calm in Lake Victoria in Kisumu county.

Swahili: Uganda - Mwenyekiti wa Tume ya Uchaguzi- Justice Simon Mugenyi amesema kuwa watatangaza matokeo ya uchaguzi kadri zitakapokuwa zikifika kwenye meza ya tume hiyo huku akiahidi kuwa matokeo hayo yatakuwa ya kweli.
English: Uganda - Chairman of the Election Commission- Justice Simon Mugenyi has said that they will announce the election results as soon as they reach the commission's table, promising that the results will be true.

Swahili: Kwa upande wake Samia Suluhu amewaahidi wananchi wa Tanzania na mataifa mengine ya Afrika kuwa yu tayari kuingoza Tanzania kwa njia inayofaa akieleza kuwa kifo cha Magufuli kimeacha pengo kubwa ambalo haliwezi kuzibika.
English: For her part, Samia Suluhu has promised the citizens of Tanzania and other African nations that she is ready to replace Tanzania in a suitable way, explaining that Magufuli's death has left a huge gap that cannot be filled.

Swahili: Mahakama ya Nairobi imesema kuwa kesi inayomhusu aliyekuwa gavana wa Nairobi Mike Sonko inafaa kuendelea kama ilivyoratibiwa.

Swahili: Wakili Ouko hata hivyo anasema licha ya kuwa Sonko anahudumiwa na maafisa wa afya kutokana na ugonjwa unaomkabili hilo haliwezi kumzuia kufika mahakamani.

Swahili: Mahakama imemwambia wakili Oloo kufika mahakamani tarehe tatu Mei mwaka huu.

Swahili: Hii inaendelea wakati ambapo wakati huo huo mahakama inaendelea na kesi ya washukiwa wengine kumi na nne
English: This continues while the court is continuing the trial of fourteen other suspects

Swahili: Hii ni kwa sababu vitanda vya kuwalaza wagonjwa walio katika hali ya mahututi vimejaa vyote
English: This is because the beds for the terminally ill are full.

Swahili: Hospitali hiyo inasema kuwa wagonjwa wapelekwe katika hospitali nyingine kwa kuwa Kenyatta imejaa

English: The secretary general of the commission said that KNEC has not yet set out the appropriate strategies to be followed when correcting the exam.

Swahili: Akelo alisema kuwa iwapo mikakati ifaayo haitawekwa upesi basi watafanya wawezavyo kuhakikisha kuwashughuli ya kusahihisha mtihani haitafanywa
English: Akelo said that if proper strategies are not quickly developed then they will do their best to ensure that the task of correcting the exam will not be carried out

Swahili: Walimu wawili wameshikwa baada ya kufumaniwa na wanafunzi wawili wa kike katika bwawa la kuogelea katika hoteli moja, hii ni baada wafanyakazi wa hoteli hiyo kuwapata na kupiga ripoti kwa polisi waliofika na kuwakamata
English: Two teachers have been arrested after being found by two female students in a swimming pool in one hotel, this is after the hotel staff found them and reported to the police who arrived and arrested them.

Swahili: Afisa mmoja anayesimamia hospitali alifariki leo kutokana na mshtuko wa moyo ulioletwa na ugonjwa wa korona
English: A hospital administrator died today of a heart attack caused by coronavirus

Swahili: Gavana Kinyanjui amesema kuwa Kingori alijitoa mhanga kuhakikisha kuwa ugonjwa wa korona hausambai
English: Governor Kinyanjui said that Kingori has given himself up to make sure that the coronavirus does not spread

Swahili: Wakaazi wa Nakuru hadi sasa wanaendelea kuomboleza mwendazake Kingori
English: The residents of Nakuru still mourn for their fellow Kingori

Swahili: Tume ya kuratibu mishahara ya wafanyikazi wa serikali imepunguza marupurupu ya wafanyakazi wa serikali ili kuwapa wale wenye mapato ya chini.
English: The Commission for the Coordination of Salaries of Government Employees has reduced the payroll of government employees to those with low incomes.

Swahili: Mwenyekiti wa tume hiyo Lyn Mengich amesema kuwa wale ambao wamekuwa wakipokea marupurupu a juu
English: The chairman of the commission, Lyn Mengich, said that those who have been receiving high fines

Swahili: Mengich alisema kuwa awamu hii ya tatu itaangalia jinsi wakuu sserikalini wamekuwa wakipokea mishahara yao.
English: Mengich said that this third phase will look at how government officials have been receiving their salaries.

Swahili: Mengich alisema kuwa shughuli hiyi itaanza miezi sita baada ya makamishna wa tume hiyo kuleta ripoti.
English: Mengich said that the operation will begin six months after the commissioners of the commission bring the report.

Swahili: Alimaliza kwa kusema kuwa wale ambao wamekuwa wakipokea marupurupu watapata pigo kwani itatolewa
English: He concluded by saying that those who have been receiving the bribes will be punished because it will be given away

Swahili: Alisema kuwa tume ya kuwaajiri walimu watamchukulia hatua mwalimu yeyote atakayepatwa na hatia katika mtihani huo unaoendelea
English: He said that the teachers' recruitment commission will take action against any teacher who is found guilty in the ongoing examination.

Swahili: Alimaliza kwa kusema kuwa idadi ya wanafunzi elfu thelathini na sita mia nane themanini na tatu watafanya mtihani wao
English: He concluded by saying that the total number of students will be thirty-six eight hundred eighty-three.

Swahili: Mwanafunzi mmoja kutoka kaonti ndogo ya Kenyenya atafanya mtihani wake katika hospitali.
English: A student from a small county in Kenya will take his exam in a hospital.

Swahili: Baada ya kujifungua mwanafunzi huyo alipata nafasi ya kuendelea na mtihani wake chini ya ulinzi wa maafisa wamtihani.
English: After the delivery, the student was given the opportunity to continue his examination under the protection of the examination authorities.

Swahili: Kenya inawania kuongeza idadi ya bidhaa ambazo zinapelekwa Uingereza ili kusaidia kuleta shilingi trilioni tatu
English: Kenya is pushing for more goods to be shipped to Britain to help bring in three trillion shillings

Swahili: Waziri wa viwanda alinena hayo katika kutia saini mkataba huo
English: The minister of industry said this in signing the contract

Swahili: Balozi wa Uingereza humu nchini amesifu sana makubaliano hayo akusema kuwa itasaidia kaika kuleta maendeleo nchini Kenya na Uingereza
English: The British ambassador here has praised the agreement, saying it will help bring about progress in Kenya and Britain.

Swahili: Wizara ya afya imeeleza kuwa chanjo hiyo itasaidia kuongeza kinga kwenye mwili baada ya wiki tatu, wameendelea kusema kuwa baada ya kupokea dozi ya pili mtu hataweza kupata ugonjwa wa corona.
English: The health ministry has said that the vaccine will help boost the body's immune system after three weeks, adding that after receiving the second dose, a person will not be able to get coronavirus.

Swahili: Daktari anayeongoza shughuli ya kutoa chanjo hata hivyo amesema kuwa waliochanjwa wanaweza kuusambaza ugonjwa huo akiwahimiza watu wote kupata chanjo.
English: The doctor who oversees the vaccination process, however, has said that vaccinated people can spread the disease by encouraging everyone to get vaccinated.

Swahili: Wahudumu wa magari ya abiria wameiomba serikali kuwapa nafasi za juu wakati wa kuwapa chanjo dhidi ya korona
English: Passenger car operators have asked the government to give them higher positions when providing them with coronavirus vaccines

Swahili: Kibira Machai ambaye ni mmoja wa viongozi wa magari ya umma amesema kuwa madereva na kondakta wako katika hali ya hatari kwani wanatangamana na watu wengi
English: Kibira Machai, one of the leaders of public transport, said that the drivers and the conductor are in danger as they are in close contact with the crowd.

Swahili: Ameiomba serikali kuwapa kipaumbele wakati wa chanjo hiyo
English: He has asked the government to give them priority during the vaccination

Swahili: Amelalamika kuwa sekta ya matatu imewachwa nyuma katika mpango hio
English: He complained that the third sector was left behind in the scheme.

Swahili: Wawakilishi wadi katika kaonti ya Nairobi wamemkashifu Didmus Baraza kujitenga na wanaompigia debe William Ruto
English: The Nairobi ward representatives have condemned Didmus Council to separate itself from the defectors of William Ruto

Swahili: Wakizungumza na wanahabari wawakilishi wadi hao wamesema kuwa watawaunga mkono viongozi wanaotoka eneo la Magharibi
English: Speaking to reporters, the ward representatives said they would support the Western leaders

Swahili: Wawakilishi wadi hao walisema kwamba Baraza ameona wimbi la siasa limemshinda ndio maana amejitenga na William Ruto
English: The ward representatives said that the council had seen the political wave beat him and that this is why he has separated from William Ruto

Swahili: Muungano wa walimu wa sekondari humu nchini KUPPET umeikashifu vikali tume inayosimamia mitihani  ya KNEC kwa kutokuwa na mikakati kabambe ya usahihishaji wa mitihani ya kitaifa ya KCPE na KCSE.
English: The KUPPET High School Teachers' Alliance has strongly criticized the KNEC exam commission for not having a robust strategy to correct the national KCPE and KCSE exams.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa muungano huo Akello Misori ameikashifu tume hiyo kwa kukosa kutuma pesa kwa shule za sekondari  wakati wa mtihani wa kitaifa.
English: The union's secretary general, Akello Misori, has criticized the commission for failing to send money to high schools during national exams.

Swahili: Missorialipokuwa akiongea na wanahabari  alisema kuwa shule zinafaa kupewa pesa kabla ya mitihani kuanza rasmi.
English: Missoria, speaking to reporters, said that schools should be given money before the exams officially begin.

Swahili: Alisema kuwa kuwa walimu wameambiwa wajitayarishe kuyasahihisha mitihani ila hakuna matayarisho na mikakati kabambe yaliyowekwa ya kukabili ueneaji wa Korona.
English: He said that teachers have been told to prepare to correct the exams but no preparedness and ambitious strategies have been put in place to deal with the spread of Corona.

Swahili: Alimalizia kwa kuiomba tume hiyo ya mitihani kuongea vituo vya kusahihishia mitihani kwa minajili ya kufuata sheria za kuzuia uenezaji wa Korona.
English: He concluded by asking the exam commission to speak to the exam correction centres in favour of enforcing the rules to prevent the spread of the Corona virus.

Swahili: Mwili wa mwendazake Magufuli utasafirishwa humu nchini hadi kisiwani Zanzibar kabla ya kupelekwa kwake Mwanza.
English: The body of his colleague Magufuli will be transported from the country to the island of Zanzibar before being shipped to Mwanza.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Waweru ambaye ni mwendesha shughuli katika chama cha Jubilee ameaga dunia.
English: Mr. Waweru, who is the executive director of the Jubilee Party, has bid the world farewell.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Waweru aliaga katika hospitali ya Karen masaa machache yaliyopita.
English: Mr. Waweru called Karen's hospital a few hours ago.

Swahili: Kilichosababisha kifo cha Waweru bado hakijulikani.
English: The cause of Waweru's death is still unknown.

Swahili: Mazishi ya Kikwai -Marehemu Susa Kikwai aliyekuea naibu wa gavana wa Kericho  atazikwa leo.
English: Sheep Funeral - The late Susa Sheep, who was the deputy governor of Kericho, will be buried today.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Kikwai aliaga dunia siku ya Jumamosi iliyopita.
English: Mr. Kikwai laid the groundwork last Saturday.

Swahili: Alizungumza na wanahabari hapo awali alipokuwa mwenyekiti wa kuhifadhi karatasi za mitihani ya shule za msingi za Uasin Gishu katika maeneo ya Eldoret huku akisisistiza kuwa hakuna ripoti yoyote iliyotolewa kuhusu wizi wa mitihani.
English: He spoke to reporters earlier when he was chairman of the Uasin Gishu primary school test papers in Eldoret areas while insisting that no reports of test theft have been made.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo, wanafunzi ishirini na tisa katika kaunti ya Meru walikosa kufanya mitihani yao yadarasa la nane.
English: Meanwhile, twenty-nine students in Meru County failed their eighth grade exams.

Swahili: Hayo  yaliripotiwa na Yatan Dabaso ambaye ni waziri wa masomo katika maeneo ya Tigania.
English: This was reported by Yatan Dabaso, the education minister in the Tigania area.

Swahili: Naibu wa kiongozi wa wengi bungeni mheshimiwa Maoka Maore amemuomba spika wa bunge mheshimiwa Justin Muturi kuandaa mipango ya wabunge kupiga kura.
English: The deputy majority leader, Mr Maoka Maore, has asked the speaker of parliament, Mr Justin Muturi, to prepare the parliamentary ballot.

Swahili: Wabunge walisema kuwa wataheshimu sheria hizo hadi wizara ya fedha ikaongeza pesa katika maeneobunge.
English: The lawmakers said they would respect the laws until the finance ministry added money to the parliament.

Swahili: Junet pamoja na baadhi ya wabunge wengine kama vile Millie Odhiambo, Babu Owino na wengine walisema kuwa pesa hizo husaidia katika maendeleo ya maeneo bunge.
English: Junet and some other lawmakers such as Millie Odhiambo, Babu Owino and others said that the money helps in the development of parliamentary areas.

Swahili: Matiang'I kuhusu mambo ya usalama wa Kapedo.
English: THE security concerns of the Capedo.
