English: A special meeting to discuss security issues is being organized in Kajiado South in a hotel today.

Swahili: Mkutano utakuwa wa kuwaondolea/kufutilia mbali wakaazi wa huko amri ya kutotoka nje ya kuanzia saa kumi na mbili jioni hadi saa kumi na mbili asubuhi.
English: The meeting will be to lift the curfew from 12 p.m. to 12 a.m. for local residents.

Swahili: Amri ya kutotoka nje liliwekwa wakati ambapo wakaazi wa Kapedo na Tiati walikuwa wakipigana na kung'ang'ania mipaka ya Turkana na Baringo.
English: The curfew was imposed when the inhabitants of Capedo and Tiati were fighting and fighting over the Turkana and Baringo borders.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Matiangi aliwaahidi wakaazi wa huko kuwa wahalifu ambao wamekuwa wakivamia maeneo hayo watasakwa, kukamatwa na kuchukuliwa hatua kali licha ya amri ya kutotoka nje kutolewa na waziri wa usalama.
English: Mr. Matiangi promised the local population that criminals who have been invading the areas will be searched, arrested and strictly prosecuted despite a no-go order issued by the security minister.

Swahili: Wizara ya usalama kupitia tawi la Walinda usalama la Mandera iliweza kuvizia shughuli za uvamizi zilizokuwa zikipangwa na kundi la Alshabaab katika maeneo ya Mandera.
English: The security ministry, through the Mandera Security Guard branch, was able to cover up the planned invasions by the Alshabaab group in Mandera areas.

Swahili: Makundi ya Alshabaab yalipanga kuwavamia maafisa wa polisi wa maeneo ya Lafey pamoja na kambi la polisi la Sheikh katika shughuli zao za uhalifu.
English: Alshabaab groups planned to attack Lafey police officers and Sheikh's police station in their criminal activities.

Swahili: Mkutano wa kipekee umeandaliwa wa majadiliano ya mipaka na usalama wa vijiji  katika hoteli moja ya Kajiado kusini siku ya leo.
English: A special meeting is planned for the discussion of borders and the security of villages in a hotel in Kajiado south today.

Swahili: Kundi hilo lilionyesha dalili ya kuvamia maeneo hayo kabla ya polisi kuwasaka katika maeneo hayo.
English: The group showed signs of raiding the areas before the police searched them in the areas.

Swahili: Mkuu wa polisi katika maeneo hayo amesema kuwa hakuna aliyeumia katika huo uvamizi huku akisisitiza kuwa wahalifu hao bado wanapanga kuyavamia makao hayo ya polisi.
English: The local police chief said that no one was injured in the attack, stressing that the criminals are still planning to attack the police station.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa uchunguzi unafanywa kuhusu kifo cha afisa huyo.
English: He said that an investigation into the officer's death was underway.

Swahili: Wafanyibiashara wanaotoka Chabera, Kadongo, Misambi Ramba pamoja na sehemu zingine wamepata hasara kubwa kutokana na kupotea kwa nguvu za uemem katika maeneo hayo.
English: Traders from Chabera, Kadongo, Misambi Ramba and other areas have suffered heavy losses due to the loss of emem power in these areas.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na Ouma na Victor Atinda ambao ni wafanyibiashara katika soko la Kadongo wamesema kuwa wamepoteza wateja wengi kwa sababu ya shida hiyo.
English: Led by Ouma and Victor Atinda, traders at Kadongo market, they have said they have lost many customers due to the crisis.

Swahili: Wameiomba kambi ya stima KPLC kuitatua shida hiyo ili kuwasaidia wafanyibiashara ambao wanapata hasara.
English: They have asked the power plant KPLC to solve the problem to help the losses suffered by the businessmen.

Swahili: Walimalizia kwa kusema kuwa wameitisha msaada kila mahali lakini wameambulia patupu.
English: They concluded by saying that they had called for help everywhere but had failed.

Swahili: Serikali ya kaunti ya Siaya kupitia Wizara ya kilimo imepanga kujenga jumba la utafiti/maabara ya kilimo
English: The Siaya county government through the Ministry of Agriculture has planned to build a research hall/agricultural laboratory

Swahili: Katibu wa wizara ya kilimo ya kaunti ya Siaya mheshimiwa Charles Sisso amesema kuwa maabara hiyo itajengwa kwa shilingi milioni ishirini na inatarajiwa kukamilishwa katika mwezi wa sita mwaka huu.
English: The secretary of the Siaya county ministry of agriculture, Mr. Charles Sisso, said that the lab will be built for 20 million shillings and is expected to be completed in the sixth month of this year.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Sisso aliongea na wanahabari wa Dala Fm akisema kuwa maabara hiyo itasaidia katika kuchunguza mchanga pamoja na kutafiti na kupima magonjwa anuwai ya wanyama na mimea.
English: Mr Sisso spoke to Dala Fm journalists saying that the lab will help in soil research as well as research and testing various animal and plant diseases.

Swahili: Kwingineko, mheshimiwa Sisso amesema kuwa fedha zilizotengwa sasa hivi ni za kujenga sehemu za kukausha mchele huku akisema kuwa wakulima wa mchele wamekuwa wakipata hasara hasa katika msimu wa mvua, wavuvi vilevile waliungwa mkono kwa kupewa neti za bure.
English: Elsewhere, Mr Sisso said that the funds allocated are now for the construction of rice drying areas, saying that rice farmers have been suffering losses especially in the rainy season, while fishermen were also supported by free nets.

Swahili: Mbali na hayo, walipeana boti za kasi za kusaidia katika kuweka usalama ziwani.
English: In addition, they provided fast boats to help keep the lake safe.

Swahili: Wakulima wameshauriwa kuanza shughuli za ukulima kwa sababu msimu wa mvua umeanza na unatarajiwa kuenda hadi mwezi wa sita.
English: Farmers are advised to start their farming activities because the rainy season has begun and is expected to last until the sixth month.

Swahili: Mkurugenzi wa wizara ya elimu kaunti ya Siaya mheshimiwa Domnic Arodi amesema kuwa walishatabiri kuwa mvua faafu ya kuanza rasmi shughuli za ukulima itaanza katika wiki ya tatu ya mwezi huu.
English: The director of the Siaya County Ministry of Education, Mr. Domnic Arodi, said that they predicted that the rainfall would be the first official start of agricultural activities in the third week of this month.

Swahili: Arodi alisema kuwa mbegu  zinazofaa kupandwa ni pamoja na za maharagwe, mtama na mahindi huku akiwahakikishia kuwa mvua tayari imeanza katika maeneo anuwai.
English: Arodi said that seeds suitable for planting included beans, mustard and corn, while assuring them that rain has already begun in various areas.

Swahili: Aliongezea kuwa wakulima wanaweza kupanda mihogo ambayo itawasaidia wakati wa njaa.
English: He added that farmers could plant a crop of hops that would help them during famine.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Arodi akiongea na wanahabari wa Dala  Fm, amewaambia wakulima kuwa wawe wakifuata ratiba ya wizara ya ukulima ya mashinani ili kuboresha shughuli za ukulima.
English: Speaking to the media in Dala Fm, Mr. Arodi has told farmers to follow the schedule of the Ministry of Agriculture of the Mashiach to improve agricultural activities.

Swahili: Ameanzisha mradi wa kipekee wa kuboresha shughuli za ukulima katika kaunti zote za humu nchini.
English: He has set up a unique project to improve agricultural activities in all the districts of this country.

Swahili: Mradi huo unaoendeshwa na wizara ya ukulima humu nchini utasaidia kumaliza matatizo yaliyo katika ukulima kama njia mojawapo ya  kuhakikisha kua chakula kinatosha nchini kote.
English: The project, run by the country's agriculture ministry, will help solve the problems in agriculture as one way to ensure that food is adequate for the entire country.

Swahili: Otieno Owuor amesema kuwa mradi huo umefika kwa wakulima zaidi ya elfu moja katika kaunti ya Siaya.
English: Otieno Owuor said that the project has reached more than a thousand farmers in Siaya county.

Swahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta pamoja na naibu wake William Ruto waliungana na familia na marafiki katika kuomboleza mratibu wa Jubilee mheshimiwa Waweru katika hospitali ya Karen alikokimbizwa baada ya kuzirai na kisha kuaga.
English: President Uhuru Kenyatta and his deputy William Ruto joined family and friends in mourning the Jubilee coordinator Mr. Waweru at Karen's hospital who was rushed after falling asleep and then saying goodbye.

Swahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta alimuomboleza Waweru kama kiongozi aliyekuwa mchapa kazi katika nyadhifa zote za serikali alizofanyia kazi katika rambirambi alizotuma.
English: President Uhuru Kenyatta mourned Waweru as a leader who was a traitor in all the government positions he worked in the rambirambi he sent.

Swahili: Kwa upande wa naibu wa rais William Ruto alimuomboleza kama kiongozi aliyeamini kazi yake na aliyetaka chama cha Jubilee kuendelea mbele siku zote.
English: On the part of Vice President William Ruto, he mourned him as a leader who believed in his work and wanted the Jubilee party to continue forever.

Swahili: Kinara wa ODM Raila Odinga  vilevile kwa wakati huo huo alikaribishwa na kulala katika ikulu ya nchi hiyo.
English: The ODM tower Raila Odinga was also at the same time welcomed and slept in the country's palace.

Swahili: Muungano wa madakitari humu nchini (KMPD ilitoa shauku/ mshtuko wao kutokana na kujaa kwa vitanda vya
English: The KMPD has expressed its enthusiasm/shock at the number of beds in the country.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa muungano huo Dkt. Chibanzi Mwachonda amesema kuwa kuongezeka kwa wagonjwa wa Korona humu nchini haijawanusuru wahudumu wa afya kwani idadi 10 ya madaktari wamelazwa hospitalini kwa sababu ya ugonjwa huo.
English: The union's secretary general, Dr. Chibanzi Mwachonda, said the increase in coronavirus cases in the country has not helped health workers as 10 doctors have been hospitalized due to the disease.

Swahili: Idadi ya watakaoangamia kutokana na ugonjwa huo humu nchini itaongezeka.
English: The number of deaths from the disease in this country will increase.

Swahili: Dkt. Mwachonda amesema kuwa hesabu ya wahudumu wa afya walio katika kitengo cha wagonjwa mahututi sasa imepungua huku akiwasihi wahudumu wote kuenda kupokea chanjo.
English: Dr. Mwachonda said that the number of health workers in the critical care unit has now decreased while urging all the staff to get vaccinated.

Swahili: Kanisa za humu nchini zimeshauriwa kufuata sheria zote zilizowekwa za kudhibiti uenezaji wa Korona
English: Churches in this country are advised to follow all the established laws to control the spread of the Corona virus

Swahili: Padri Muheria amelalamika zaidi kuhusu kesi zinazoongezeka za idadi kubwa ya watu wanaoambukizwa ugonjwa wa Korona.
English: Priest Muheria has complained further about the growing number of cases of the coronavirus infection.

Swahili: Inasemekana kuwa idadi ya wanaoenda kanisani wanafaa kufuata sheria za kudhibiti ugonjwa wa Korona kwa kuosha mikono, kuvaa barakoa  na kukaa mita moja mbali na watu.
English: It is said that the number of churchgoers who attend is appropriate to observe the rules for controlling the coronavirus by washing their hands, wearing a blanket, and staying one meter away from people.

Swahili: Kinara wa chama cha ANC Musalia Mudavadi amekana uvumi unaosambaa humu nchini kuwa kuhusishwa kwa kinara wa chama cha wiper Kalonzo Musyoka kimefanya chama cha ODM kupoteza umaarufu wake.
English: ANC leader Musalia Mudavadi has denied the rumors circulating in the country that the involvement of the wiper party leader Kalonzo Musyoka has caused the ODM party to lose its popularity.

Swahili: Akiongea katika kaunti ya Mombasa, Mudavadi alisema kuwa mambo hayo ni propaganda ambazo hazina maana zozote iwapo chama cha ODM kitaendelea kupoteza umaarufu wake humu nchini haswa katika maeneo hayo.
English: Speaking in Mombasa district, Mudavadi said that these are propaganda that have no meaning if the ODM party continues to lose its popularity here in the country especially in those areas.

Swahili: Mudavadi alisema kuwa hasara za pesa kama hizo hazifai kufanyika tena katika Kambi ya ndege ya humu nchini Kenya Airways katika mwaka ujao.
English: Mudavadi said that such losses should not be repeated at the airport in Kenya Airways next year.

Swahili: Nchi ya Kenya imetajwa kama mojawapo za nchi ambazo hazina mikakati ya kulinda mazingira yake pamoja na majikama inavyofaa.
English: Kenya has been named as one of the countries that lacks adequate environmental protection and conservation strategies.

Swahili: Wale wanaoishi katika maeneo ya vyanzo vya maji wameshauriwa na tume ya mazingira kuweka mikakati faafu ya kuhifadhi maji yatakayowasaidia wakati wa ukame.
English: Those living in water-rich areas have been advised by the environmental commission to develop effective water conservation strategies that will help them during drought.

Swahili: Kazi ya ujenzi wa barabara kutoka Lamu hadi Garsen ulianzishwa mwezi wa sita mwaka huu  na asilimia kubwa inatarajika kukamilika.
English: The construction of the road from Lamu to Garsen began in June this year and is expected to be completed in large part.

Swahili: Miradi ya kuboresha shughuli za kilimo zimeanzishwa katika kaunti zote arubaini na saba nchini Kenya.
English: Projects to improve agricultural activity have been launched in all forty-seven counties in Kenya.

Swahili: Mipango imeanza ya kuboresha kilimo nchini zikiongozwa na wizara ya kilimo ya kuondoa changamoto ili wakulima wapate kuzalisha vyakula vya kutosha na kujenga maghala ya vyakula.
English: Plans have been launched to improve agriculture in the country under the leadership of the Ministry of Agriculture to address the challenge of providing farmers with sufficient food and building food storage facilities.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu katika idara ya kilimo katika kaunti ya Siaya mheshimiwa Charles Sisso alieleza kuwa maabara ya shilingi milioni ishirini inajengwa na inatarajiwa kukamilika mwezi wa sita mwaka huu.
English: The secretary general of the Siaya County Department of Agriculture, Mr. Charles Sisso, explained that a 20 million shilling laboratory is being built and is expected to be completed in June this year.

Swahili: Akiongea na Dala Fm, Bwana Sisso amesema kuwa maabara hiyo itatumika kuchunguza mchanga, mifugo na mimea miongoni mwa mengine.
English: Speaking to Dala Fm, Mr Sisso said that the lab will be used to study sand, livestock and plants among others.

Swahili: Kwingineko, mheshimiwa Sisso amesema kuwa fedha zilizotengwa sasa hivi ni za kujenga sehemu za kukausha mchele huku akisema kuwa wakulima wa mpunga wamekuwa wakipata hasara hasa katika msimu wa mvua, wavuvi vilevile waliungwa mkono kwa kupewa nyavu maalum.
English: Elsewhere, Mr Sisso said that the funds allocated are now for the construction of rice drying areas, adding that rice farmers have been suffering losses especially in the rainy season, while fishermen were also supported by special nets.

Swahili: Wadi ya Railways katika kaunti ya Kisumu imepanga kufanya kazi na wazee wa vijiji (nyumba kumi) kufanya maendeleo kwa wananchi.
English: The Railways Department in Kisumu County has planned to work with village elders (ten houses) to develop the citizens.

Swahili: Diwani/msimamizi wa wadi hiyo ambaye ni Pdri. David Arao amesema kuwa kufanya kai na wazee hao ndio hatua ya mwisho ya kuhakikisha kuwa maendeleo yanawafikia wananchi kwa njia ifaayo.
English: The warden/manager of the ward, Dr. David Arao, said that the implementation of the kai and the elderly is the last step to ensure that development reaches the citizens in a proper way.

Swahili: Aliongea katika hafla fulani ya uchaguzi wa wawakilishi wa vijiji vya eneo la Railways ya juu na chini ambapo wakaazi wa hapo walifika katika eneo hilo la Work Yard kuwachagua wasimamizi wao wa vijiji.
English: He spoke at an election of representatives of the upper and lower railway areas where local residents arrived in the Work Yard area to elect their village managers.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Arao aliwasifu wawakilishi wazee wa hapo awali huku akiahidi kufanya kazi nao.
English: Mr. Arao praised the former senior representatives while promising to work with them.

Swahili: Alikamilisha kwa kusema kuwa atawapa kazi ya kuhakikisha kuwa maendeleo anuwai kama vile barabara, maji na mfumo wa maji taka zimetengenezwa vizuri katika kaunti hiyo na ripoti faafu kutolewa.
English: He concluded by saying that he would give them the task of ensuring that various developments such as roads, water and wastewater systems are well developed in the county and that a detailed report is issued.

Swahili: Daktari Aman akizungumza alisihi kila mwananchi achukue usukani katika kujikinga dhidi ya ugonjwa wa Korona.
English: Dr Aman speaking urged every citizen to take the lead in protecting themselves against the coronavirus.

Swahili: Amewaambia wakenya wanaopanga kuwa na sherehe wakati wa likizo ya pasaka watupilie  mbali mipango kama hiyo.
English: He has told Kenyans planning to have a holiday party during the Easter holidays to put aside such plans.

Swahili: Muungano wa kutetea haki za madaktari humu nchini (KMPD) umetangaza wasiwasi wao kuhusu kujaa kwa wadi za wagonjwa mahututi kujaa pomoni humu nchini.
English: The KMPD has expressed concern about the number of urgent care wards in the country.

Swahili: Muungano huo umewarai wakenya wote kuheshimu dini zote za Wakenya wenzao.
English: This unity has taught all Kenyans to respect all the religions of fellow Kenyans.

Swahili: Ameielekeza kama ya elimu inayoongozwa na mwakilishi wa wanawake bungeni wa kaunti ya Busia  Bi. Florence Mutua kuongoza hafla hiyo bungeni na kutoa ripoti rasmi kabla ya tarehe kumi tano mwezi wa Aprili mwaka huu.
English: She has directed it as an educational event led by the representative of women in parliament of Busia county Ms. Florence Mutua to lead the event in parliament and to give an official report before the 15th of April this year.

Swahili: Mkewe rais Bi. Margaret Kenyatta amewarai wakenya ili waendelee kufuata mikakati ya kuzuia usambazaji wa Ukimwi na Kaswende kutoka kwa mama hadi mtoto wakati wa kujifungua.
English: His wife, Mrs Margaret Kenyatta, has urged Kenyans to continue to follow strategies to prevent the transmission of HIV and tuberculosis from mother to child during childbirth.

Swahili: Bi. Kenyatta amesema kuwa miradi yote yameweza kufanywa kutokana na ushirikiano ambao umekuwa kati ya serikali na mashirika yasiyo ya serikali.
English: Ms. Kenyatta said that all the projects have been made possible thanks to the cooperation that has been between the government and NGOs.

Swahili: Ameisifia sana ushirikiano ambao umekuwa kati yake na matawi ya wizara kadhaa za serikali za kaunti katika mradi wake wa kusaidia katika matibabu ya Beyond Zero Campaign.
English: He has praised the collaboration that has been made between him and several county government departments in his Beyond Zero Campaign medical aid project.

Swahili: Waziri wa afya humu nchini Mutai Kagwe katika haotuba iliyosomwa na naibu wake Mercy Mwangangi amemsifu Bi. Kenyatta kuhusu mradi wake wa Beyond Zero Campaign ambao umesaidia sana kupita kiasi.
English: In a speech read by his deputy, Minister of Health Mutai Kagwe, Ms. Kenyatta praised her Beyond Zero Campaign project, which has been extremely helpful.

Swahili: Mshukiwa huyo kwa majina ya Husein Otieno alihukumiwa na mahakama ya Kibera baada ya kukiri mashtaka yake mbele ya hakimu Philip Mutua.
English: The suspect, named Husein Otieno, was convicted by Kibera court after admitting his charges to the judge Philip Mutua.

Swahili: Kulingana na ripoti za mahakama, Otieno alimuibia Jared Omuya  tarehe kumi na mbili mwezi huu katika kituo cha kuegeshea magari ya abiria ya Riruta mjini Nairobi.
English: According to court reports, Otieno stole Jared Omuya on the 12th of this month from a Riruta passenger car park in Nairobi.

Swahili: Wabunge wameunga mkono wazo lililowasilishwa bungeni na mbunge wa Garissa ya  kuitaka serikali kuweka mikakati ya kipekee ya kuhakikisha kuwa serikali imewapa vijana vitambulisho/vipande wakiwa bado shuleni
English: Parliamentarians have supported the proposal put forward by the Garissa MP to call on the government to set up special policies to ensure that the government gives young people IDs/s while they are still in school

Swahili: Wanaitaka serikali kuweka wazi sababu za vijana kutoka maeneo fulani nchini kukosa vitambulisho hata baada ya kukamilisha masomo ya sekondari.
English: They demand that the government clarify why young people from some parts of the country do not have a valid ID even after finishing high school.

Swahili: Wanasema kuwa vitambulisho vingine vililetwa kutokana na baa la njaa lililowakumba wakaazi wa maeneo ya kaskazini mashariki katika miaka ya elfu moja tisa mia tisini huku wazee wakisisitiza kuwa baadhi ya jamii ya wasomali katika kaunti ya Garissa na Wajir hawana vitambulisho.
English: They say that some of the identities were brought in as a result of the famine that hit the northeastern areas in the 1990s, while the elders insisted that some Somali communities in Garissa and Wajir counties have no identities.

Swahili: Maneno hayoya Duale yaliungwa mkono na mbunge wa Eldas - Adeb Keyana ambaye alilalamika kuhusu shida zinazowakumba waakenya ambao hawana vitambulisho.
English: Duale's comments were supported by Eldas MP Adeb Keyana, who complained about the problems facing Kenyan citizens without IDs.

Swahili: Amesema kwamba kuwapa vijana hao vitambulisho wakiwa shuleni itasaidia zaidi katika kupunguza na kumaliza uhalifu kabisa  humu nchini.
English: He said that giving these young people their school IDs would be a major contribution to reducing and eliminating crime in this country.

Swahili: Bi. Agnes akavindu aliyeibuka mshindi wa kiti cha useneta katika uchaguzi mdogo wa kaunti ya Machakos amekaribishwa rasmi katika afisi hiyo ya seneta.
English: Mrs. Agnes was infected and the winner of the Senate seat in the Machakos county by-election has been officially invited to the Senate chamber.

Swahili: Kavindu  aliyeapishwa rasmi bungeni na spika Ken Lusaka aliandamana pamoja na Seneta wa Bungoma Moses Wetangula pamoja na Abshiro Halaqe aliyealikwa na chama cha KANU.
English: Kavindu was sworn in to parliament by speaker Ken Lusaka accompanied by Bungoma Senator Moses Wetangula and Abshiro Halaqe, invited by the KANU party.

Swahili: Kavindu amekuwa seneta mwanamke wa nne kuchaguliwa na wananchi huku akichukua nafasi hiyo iliyobaki bure kutokana na kifo cha seneta wa kitambo wa kaunti hiyo Boniface Kabaka.
English: Kavindu has become the fourth female senator to be elected by the citizens while taking the vacant seat left vacant by the death of the county's incumbent senator Boniface Kabaka.

Swahili: Kinara wa chama cha Wiper - Kalonzo Musyoka pamoja na  naibu wa waziri wa utalii Wavinya Ndeti  walifika bungeni Kavindu alipokuwa akiapishwa afisini.
English: A Wiper-Kalonzo Musyoka party spokesman and deputy minister of tourism Vavinya Ndeti arrived at the Kavindu parliament as he was sworn into office.

Swahili: Wakazi wa Kisumu wana maoni mengi kuhusu chanjo ya Korona iliyowasili nchini.
English: Residents of Kisumu have many opinions about the arrival of the Corona vaccine in the country.

Swahili: Wale wanaosisitiza ili katiba ifanyiwe mabadiliko humu nchini wameambiwa kuwa hawawezi kuwasaidia wakenya kutatua na kumaliza matatizo/ shida kubwa.
English: Those who insist on constitutional reform in this country have been told that they cannot help Kenya solve and solve major problems.

Swahili: Naibu wa rais mheshimiwa William Ruto amesema kuwa viongozi hao wameweka mbele tamaa zao za kibinafsi.
English: Vice President William Ruto has said that the leaders have put their own personal interests first.

Swahili: Akiongea katika kaunti ya Narok, mheshimiwa Ruto alisema kuwa siyo lazima katiba ibadilishwe kwa sababu wananchi wanataka miradi ya maendeleo.
English: Speaking in Narok county, Mr Ruto said that the constitution does not have to be changed because the citizens want development projects.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Mudavadi aliongea na wanahabari huku akisema kuwa baadhi ya viongozi katika kaunti ya Kakamega akiwemo gavana Wycliffe Oparanya  wanapanga jinzi watakayoiba kura katika uchaguzi huo.
English: Mudavadi told reporters that some leaders in Kakamega county including Governor Wycliffe Oparanya are planning a plot to steal votes in the election.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa wamepiga hatua ya kuwaleta wananchi pamoja kwa matakwa ya kuwang'oa wenye tabia zisizokubalika kama kaunti za huko.
English: He said they have taken steps to bring the citizens together with the demand to eliminate those who have behaved as unacceptable as local counties.

Swahili: Aliongea alipokuwa katika mkutano wa viongozi wengi tajika ya kujadili jinsi wananchi watakavyoboresha maisha yao haswa wanapokabili ugonjwa wa Korona.
English: He spoke at a meeting of many wealthy leaders to discuss how citizens will improve their lives especially in the face of the coronavirus pandemic.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Duba amewaomba wanaofanya ufugaji wa wanyama kuwachana na shughuli za kung'ang'ania sehemu hizo za ufugaji kwani wengi wamepoteza maisha yao kutokana na vita hivyo.
English: Mr Duba has urged the livestock farmers to stay away from the activities of the farming areas as many have lost their lives in the war.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa usalama Dkt. Karanja Kibicho aliongea na wanahabari huku akiwaomba viongozi wa siasa ambao bado wanaoipiga vita ripoti ya BBI kujitayarisha kwa mshindano makubwa  baada ya wabunge kuunga mkono ripoti hiyo itakayowasilishwa bungeni .
English: Secretary-General of the Security Council Dr. Karanja Kibicho spoke to reporters as he urged political leaders who are still fighting the BBI report to prepare for a major competition after lawmakers backed the report to be submitted to parliament.

Swahili: Kamati ya kufanya bajeti CDF bungeni itakutana na waziri wa fedha Ukur Yatani kujadili kusitishwa kwa fedha za CDF.
English: The CDF budgeting committee will meet with finance minister Ukur Yatan to discuss the suspension of CDF funding.

Swahili: Hazina ya CDF inafaa kupokea shilingi bilioni arubaini na moja katika mwaka wa fedha wa 2020/2021
English: The CDF's treasury is eligible to receive 41 billion shillings in the 2020/2021 financial year

Swahili: Wizi wa mahindi.
English: Stealing corn.

Swahili: Washukiwa watatu wanaohusishwa na wizi wa mbegu za mahindi zinazotosha marobota 1700 katika kambi ya mbegu ya Kenya Seed Companyambayo ni jumla ya shilingi bilioni saba walikamatwa na polisi wa Narok.
English: Three suspects involved in the theft of 1700 robot-sized corn seeds at the Kenya Seed Company seed camp totaling seven billion shillings were arrested by Narok police.

Swahili: Brian Meja pamoja na washukiwa wengine wawili wanaotoka katika maeneo ya Narok walikamatwa jana jioni kwa tuhuma za wizi wa mbegu za mahindi.
English: Brian Mayor and two other suspects from the Narok area were arrested last night on suspicion of theft of cornseeds.

Swahili: Uchunguzi huo ulifanywa na kambi kuu ya mbegu humu nchini katika makao ya biashara ya mheshimiwa Meja.
English: The study was conducted by the country's largest seed camp in the business home of Mr. Mayor.

Swahili: Maafisa wa upelelezi walisema kuwaMeja  amekuwa akihifadhi mbegu hizo katika makao hayo ya biashara kabla ya kuwasambazia wafanyibiashara wengine.
English: Investigators said that the mayor has been storing the seeds in the trading center before distributing them to other traders.

Swahili: Walisisitiza kuwa Mifuko ya mbegu hizo imekuwa ikisambazwa kwa Yogesh pamoja na Gaurav ambao ni wafanyibiashara wa Asia.
English: They insisted that the bags of seeds have been distributed to Yogesh and Gaurav, Asian traders.

Swahili: Ajali ya mwalimu mwingine wa shule ya sekondari
English: The fate of another high school teacher

Swahili: Kulingana na mkuu wa polisi wa hapo mheshimiwa Daniel Kitavi alisema kuwa ajali hiyo imetokana na kuwa walimu hao wamekuwa wakimpigania kidosho mmoja ambaye anafunza katika shule hiyo.
English: According to the local police chief, Mr. Daniel Kitavi said that the accident was caused by the teachers having been fighting against a single defect that teaches at the school.

Swahili: Mkuu wa polisi aliendelea kwa kusema kuwa mshukiwa aliyemshambulia mwalimu mwenzake amefungiwa katika kituo cha polisi  huku uchunguzi ukiendelea kufanywa.
English: The police chief went on to say that the suspect who attacked his teacher has been detained at the police station while the investigation is ongoing.

Swahili: Wakazi wa Kisumu wametoa maoni mbali mbali kuhusu chanjo za Korona zilizowasili humu nchini alfajiri ya leo.
English: Residents of Kisumu have expressed their opinions about the Corona vaccines that arrived here this morning.

Swahili: Wakazi hao walionyesha furaha yao kuhusu chanjo zilizowasili cnchini walipokuwa wakiongea na wanahabari wa Dala Fm huku wakisema kuwa chanjo hizo zitamfanya rais Uhuru Kenyatta kufungua nchi ili waendelee na shughuli zao za kawaida.
English: The residents expressed their satisfaction about the vaccines arriving as they spoke to Dala Fm journalists, saying that the vaccines would allow President Uhuru Kenyatta to open up the country to resume their normal activities.

Swahili: Waliongezea kwa kusema kuwa hilo ni wazo nzuri la kuwachanja wafanyikazi wa serikali kama vile madaktari na walimu nafasi ya kwanza ya kupata chanjo kwani wao ndio wanaweza kuambukizwa kirahisi.
English: They added that it is a good idea to vaccinate government employees such as doctors and teachers as the first to get vaccinated as they are the ones who are more susceptible to infection.

Swahili: Kwingineko, walitoa maoni yao wakisema kuwa watapata motisha ya kupewa chanjo hiyo baada ya wafanyikazi wa serikali kama vile polisi kuchanjwa.
English: Elsewhere, they expressed their views saying that they would get an incentive to get the vaccine after government officials such as the police were injected.

Swahili: Wananchi wa eneo hilo walitoa maoni yao katika mkutano huo kwa kumuunga naibu wa rais kwa kujitolea kuwasaidia wananchi wenye mapato ya chini.
English: The local people expressed their views at the meeting by joining the vice president in volunteering to help low-income citizens.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na mbunge wa Mathira - Rigathi Gachagua alisema kuwa wataendelea kutembea na mheshimiwa Ruto katika kutimiza ndoto yake ya kuwa rais hadi siku ya uchaguzi/ upigaji kura.
English: Led by MP Mathira - Rigathi Gachagua said they will continue to walk with Mr Ruto in fulfilling his dream of becoming president until election day/vote.

Swahili: Wamekashifu zaidi baadhi ya viongozi wa humu nchini ambao hawajafurahia mikakati yao ya maendeleo ambayo mheshimiwa Ruto amekuwa akifanya huku akisema kuwa baadhi ya wawaniaji wa kiti hicho cha urais  hawana kumbukumbu ya maendeleo yoyote humu nchini.
English: They have further criticized some of the leaders of this country who have not been happy with their development strategies that Mr Ruto has been working on, saying that some of the presidential candidates have no memory of any progress in this country.

Swahili: Gachagua amesema kuwa rais Uhuru Kenyatta hatapeana uongozi kwa kinara wa ODM Raila Odinga .
English: Gachagua has said that President Uhuru Kenyatta will not give leadership to ODM chief Raila Odinga.

Swahili: Ruto kwa upande wake ameendelea kutumia nafasi hiyo kuwasihi wakazi wa huko kumfikiria katika uchaguzi wa 2022.
English: Ruto has continued to use the opportunity to urge locals to consider him in the 2022 election.

Swahili: Amewakashifu baadhi ya  viongozi ambao wanajaribu kutumia njia zisizofaa kumsitisha na kumzuia kupata urais.
English: He has criticized some leaders who try to use improper methods to deter him and prevent him from running for president.

Swahili: Profesa Magoha aliongea katika shule ya vijana ya Chavakali katika kaunti ya Vihiga huku akisema kuwa wamejitayarishwa vilivyo kwa mtihani ujao.
English: Professor Magoha spoke at the Chavakali youth school in Vihiga county, saying that they are prepared for the upcoming exam.

Swahili: Hakuna mahindi yatakayonunuliwa kutokakwa  nchi za Tanzania na Uganda
English: No corn will be bought from Tanzania and Uganda

Swahili: Serikali imesema kuwa imefunga shughuli za kununua mahindi kutoka kwa nchi za nje za Tanzania na Uganda.
English: The government has said it has closed the import of maize from Tanzania and Uganda.

Swahili: Taarifa hii imetolewa na Wizara ya ukulima ya humu nchini siku ya leo.
English: This statement was issued by the Ministry of Agriculture of the country today.

Swahili: Wizara hiyo ya Ukulima imesema kuwa hatua hiyo imechukuliwa kutokana na kemikali za Aflatoxin zinazotumika kwenye mahindi ambayo inasemekana kuwa siyo nzuri katika afya ya binadamu.
English: The Ministry of Agriculture said that the move was taken because of the Aflatoxin chemicals used in corn that are not considered safe for human health.

Swahili: Kamati inayosimamia chakula na ukulima nchini wakiongozwa na mkurugenzi walisema kuwa serikali imekuwa ikifanya upimaji wa vyakula vyote vinavyotoka katika nchi zingine za nje na waligundua kuwa kamikali hizo zilitumika kwa wingi na nchi hizo mbili.
English: The country's Food and Agriculture Committee, headed by the director, said that the government has been testing all food imports from other countries and found that the chemicals were widely used by the two countries.

Swahili: Chuo kikuu cha Nairobi cha Nairobi kilifanya upimaji na uchunguzi wa mahindi hayo.
English: The University of Nairobi conducted a test and analysis of the corn.

Swahili: Hapo awali nchi ya Kenya ilikua ikinunua mahindi kutoka kwa nchi hizo mbili.
English: Kenya was originally a major importer of corn from both countries.

Swahili: Kuidhinishwa kwa Muturi kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu ya mlima Kenya.
English: Authorization of Muturi as the spokesperson of the Agikuyu mountain community in Kenya.

Swahili: Spika wa bunge Justin Muturi ameidhinishwa kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu katika shughuli za siasa katika uchaguzi wa 2022.
English: Parliamentary Speaker Justin Muturi has been confirmed as Agikuyu community spokesperson in political activities in the 2022 elections.

Swahili: Hafla hiyo iliongozwa na Wazee wa Njuri Ncheke katika kaunti ya Meru ambapo Muturi alichukua nafasi hiyo kuenda kuchukua cheo hicho kitakachobakia bure baada aliye kwenye cheo hicho kwa sasa cha rais Uhuru Kenyatta kustaafu.
English: The event was led by the elders of Njuri Ncheke in Meru county where Muturi took the position to take the position that will remain vacant after the current president Uhuru Kenyatta retired.

Swahili: Amekua kiongozi wa tano aliyeidhinishwa kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu baada ya rais wa kwanza Jomo Kenyatta,rais wa tatu Mwai Kibaki, rais wa nne Uhuru Kenyatta pamoja na Kiraitu murungi ambaye ni gavana wa Meru.
English: He has become the fifth leader to be recognized as the spokesperson of the Agikuyu community after the first president Jomo Kenyatta, the third president Mwai Kibaki, the fourth president Uhuru Kenyatta and Kiraitu murungi who is governor of Meru.

Swahili: Hafla hiyo ilijaa na baadhi ya wabunge kutoka mlima Kenya ambao ni pamoja na mawaziri wa wizara  akiwemo Peter Munya.
English: The event was filled with some parliamentarians from the mountains of Kenya including ministers including Peter Munya.

Swahili: Hayo yote yalitendeka wakati ambapo uvumi ulikuwa unasambazwa kuwa Muturi atawania kiti cha urais katika uchaguzi ujao.
English: All this happened at a time when rumors were spreading that Muturi would run for president in the next election.

Swahili: Kabla ya hafla hiyo, maoni anuwai yalitolewa na wananchi pamoja na viongozi kuhusu hatua zilizochukuliwa kwa raia.
English: Prior to the event, various comments were made by citizens and officials about the measures taken for the citizens.

Swahili: Wazee wa Njuri Ncheke wamemuidhinisha spika Muturi kama kiongozi wa jamii ya wakikuyu.
English: Njuri Ncheke's elders have approved Muturi as the leader of the Wikuyu community.

Swahili: Baadhi ya wananchi waliozungumza katika kaunti ya Meru wamesema kuwaingekuwa vyema cheo hicho kikipewa viongozi wengine waliochaguliwa na wananchi.
English: Some citizens speaking in Meru County have said that it would be good if the position was given to other elected officials.

Swahili: Baadhi yao waliwapendelea mbunge wa Gatundu kusini Moses Kuria na aliyekuwa gavana wa kitambo wa Kiambu William Kabogo kupewa cheo hicho.
English: Some favored the appointment of South Gatundu MP Moses Kuria and former Provisional Governor of Kiambu William Kabogo.
