Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa KNUT Wilson Sosion ameeleza kuwa hawataiunga mkono BBI iwapo madai yao ya ongezeko la mshahara na marupurupu haitaangaliwa.
English: KNUT Secretary General Wilson Sosion has said that they will not support BBI if their demands for wage increases and profits are not met.

Swahili: Sosion vilevile ameeleza mipango ya kuhakikisha kuwa walimu wanapeleka pesa kwa muungano wa walimu wa KNUT.
English: Sosion has also outlined plans to ensure that teachers send money to the KNUT teachers' union.

Swahili: Wahudumu wa afya wa kaunti ya Lamu ambao wamekuwa kwenye mgomo kwa zaidi ya siku tisini hatimaye wamerudi kazini.
English: Lamu County health workers who have been on strike for more than 90 days have finally returned to work.

Swahili: Naibu katibu mkuu wa manesi hao Anne Kerothe ameeleza kuwa wamerudi kazini kutokana na taabu ambazo wananchi wanapitia.
English: Anne Kerothe, the assistant secretary general of the nurses, has said that they have returned to work because of the hardships that citizens are going through.

Swahili: Anne alieleza kuwa kaonti hiyo ya lamu imekataa kuwaboreshea mazingira ya kufanya kazi pamoja na malipo ya marupurupu.
English: Anne explained that the county of limbo refused to improve their working environment and to pay them a flat rate.

Swahili: Manesi hao wamekuwa wakiandamana tangu mwezi wa kumi na mbili mwaka jana.
English: The nurses have been marching since December last year.

Swahili: Mwendeshaji bodaboda mmoja ameaga dunia papo hapo na watu wawili kupata majeraha mabaya baada ya pikipiki mbili kugongana katika barabara ya Runyenjes kaunti ya Embu.
English: A bus driver immediately raided the ground and two people were seriously injured after two motorcycles collided on Runyenjes Road in Embu County.

Swahili: Walioshuhudia ajali hiyo wanasema kuwa mwendeshaji aliyeaga alikuwa akiendesha pikipiki kwa kasi sana kabla ya kupoteza mwelekeo na kugonga pikipiki nyingine.
English: Witnesses say the driver was speeding too fast before losing direction and hitting another motorcycle.

Swahili: Wale smbso waliumia wanaendelea kupata matibabu.
English: Those who were injured continue to receive treatment.

Swahili: Wanasiasa humu nchini wameonywa vikali dhidi ya kueneza siasa za chuki hii ni baada ya uchaguzi mdogo uliofanywa siku ya Alhamisi uliosheheni mvutano.
English: Politicians in this country have been warned against spreading hate politics only after a small election on Thursday that sparked tensions.

Swahili: Gavana wa Machakos Alfred Mutua ameeleza kuwa hakuna maendeleo yatakayokuwa humu nchini iwapo wanasiasa hawatawacha siasa za chuki na kugawanya wananchi.
English: Machakos Governor Alfred Mutua has said that no progress will be made in this country unless politicians abandon the politics of hatred and divide the citizens.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo la Tharaka Nithi Mutua alisema kuwa ni yeye tu aliye na uwezo wa kulainisha nchi ya Kenya na kuwaomba wananchi kumuunga mkono katika azma yake ya kuwa rais.
English: Speaking in Tharaka, Nithi Mutua said he was the only one who could soften Kenya and ask the people to support him in his ambition to become president.

Swahili: Jela humu nchini imeanzisha miradi ya kuwafunza kinadada kazi za mikono ambazo zitawasaidia katika siku za usoni baada ya kuwachiliwa huru.
English: The prison in this country has started training the cadets in manual labor that will help them in the future after they are released.

Swahili: Maneno hayo yameungwa mkono na kiongozi wa mashtaka mjini Busia akisema kuwa wananchi wanafaa kuwakaribisha wafungwa ambao wamewachiliwa baada ya kumaliza fungo.
English: The statement was supported by a prosecutor in Busia who said that citizens should welcome prisoners who have been released after the fast.

Swahili: Watu wawili wamekamatwa baada ya kupatwa na kosa la kuharibu transfoma katika eneo la Kanyakwar kaunti ya Kisumu.
English: Two people have been arrested after being found guilty of corrupting the transfoma in Kanyakur, Kisumu county.

Swahili: Wanakijiji hicho waliamka asubui na kukuta giza limetanda jambo ambalo liliwafanya kwenda kuangalia tatizo lilikuwa wapi na eneo la transfoma
English: The villagers woke up early in the morning to find the darkness was over their heads, which led them to go to the transfoma area to see where the problem was.

Swahili: Wawili hao walishikwa wakiiba mafuta ya transfoma hiyo ambayo iliwekwa katika eneo hilo majuma mawili yaliyopita.
English: The two were caught stealing oil from the transfoma that had been placed in the area two weeks earlier.

Swahili: Afisa mkuu wa kambi ya umeme ya Kenya Power amesema kuwa kambi hiyo imepoteza idadi kumi na moja ya transfoma katika eneo la Kisumu pekee jambo ambalo linaipa hasara kubwa.
English: Kenya Power's chief power station official said the plant has lost 11 transformers in Kisumu alone, causing significant losses.

Swahili: Ameeleza kuwa uchunguzi zaidi unaendelea kuhusiana na wizi huo
English: He explained that further investigation is underway into the theft

Swahili: Watu wawili wamekufa huku wengine thelathini wakiumia kutokana na shambulizi la lililotokea Mogadishu Somalia.
English: Two people have died and 30 others have been injured in the Mogadishu attack in Somalia.

Swahili: Naibu wa rais William Ruto amesema kuwa ameendelea kusisitiza ni yeye anayefaa kuutwaa uongozi wa nchi ya Kenya katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao wa elfu mbili ishirini na mbili.
English: Vice President William Ruto has said he has continued to insist he is the right person to take over Kenya's leadership in the next general election of 222.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kaunti ya Meru alikofanya ziara ya siku tatu iliyoisha leo Ruto alisema kuwa viongozi wanaokwenda kinyume naye si wa kutegemewa.
English: Speaking in the Meru district where he made a three-day visit that ended today, Ruto said that leaders who go against him are not reliable.

Swahili: Ruto alisema kuwa viongozi hao wanamsubiri Rais Uhuru kuwaunga mkono ilhali hakuna kazi waliyofanyia wananchi.
English: Ruto said the leaders are waiting for President Uhuru to support them while they have done no work for the citizens.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo seneta wa Meru Mithika Linturi amesema kuwa BBI ingewafaa zaidi wananchi wakati huu wananchi wanapopitia changamoto.
English: Meanwhile, Meru senator Mithika Linturi said that BBI would be more beneficial to the citizens at this time when citizens are facing challenges.

Swahili: Waziri wa usalama amesikitishwa zaidi na wanasiasa kutokana na vurugu vilivyotokea katika wiki hii ambayo inaisha.
English: The minister of security has been more upset by politicians over the violence that has taken place this week.

Swahili: Waziri wa usalama Dkt.  Matiang'I alisema kuwa uamuzi uliotolewa na chama cha ODM ya kubadilisha mpeperushaji wa bendera wa chama hicho kama Raila Odinga ulitokea dakika ya mwisho
English: Minister of Security Dr. Matiang'i said that the decision made by the ODM party to change the party's flag bearer like Raila Odinga came at the last minute

Swahili: Mkutano huo uliofayika kwa mbunge wa Mathare Anthony Oluoch sasa lazima uchukuliwea na uzito.
English: The meeting, which was arranged for Mathare MP Anthony Oluoch, must now be taken seriously.

Swahili: Matiang`I anasema kuwa mkutano huo hauonyeshi kuwa makubaliano baina ya Raila na Uhuru umeambulia patupu.
English: Matiang`I says the meeting does not show that the agreement between Raila and Independence has been unsuccessful.

Swahili: Anapinga uvumi ambao unaendelea nchini kwamba Uhuru Kenyatta lazima amuunge mkono Raila Odinga.
English: He opposes the rumors that Uhuru Kenyatta must support Raila Odinga.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa Mheshimiwa Raila ana mpango wake mwenyewe wa kuwania urais mwakani.
English: He said that Mr Raila has his own plans to run for president this year.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo mbunge wa Makadara ambaye ni mwenyekiti wa ODM Nairobi George Aladwa amesisitiza kuwa Raila Odinha ndiye atapeperusha bendera ya ODM.
English: Meanwhile, MK Madara who is the chairman of ODM Nairobi George Aladwa has insisted that Raila Odinha will fly the ODM flag.

Swahili: Amemwambia gavana wa Mombasa Ali Hassan Joho pamoja na gavana wa Kakamega Wycliff Oparanya watulize azma yao ya kuwania urais.
English: He has asked the governor of Mombasa, Ali Hassan Joho, and Kakamega governor Wycliff Oparanya to cancel their presidential bid.

Swahili: Seneta wa Murang`a Irungu Kangata amesema kuwa makubaliano ya siasa baina ya Uhuru na Raila ni kama inakamilika.
English: Murang`a Senator Irungu Kangata has said that the political agreement between Independence and Raila is almost complete.

Swahili: Akizungumza kutoka eneo la Kiharu alikohudhuria hafla ya maombi amesema baadhi ya wanasiasa kutoka eneo la kati waliopinga makubaliano hayo walinyang`anywa nyadhifa zao serikalini.
English: Speaking from the Kiharu area during a prayer ceremony, he said some politicians from the central region who opposed the agreement were stripped of their positions in the government.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa Kenyatta anaweza kuwa na imani na naibu wake ambaye amekuwa naye kwa tangu uchaguzi wa elfu mbili na mbili.
English: He said Kenyatta can have faith in his deputy who has been with him since the election of 2000 years ago.

Swahili: Amemrai Kenyatta kumuunga mkono naibu wake kwani ako katika nafasi nzuri ya kuutwaa uongozi wa nchi hii.
English: He urged Kenyatta to support his deputy as he is in a good position to take over the leadership of this country.

Swahili: Ameeleza ya kuwa licha ya hayo yote wanamheshimu rais Uhuru Kenyatta.
English: He explained that despite all this they respect President Uhuru Kenyatta.

Swahili: Kangata alisema hayo siku moja baada ya seneta wa Siaya James Orengo kusema kuwa kuna baadhi ya wakuu serikalini ambao wanapanga kuwazuia wengine kuutwaa uongozi humu nchini.
English: Kangata said this a day after Siaya senator James Orengo said that there are some government officials who plan to prevent others from taking over the country.

Swahili: Hii inafanyika baada ya vuguvugu la Tanga Tanga linalomuunga mkono William Ruto wakiongozwa na Caleb Kositany kuwaambia wenzao wa ODM kutafuta namna ya kutatua migogoro baina ya pande hizo mbili.
English: This comes after the Tanga Tanga movement, led by Caleb Kositany, told fellow ODMs to find a way to resolve the conflicts between the two sides.

Swahili: Caleb Kositany amewaambia viongozi wa ODM na wale Jubilee kutoleta vurugu humu nchini.
English: Caleb Kositany has told the leaders of the ODM and the Jubilee parties not to bring violence to this country.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kanisa la AIC kule Eldoret Kositany alieleza kusikitishwa kwake na matamshi ya baadhi ya viongozi wa ODM anaosema wanataka kuirudisha Kenya nyuma.
English: Speaking at the AIC church in Eldoret Kositany expressed his regret over the remarks of some ODM leaders who say they want to bring Kenya back.

Swahili: Mkuu wa polisi aliendelea kwa kusema kuwa mshukiwa aliyemshambulia mwalimu mwenzake amefungiwa katika kituo cha polisi  huku uchunguzi ukiendelea kufanywa.
English: The police chief went on to say that the suspect who attacked his teacher has been detained at the police station while the investigation is ongoing.

Swahili: Wakazi wa Kisumu wametoa maoni mbali mbali kuhusu chanjo za Korona zilizowasili humu nchini alfajiri ya leo.
English: Residents of Kisumu have expressed their opinions about the Corona vaccines that arrived here this morning.

Swahili: Wakazi hao walionyesha furaha yao kuhusu chanjo zilizowasili cnchini walipokuwa wakiongea na wanahabari wa Dala Fm huku wakisema kuwa chanjo hizo zitamfanya rais Uhuru Kenyatta kufungua nchi ili waendelee na shughuli zao za kawaida.
English: The residents expressed their satisfaction about the vaccines arriving as they spoke to Dala Fm journalists, saying that the vaccines would allow President Uhuru Kenyatta to open up the country to resume their normal activities.

Swahili: Waliongezea kwa kusema kuwa hilo ni wazo nzuri la kuwachanja wafanyikazi wa serikali kama vile madaktari na walimu nafasi ya kwanza ya kupata chanjo kwani wao ndio wanaweza kuambukizwa kirahisi.
English: They added that it is a good idea to vaccinate government employees such as doctors and teachers as the first to get vaccinated as they are the ones who are more susceptible to infection.

Swahili: Kwingineko, walitoa maoni yao wakisema kuwa watapata motisha ya kupewa chanjo hiyo baada ya wafanyikazi wa serikali kama vile polisi kuchanjwa.
English: Elsewhere, they expressed their views saying they would get an incentive to get the vaccine after government officials such as the police were injected.

Swahili: Wananchi wa eneo hilo walitoa maoni yao katika mkutano huo kwa kumuunga naibu wa rais kwa kujitolea kuwasaidia wananchi wenye mapato ya chini.
English: The local people expressed their views at the meeting by joining the vice president in volunteering to help low-income citizens.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na mbunge wa Mathira - Rigathi Gachagua alisema kuwa wataendelea kutembea na mheshimiwa Ruto katika kutimiza ndoto yake ya kuwa rais hadi siku ya uchaguzi/ upigaji kura.
English: Led by MP Mathira - Rigathi Gachagua said they will continue to walk with Mr Ruto in fulfilling his dream of becoming president until election day/vote.

Swahili: Wamekashifu zaidi baadhi ya viongozi wa humu nchini ambao hawajafurahia mikakati yao ya maendeleo ambayo mheshimiwa Ruto amekuwa akifanya huku akisema kuwa baadhi ya wawaniaji wa kiti hicho cha urais  hawana kumbukumbu ya maendeleo yoyote humu nchini.
English: They have further criticized some of the leaders of this country who have not been happy with their development strategies that Mr Ruto has been working on, saying that some of the presidential candidates have no memory of any progress in this country.

Swahili: Gachagua amesema kuwa rais Uhuru Kenyatta hatapeana uongozi kwa kinara wa ODM Raila Odinga.
English: Gachagua has said that President Uhuru Kenyatta will not give leadership to the ODM chief Raila Odinga.

Swahili: Ruto kwa upande wake ameendelea kutumia nafasi hiyo kuwasihi wakazi wa huko kumfikiria katika uchaguzi wa 2022.
English: Ruto has continued to use the opportunity to urge locals to consider him in the 2022 election.

Swahili: Amewakashifu baadhi ya  viongozi ambao wanajaribu kutumia njia zisizofaa kumsitisha na kumzuia kupata urais.
English: He has criticized some leaders who try to use improper methods to stop him and prevent him from running for president.

Swahili: Profesa Magoha aliongea katika shule ya vijana ya Chavakali katika kaunti ya Vihiga huku akisema kuwa wamejitayarishwa vilivyo kwa mtihani ujao.
English: Professor Magoha spoke at the Chavakali youth school in Vihiga county, saying that they are prepared for the upcoming exam.

Swahili: Hakuna mahindi yatakayonunuliwa kutokakwa  nchi za Tanzania na Uganda
English: No corn will be bought from Tanzania and Uganda

Swahili: Serikali imesema kuwa imefunga shughuli za kununua mahindi kutoka kwa nchi za nje za Tanzania na Uganda.
English: The government has said it has closed the import of maize from Tanzania and Uganda.

Swahili: Taarifa hii imetolewa na Wizara ya ukulima ya humu nchini siku ya leo.
English: This statement was issued by the Ministry of Agriculture of the country today.

Swahili: Wizara hiyo ya Ukulima imesema kuwa hatua hiyo imechukuliwa kutokana na kemikali za Aflatoxin zinazotumika kwenye mahindi ambayo inasemekana kuwa siyo nzuri katika afya ya binadamu.
English: The Ministry of Agriculture said that the move was taken because of the Aflatoxin chemicals used in corn that are not considered safe for human health.

Swahili: Kamati inayosimamia chakula na ukulima nchini wakiongozwa na mkurugenzi walisema kuwa serikali imekuwa ikifanya upimaji wa vyakula vyote vinavyotoka katika nchi zingine za nje na waligundua kuwa kamikali hizo zilitumika kwa wingi na nchi hizo mbili.
English: The Food and Agriculture Committee of the country, headed by the director, said that the government has been testing all food imports from other countries and found that the chemicals were widely used by the two countries.

Swahili: Chuo kikuu cha Nairobi cha Nairobi kilifanya upimaji na uchunguzi wa mahindi hayo.
English: The University of Nairobi conducted a test and analysis of the corn.

Swahili: Hapo awali nchi ya Kenya ilikua ikinunua mahindi kutoka kwa nchi hizo mbili.
English: Kenya was originally a major importer of corn from both countries.

Swahili: Kuidhinishwa kwa Muturi kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu ya mlima Kenya.
English: Authorization of Muturi as the spokesperson of the Agikuyu mountain community in Kenya.

Swahili: Spika wa bunge Justin Muturi ameidhinishwa kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu katika shughuli za siasa katika uchaguzi wa 2022.
English: Parliamentary Speaker Justin Muturi has been confirmed as Agikuyu community spokesperson in political activities in the 2022 elections.

Swahili: Hafla hiyo iliongozwa na Wazee wa Njuri Ncheke katika kaunti ya Meru ambapo Muturi alichukua nafasi hiyo kuenda kuchukua cheo hicho kitakachobakia bure baada aliye kwenye cheo hicho kwa sasa cha rais Uhuru Kenyatta kustaafu.
English: The event was led by the elders of Njuri Ncheke in Meru county where Muturi took the position to take the position that will remain vacant after the current president Uhuru Kenyatta retired.

Swahili: Amekua kiongozi wa tano aliyeidhinishwa kama msemaji wa jamii ya Agikuyu baada ya rais wa kwanza Jomo Kenyatta,rais wa tatu Mwai Kibaki, rais wa nne Uhuru Kenyatta pamoja na Kiraitu murungi ambaye ni gavana wa Meru.
English: He has become the fifth leader to be recognized as the spokesperson of the Agikuyu community after the first president Jomo Kenyatta, the third president Mwai Kibaki, the fourth president Uhuru Kenyatta and Kiraitu murungi who is governor of Meru.

Swahili: Hafla hiyo ilijaa na baadhi ya wabunge kutoka mlima Kenya ambao ni pamoja na mawaziri wa wizara  akiwemo Peter Munya.
English: The event was filled with some MPs from the mountains of Kenya including ministers including Peter Munya.

Swahili: Hayo yote yalitendeka wakati ambapo uvumi ulikuwa unasambazwa kuwa Muturi atawania kiti cha urais katika uchaguzi ujao.
English: All this happened at a time when rumors were spreading that Muturi would run for president in the next election.

Swahili: Kabla ya hafla hiyo, maoni anuwai yalitolewa na wananchi pamoja na viongozi kuhusu hatua zilizochukuliwa kwa raia.
English: Prior to the event, various comments were made by citizens and officials about the measures taken for the citizens.

Swahili: Baadhi ya wananchi waliozungumza katika kaunti ya Meru wamesema kuwaingekuwa vyema cheo hicho kikipewa viongozi wengine waliochaguliwa na wananchi.
English: Some citizens speaking in Meru County have said that it would be good if the position was given to other elected officials.

Swahili: Baadhi yao waliwapendelea mbunge wa Gatundu kusini Moses Kuria na aliyekuwa gavana wa kitambo wa Kiambu William Kabogo kupewa cheo hicho.
English: Some favored the appointment of South Gatundu MP Moses Kuria and former Provisional Governor of Kiambu William Kabogo.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo kundi la viongozi wanaomuunga mkono rais Uhuru Kenyatta wamesema kuwa  rais ndiye atabakia kuwa msemaji wa jamii yao.
English: Meanwhile, a group of leaders supporting President Uhuru Kenyatta have said that the president will remain the spokesman for their community.

Swahili: Chaguzi ndogo inatarajiwa kufanywa ya useneta katika kaunti ya Machakoa.
English: Small selections are expected to be made of senators in Machakoa county.

Swahili: Sheria imetolewa kuatia mbaroni wanasiasa ambao wanapanga kuleta vurugu wakati wa uchaguzi.
English: The law has been passed to punish politicians who plan to cause violence during elections.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa watafanya uchunguzi pamoja na kiomgozi wa mashtaka kutafuta uhusiano wowote kuwanasa wale walioharibu vifaa vya kupigia kura.
English: He said they would investigate with prosecutors looking for any connection to arrest those who destroyed voting equipment.

Swahili: Ameeleza kuwa watu kama hao lazima wafikishwe mahakamani ili kujibu maswali yao yote, ameendelea kusema kuwa hadi kufikia sasa maafisa wanaendelea kumzuia Echesa kwa kosa linalomhusisha na kumpiga afisa wa polisi.
English: He explained that such people must be brought to court to answer all their questions, adding that officials are still holding Echesa for a crime involving him beating a police officer.

Swahili: Jaji mkuu mshikilizi Philomena Mwilu amesema kuwa wanahitaji pesa zaidi kujenga korti ya Kericho oamoja na korti zingine humu nchini.
English: Chief Justice Philomena Mwilu has said that they need more money to build the courthouse in Kericho and other courts in the country.

Swahili: Mwilu alisema kuwa tayari wameanza majadiliano na kamati ya bunge kuona kwamba wataongezwa pesa ili kuendesha shughuli za tume hiyo.
English: The minister said they had already started discussions with the parliamentary committee to see if they would get more money to run the commission.

Swahili: Wizara ya ujenzi humu nchini ilifanya utafiti kuhusiana na jengo hilo miezi miwili iliyopita na kuwashauri wafanyikazi kuhamia hadi eneo la ukusanyaji ushuru katika kaunti hiyo.
English: The construction ministry here in the country conducted a study on the building two months ago and advised workers to move to the tax collection area in the county.

Swahili: Mwenyekiti wa tume ya utangamano na amani nchini NCIC Samuel Kobia amesema kuwa wamechukua hatua hiyo kutokanana maneno hayo.
English: The chairman of the NCIC's Cohesion and Peace Commission, Samuel Kobia, said they had taken the step to address the issue.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Kobia aliihimiza wizara ya usalama kutopeana karatasi hizo.
English: Mr. Kobia urged the security ministry not to hand over the papers.

Swahili: Mpango huo ambao unalenga hesabu hiyo utaendeshwa na wizara ya afya, uongozi wa kaunti ya Nairobi kambi ya kutengeneza vileo almaarufu Kenya Breweries pamoja na tume ya AMREF
English: The programme, which aims to address the county's health crisis, will be run by the health ministry, the Nairobi county's headquarters, Kenya Breweries and the AMREF commission.

Swahili: Hatua hiyo ilichukuliwa baada ya asilimia thelathini ya sehemu za vileo/baa ambazo ziliwaajiri watu kazi humu nchini kushuka chini.
English: The move came after 30% of the alcohol/bar sector that employed people in this country fell.

Swahili: Hata hivyo alieleza kuwa wamefika kwenye sehemu za vileo elfu mbili mia mbili sabini na tatu na kuwapa mafunzo watu elfu tatu mia nane.
English: However, he explained that they had reached the two thousand two hundred and seventy-three beverage areas and trained three thousand eight hundred people.

Swahili: Viongozi wa KAYA katika eneo la mwambao wa pwani wamewahimiza viongozi katika eneo hilo kufanya kazi pamoja.
English: KAYA leaders in the coastal area have urged local leaders to work together.

Swahili: Viongozi hao wa KAYA wamesema kuwa wakifanya kazi pamoja wananchi kutoka eneo hilo la pwani watapata maendeleo.
English: The KAYA leaders have said that if the coastal community works together, they will make progress.

Swahili: Kiongozi wa wengi bungeni Amos Kinyua amewahimiza vijana na kinadada kuchukua mkopo kutoka kwa hazina ya mkopo
English: The majority leader Amos Kinyua has urged young and conservative people to borrow from the credit union

Swahili: Wazee hao wa KAYA wamezitaka jamii zote za eneo hilo kuishi pamoja.
English: These KAYA elders wanted all the communities of the area to live together.

Swahili: Kiongozi wa chama cha KANU leo hii ataenda kuipigia debe vuguvugu la BBI katika eneo la Pokot Magharibi.
English: The leader of the KANU party will today go to the BBI's hot pot in the West Pokot region.

Swahili: Moi atafanya hivyo katika hafla ya kuwachangia pesa makundi ya kina mama katika eneo hilo,hafla hiyo inatarajiwa kuhudhuriwa na gavana wa kaunti hiyo John Lonyangapuo.
English: Moi will do so at a fundraising event for local mother groups, which is expected to be attended by the county governor John Lonyangapuo.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na mwakilishi wadi wa waliowengi katika kauni hiyo, wamewahimiza wananchi kutoka kwa wongi ili kuhudhuria mkutano huo.
English: Led by a representative of the majority in the county, they have urged the citizens from the monastery to attend the meeting.

Swahili: Ozri Kazushio amesema kuwa chama hicho cha KANU kitaendelea kumuunga mkono rais Uhuru Kenyatta.
English: Ozri Kazushio has said that the KANU party will continue to support President Uhuru Kenyatta.

Swahili: Somalia- Idadi ya watu wawili wamepoteza maisha yao katika chumba cha matibabu nchini humo.
English: Somalia- Two people have lost their lives in a medical room in the country.

Swahili: Nibu wa rais William Ruto amefanya mkutano leo na wananchi wa Maili Tisa katika eneo bnge la Igembe ya kati kaunti ya Meru.
English: Vice President William Ruto has held a meeting today with the citizens of Maili Tisa in the central Igembe area of Meru county.

Swahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta ameeleza kuwa ukomeshaji wa ukeketaji wa wasichana utawainua kina dada humu nchini.
English: President Uhuru Kenyatta has said that ending the cutting of girls will lift up the status of sisters in this country.

Swahili: Tume ya uchaguzi humu nchini imewaonya viongozi pamoja na wananchi wakati huu wanapoelekea kufanya uchaguzi mdogo wa useneta katika kaunti ya Machakos.
English: The Election Commission has warned the leaders and citizens as they head towards a small Senate election in Machakos county.

Swahili: Wanasiasa wamehimizwa kumpa rais muda wa kuendeleza maendeleo.
English: Politicians have been encouraged to give the president time to advance progress.

Swahili: Malalamishi yametolewa kuwa kuna baadhi ya wakuu serikalini wanaopanga jinsi ya kuutwaa urais katika uchaguzi ujao.
English: Complaints have been made that some government officials are planning to take over the presidency in the next election.

Swahili: Kiongozi wa chama cha KANU Gideon Moi ameeleza kuwa uwepo siasa nyingi inaweza kumzuia rais kufikisha ndoto yake ya maendeleo kwa wananchi.
English: KANU party leader Gideon Moi has said that a political presence can prevent the president from communicating his dream of development to the citizens.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo la Pokot Moi alisema kuwa uchaguzi wa 2022 ni mbali hivyo basi haifai kuzuia maendeleo.
English: Speaking in the Pokot Moi area, he said that the 2022 election is so far away that it should not impede progress.

Swahili: Alitumia mkutano huo kuipigia debe BBI
English: He used the meeting to beat the BBI

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Orengo amesema kuwa atawataja hadharani viongozi hao iwapo hawatawachana na mambo ya uchaguzi mkuu wa mwaka elfu mbili ishirini na mbili.
English: Mr Orengo has said he will publicly mention the leaders if they do not give up on the general election of the year 222.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Orengo amesema kuwa wafanyikazi wa serikali hawafai kuingilia na mambo ya siasa
English: Mr. Orengo said that government employees should not interfere in political matters

Swahili: Alizungumza alipokuwa akitalii nchi ya Iraqi alikoenda katika vijiji vya Shia na Sunn ambao wengi wa ni waislamu.
English: He spoke while visiting Iraq where he visited Shia and Sunni villages, most of whom are Muslim.

Swahili: Ameziomba nchi zilizo na dini anuwai kuwakaribisha wakristo bila ubaguzi na kutowahusisha na uhalifu kama wanavyofanya nchi zingine.
English: He has called on countries with a wide variety of religions to welcome Christians without discrimination and not to involve them in crime as they do in other countries.

Swahili: Mkurugenzi katika wizara ya matibabu humu nchini DKT.  Patrick Amoth amesema kuwa waliopewa chanjo walitia sahihi yao  kwenye karatasi ya kuonyesha ukubalifu wao katika kupokea chanjo.
English: Director of the medical department here at DKT Patrick Amoth said that the vaccinated signed their approval to receive the vaccine.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo, Dkt.  Amoth alisema kuwa waliokubali ndio wanapewa chanjo hiyo huku akisisitiza kuwa madaktari katika dini ka katoliki waliokataa chanjo hiyo wana uhuru wa kufanya hivyo.
English: Meanwhile, Dr. Amoth said that those who accepted the vaccine were given the vaccine, insisting that doctors in the Catholic faith who refused the vaccine were free to do so.

Swahili: Hata hivyo, amawaomba wakenya kukubali kuchanjwa baada ya kundi la kwanza kukamilisha chanjo.
English: However, he asks the Kenyan authorities to accept the injection after the first group has completed the vaccination.

Swahili: Chanjo za kaunti sita katika mkoa wa Nyanza zilishafikishwa mjini Kisumu.
English: Vaccines from six counties in Nyanza region were delivered to Kisumu.

Swahili: Kaunti ya Kisumu Kisumu itapata chanjo elfu kumi na tano, Kaunti ya Homabay itapata chanjo elfu tisa, Kisii itapokea chanjo tisa, Migori itapokea elfu tisa, Nyamira na Siaya  zitapokea chanjo elfu sita mtawalia.
English: Kisumu County will receive 15,000 vaccines, Homabay County will receive 9,000, Kisii will receive 9, Migori will receive 9,000, Nyamira and Siaya will receive 6,000 vaccines.

Swahili: Watu watatu wameangamia kutokana na ugonjwa huo katika masaa ishirini na nne yaliyopita, inayoongeza idadi jumla ya waliofariki kutokana na virusi v
English: Three people have died from the disease in the past 24 hours, increasing the total number of deaths from the virus V

Swahili: Maafisa wa polisi mjini Kisumu wanaendelea kufanya uchunguzi kutokana na kisa ambacho mtu mmoja alimnyang`anganya polisi bunduki.
English: Police in Kisumu are still investigating the incident where a man stole a gun from the police.

Swahili: Kabla ya kuanza kuwafyatulia wananchi risasi katika kituo hicho cha kuabiri gari, bunduki ambayo alichukua kwa afisa wa trafiki.
English: Before he started shooting civilians at the drive-by, he took a gun from a traffic officer.

Swahili: Hata hivyo wananchi wakisaidiana na polisi walimkamata na kumpiga hadi kufa.
English: However, with the help of the citizens and the police, he was arrested and beaten to death.

Swahili: Wanasiasa humu nchini wameonywa vikali dhidi ya kueneza siasa za chuki hii ni baada ya uchaguzi mdogo uliofanywa siku ya Alhamisi uliosheheni mvutano.
English: Politicians in this country have been warned against spreading hate politics only after a small election on Thursday that sparked tensions.

Swahili: Gavana wa Machakos Alfred Mutua ameeleza kuwa hakuna maendeleo yatakayokuwa humu nchini iwapo wanasiasa hawatawacha siasa za chuki na kugawanya wananchi.
English: Machakos Governor Alfred Mutua has said that no progress will be made in this country unless politicians abandon the politics of hatred and divide the citizens.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo la Tharaka Nithi Mutua alisema kuwa ni yeye tu aliye na uwezo wa kulainisha nchi ya Kenya na kuwaomba wananchi kumuunga mkono katika azma yake ya kuwa rais.
English: Speaking in Tharaka, Nithi Mutua said he was the only one who could soften Kenya and ask the people to support him in his ambition to become president.

Swahili: Jela humu nchini imeanzisha miradi ya kuwafunza kinadada kazi za mikono ambazo zitawasaidia katika siku za usoni baada ya kuwachiliwa huru.
English: The prison in this country has started training the cadets in manual labor that will help them in the future after they are released.

Swahili: Maneno hayo yameungwa mkono na kiongozi wa mashtaka mjini Busia akisema kuwa wananchi wanafaa kuwakaribisha wafungwa ambao wamewachiliwa baada ya kumaliza fungo.
English: The statement was supported by a prosecutor in Busia who said that citizens should welcome prisoners who have been released after the fast.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kaunti ya Meru alikofanya ziara ya siku tatu iliyoisha leo Ruto alisema kuwa viongozi wanaokwenda kinyume naye si wa kutegemewa.
English: Speaking in the Meru district where he made a three-day visit that ended today, Ruto said that leaders who go against him are not reliable.

Swahili: Ruto alisema kuwa viongozi hao wanamsubiri Rais Uhuru kuwaunga mkono ilhali hakuna kazi waliyofanyia wananchi.
English: Ruto said the leaders are waiting for President Uhuru to support them while they have done no work for the citizens.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo seneta wa Meru Mithika Linturi amesema kuwa BBI ingewafaa zaidi wananchi wakati huu wananchi wanapopitia changamoto.
English: Meanwhile, Meru senator Mithika Linturi said that BBI would be more beneficial to the citizens at this time when citizens are facing challenges.

Swahili: Waziri wa usalama amesikitishwa zaidi na wanasiasa kutokana na vurugu vilivyotokea katika wiki hii ambayo inaisha.
English: The minister of security has been more upset by politicians over the violence that has taken place this week.

Swahili: Waziri wa usalama Dkt.  Matiang'I alisema kuwa uamuzi uliotolewa na chama cha ODM ya kubadilisha mpeperushaji wa bendera wa chama hicho kama Raila Odinga ulitokea dakika ya mwisho
English: Minister of Security Dr. Matiang'i said that the decision made by the ODM party to change the party's flag bearer like Raila Odinga came at the last minute

Swahili: Mkutano huo uliofayika kwa mbunge wa Mathare Anthony Oluoch sasa lazima uchukuliwea na uzito.
English: The meeting, which was arranged for Mathare MP Anthony Oluoch, must now be taken seriously.

Swahili: Matiang`I anasema kuwa mkutano huo hauonyeshi kuwa makubaliano baina ya Raila na Uhuru umeambulia patupu.
English: Matiang`I says the meeting does not show that the agreement between Raila and Independence has been unsuccessful.

Swahili: Anapinga uvumi ambao unaendelea nchini kwamba Uhuru Kenyatta lazima amuunge mkono Raila Odinga.
English: He opposes the rumors that Uhuru Kenyatta must support Raila Odinga.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa Mheshimiwa Raila ana mpango wake mwenyewe wa kuwania urais mwakani.
English: He said that Mr Raila has his own plans to run for president this year.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo mbunge wa Makadara ambaye ni mwenyekiti wa ODM Nairobi George Aladwa amesisitiza kuwa Raila Odinha ndiye atapeperusha bendera ya ODM.
English: Meanwhile, MK Madara who is the chairman of ODM Nairobi George Aladwa has insisted that Raila Odinha will fly the ODM flag.

Swahili: Amemwambia gavana wa Mombasa Ali Hassan Joho pamoja na gavana wa Kakamega Wycliff Oparanya watulize azma yao ya kuwania urais.
English: He has asked the governor of Mombasa, Ali Hassan Joho, and Kakamega governor Wycliff Oparanya to cancel their presidential bid.

Swahili: Seneta wa Murang`a Irungu Kangata amesema kuwa makubaliano ya siasa baina ya Uhuru na Raila ni kama inakamilika.
English: Murang`a Senator Irungu Kangata has said that the political agreement between Independence and Raila is almost complete.

Swahili: Akizungumza kutoka eneo la Kiharu alikohudhuria hafla ya maombi amesema baadhi ya wanasiasa kutoka eneo la kati waliopinga makubaliano hayo walinyang`anywa nyadhifa zao serikalini.
English: Speaking from the Kiharu area during a prayer ceremony, he said some politicians from the central region who opposed the agreement were stripped of their positions in the government.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa Kenyatta anaweza kuwa na imani na naibu wake ambaye amekuwa naye kwa tangu uchaguzi wa elfu mbili na mbili.
English: He said Kenyatta can have faith in his deputy who has been with him since the election of 2000 years ago.

Swahili: Amemrai Kenyatta kumuunga mkono naibu wake kwani ako katika nafasi nzuri ya kuutwaa uongozi wa nchi hii.
English: He urged Kenyatta to support his deputy as he is in a good position to take over the leadership of this country.

Swahili: Ameeleza ya kuwa licha ya hayo yote wanamheshimu rais Uhuru Kenyatta.
English: He explained that despite all this they respect President Uhuru Kenyatta.

Swahili: Kangata alisema hayo siku moja baada ya seneta wa Siaya James Orengo kusema kuwa kuna baadhi ya wakuu serikalini ambao wanapanga kuwazuia wengine kuutwaa uongozi humu nchini.
English: Kangata said this a day after Siaya senator James Orengo said that there are some government officials who plan to prevent others from taking over the country.

Swahili: Hii inafanyika baada ya vuguvugu la Tanga Tanga linalomuunga mkono William Ruto wakiongozwa na Caleb Kositany kuwaambia wenzao wa ODM kutafuta namna ya kutatua migogoro baina ya pande hizo mbili.
English: This comes after the Tanga Tanga movement, led by Caleb Kositany, told fellow ODMs to find a way to resolve the conflicts between the two sides.

Swahili: Caleb Kositany amewaambia viongozi wa ODM na wale Jubilee kutoleta vurugu humu nchini.
English: Caleb Kositany has told the leaders of the ODM and the Jubilee parties not to bring violence to this country.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kanisa la AIC kule Eldoret Kositany alieleza kusikitishwa kwake na matamshi ya baadhi ya viongozi wa ODM anaosema wanataka kuirudisha Kenya nyuma.
English: Speaking at the AIC church in Eldoret Kositany expressed his regret over the remarks of some ODM leaders who say they want to bring Kenya back.

Swahili: Seneta Moi ambaye ni mwenyekiti wa chama cha KANU alihudhuria mkutano huo pamoja na gavana wa Kiambu Nyoro akiandamana na wabunge kadhaa wanaounga mkono BBI.
English: Sen. Moi, who is the chairman of the KANU party, attended the meeting along with Kiambu Nyoro governor and several BBI-backed lawmakers.

Swahili: Mchana wa leo Seneta Moi alihudhuria hafla ya maombi katika kanisa la Presbyterian mjini Githunguri.
English: This afternoon Senator Moi attended a prayer ceremony in the Presbyterian church in Githunguri.

Swahili: Seneta Moi aliwakashifu baadhi ya viongozi serikalini ambao wanaendelea kuipinga serikali ya rais Kenyatta na kuenda kinyume na madai yake.
English: Senator Moi denounced some government leaders who continue to oppose the government of President Kenyatta and go against his claims.

Swahili: Moi alisema kuwa viongozi hao wanaizuia serikali kufikisha malengo yake kwa wananchi uchaguzi wa mwaka elfu mbili ishirini na mbili inapokaribia.
English: Moi said that these leaders are preventing the government from delivering its targets to citizens as the election of the year 222 draws near.

Swahili: Moi aliwasihi wananchi wa huko kuiunga mkono BBI katika kura ya maoni itakapoandaliwa.
English: Moi urged the local population to support BBI in the referendum.

Swahili: Mbunge wa Tiaty William Kamket ameendelea kueleza  umuhimu wa chama cha KANU.
English: Tiaty MP William Kamket has continued to highlight the importance of the KANU party.

Swahili: Moi alisema kuwa hata rais Uhuru Kenyatta ataungana na yeye.
English: Moi said that even President Uhuru Kenyatta would join him.

Swahili: Moi aliwakashifu baadhi ya viongozi wa Jubilee ambao hadi kufikia sasa wameanza kampeini za 2022 badala ya kuwafanyia wananchi kazi.
English: Moi criticized some of the Jubilee leaders who have so far launched 2022 campaigns instead of working for the citizens.

Swahili: Echesa akizungumza na chombo kimoja cha habari humu nchini kutoka Gigiri alikofungewa, amesema kuwa masaibu yote yanayomwandama ni kutokana na uchaguzi uliofanywa katika eneo bunge la Matungu.
English: Echesa, speaking to a news outlet in the country from Gigiri where he was detained, said that all the hardships he is facing are due to the elections held in the Matungu parliamentary area.

Swahili: Echesa alisema kuwa kanda ya video iliyomnasa akimzaba afisa wa polisi kofi ni ghushi na ina nia tu yakumwonyesha kama mtu anayependa vurugu.
English: Echesa said the video caught raping a police officer was disgusting and was intended to portray him as a violent person.

Swahili: Echesa alisema kuwa kutiwa kwake kwenye seli haitamtia woga wowote uchaguzi mkuu unapokaribia.
English: Echesa said that his being put in a cell would not cause him any fear as the general election approaches.

Swahili: Aliendelea kusema kuwa kuna baadhi ya viongozi kama seneta wa Kakamega waliofanya maovu zaidi lakini hawajashikwa na anabaki kushangaa mbona ni yeye tu aliyetiwa ndani.
English: He went on to say that there are some leaders like the Kakamega senator who have done worse but have not been caught and he remains surprised why he is the only one involved.

Swahili: Ameshangazwa zaidi na kudorora kwa hali ya usalama.
English: He is even more surprised by the security situation.

Swahili: Naibu gavana wa Migori Muita Mahanga ametishia kuigura chama cha ODM pamoja na jamii ya Kuria kabla ya uchaguzi mkuu wa 2022.
English: Deputy governor Muita Mahanga has threatened to buy the ODM party and the Kuria community before the 2022 general election.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika vijiji vya Kuria Muita alisema kuwa hakuna faida zozote ambazo jamii ya Kuria itapata katika BBI ambayo iapigiwa upato na baadhi ya viongozi wa ODM.
English: Speaking in Kuria Muita villages, he said that there is no benefit to Kuria community from the BBI that is being profited by some of the ODM leaders.

Swahili: Muita alisema kuwa pendekezo lao la kuundiwa kaonti yao ya Kuria ilitupiliwa mbali,ametishia kuanza kampeini kuwasihi jamii ya Kuria kuipinga BBI katika kura ya maoni ijayo.
English: Muita said that their proposal to form their own county of Kuria was rejected, threatening to start a campaign to urge the Kuria community to oppose BBI in the next referendum.

Swahili: Muita alisema kuwa hata pendekezo lao la kuongezwa eneo bunge pia liliambulia patupu.
English: The speaker said that even their proposal for an extension of parliamentary area was also unsuccessful.

Swahili: Ameiambia jamii ya Kuria kumuunga mkono naibu wa rais William Ruto.
English: He has told the Kuria community to support Vice President William Ruto.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo ameonyesha kusikitishws ns bssdhi ys viongozi wanaojificha katika dini huku wakifanya mauaji ya wenzao.
English: At the same time he has expressed his regret over the leaders who hide in religion while committing the murders of their fellow citizens.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kaunti ya Meru Ruto alisema kuwa alimsaidia rais Uhuru kuutwaa uongozi humu nchini hivyo basi anafaa kumuunga mkono kuiongoza nchi hii.
English: Speaking in Meru Ruto district, he said he helped President Uhuru take over the country and therefore he should support him in running this country.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Ruto alisema ana nia ya kuwaletea wananchi maendeleo na kuwakashifu wale ambao wanaongozwa na maslahi yao tu.
English: Mr. Ruto said he intends to bring about progress for the citizens and condemn those who are guided only by their interests.

Swahili: Viongozi walioandamana naye waliipinga BBI wakisema wananchi wamelazimishwa nayo.
English: Leaders who accompanied him opposed the BBI, saying the citizens were forced by it.

Swahili: Vijana wa kurandaranda mtaani wasiopungua mia mbili katika eneo la Kisumu walipewa vyakula.
English: No less than two hundred street gangs in the Kisumu area were given food.

Swahili: Vijana hao wa kurandaranda mitaani pia walipewa blanketi na shirika la Patrice Carter lenye makao yake nchini Marekani.
English: The streetwalkers also received blankets from Patrice Carter, a U.S.-based organization.

Swahili: Anne Oguta ambaye ndiye aliongoza shughuli hiyo mjini Kisumu alisema kuwa waliwapa vitu hivyo kutokana na dhiki ambazo vijana hao hupitia.
English: Anne Oguta, who led the event in Kisumu, said that they gave the items to the youths because of the hardships they are going through.

Swahili: Amewarai wahisani kujitokeza ili kusaidia familia hizo za vijana wa kuranda mitaani.
English: He has called on charities to come forward to help these families of street-walking youths.

Swahili: Akizungumza Taifa Park katika mji wa Kisumu Anne Oguta mahali ambapo ugavi wa blanketi na chakula ulikuwa ukifanywa Anne alisema kuwa baadhi ya vijana hao wanahimili baridi kali wanakolala.
English: Speaking at the National Park in Kisumu town where blankets and food were being supplied, Anne Oguta said that some of the youngsters are coping with the cold in their beds.

Swahili: Alieleza kuwa usaidizi zaidi unahitajika kwa vijana hao.
English: He explained that more help was needed for the young people.

Swahili: Vijana hao waliopata misaada hiyo walionyesha furaha nyusoni mwao.
English: The young ones who received such assistance showed joy in their faces.

Swahili: Ajuza mmoja mwenye umri wa miaka sitini na tano anaishi na maumivu baada ya tingatinga iliyokuwa ikitengeneza barabara kugonga pikipiki iliyombeba katika kijiji cha Kanyandiga kata ndogo ya Kojwach, Rachuonyo Mashariki.
English: Ajuza, a 65-year-old man, is living with pain after a road-breaking tornado hit a motorcycle in the village of Kanyandiga in Kojwach district, Rachuonyo East.

Swahili: Amewaomba viongozi wa huko pamoja na wahisani kumsaidia ajuza huyo ambaye kwa sasa yu hali maututi.
English: He has asked local leaders and philanthropists to help him find out who is currently in a coma.

Swahili: Phillip Osewe ameahidi kuinua maslahi ya wanawake pamoja na vijana iwapo atachaguliwa kama gavana wa Homabay katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao.
English: Phillip Osewe has promised to raise the interest of women and youth if he is elected as the governor of Homabay in the next general election.

Swahili: Rais wa Paraguay amewarai mawaziri wote kujiuzulu.
English: The President of Paraguay has asked all ministers to resign.

Swahili: Hii ni baada ya wananchi wa taifa hilo kuandaa mgomo wakikashifu jinsi taifa hilo linavyopambana na ugonjwa wa korona.
English: This is after the nation's citizens went on strike to criticize the country's fight against the coronavirus.

Swahili: Rais Mario Abdo Benitez amesema kuwa atachagua kamiti ya mawaziri ambao watatimiza matakwa ya wananchi.
English: President Mario Abdo Benitez has said he will elect a cabinet committee that will meet the aspirations of the citizens.

Swahili: Katika hospitali za huko ni wananchi wachache sana ndio wamepata chanjo dhidi ya korona
English: In local hospitals, very few citizens have received a coronavirus vaccine

Swahili: Viongozi wa upinzani wanamtaka rais Abdo Benitez kujiuzulu kama rais.
English: Opposition leaders are demanding President Abdo Benitez resign as president.

Swahili: Viongozi hao wa upinzani wanaihusisha serikali ya Abdo na masuala ya ufisadi.
English: The opposition leaders have linked the Abdo government to corruption.

Swahili: Gavana wa Machakos Alfred Mutua ameeleza kuwa hakuna maendeleo yatakayokuwa humu nchini iwapo wanasiasa hawatawacha siasa za chuki na kugawanya wananchi.
English: Machakos Governor Alfred Mutua has said that no progress will be made in this country unless politicians abandon the politics of hatred and divide the citizens.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi Mutua alisema kuwa ni yeye aliye na uwezo wa kuiongoza vyema taifa hili.
English: Speaking in Tharaka county, Nithi Mutua said he was the one who could lead this nation well.

Swahili: Amewaomba wananchi kumpa kura katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao akiwania urais.
English: He has asked the citizens to vote for him in the next general election as a presidential candidate.

Swahili: Bodi ya magereza imemleta afisa mpya kuiongoza kaunti ya Busia.
English: The prison board has appointed a new official to run the county of Busia.

Swahili: Kiongozi wa mashtaka katika korti ya Busia Lucy Ambasi amesema kuwa wananchi wanafaa kuwakaribisha wafungwa ambao wameachiliwa huru.
English: Prosecutor Lucy Ambasi of the Busia court said that citizens should welcome the released prisoners.

Swahili: Mshukiwa mmoja kule Migori mwenye umri wa miaka arubaini Suna Magharibi anatafutwa na maafisa wa polisi baada ya kuiteketeza nyumba aliyokuwa bakiishi pamoja na mpenzi wake wa miaka thelathini.
English: A 40-year-old suspect in Migori, West Suna, is wanted by police after burning down the house he lived in with his 30-year-old girlfriend.

Swahili: Mshukiwa huyo aliichoma chumba hicho cha kukodisha  katika kijiji cha Oruba.
English: The suspect burned down the rental room in the village of Oruba.

Swahili: Naibu wa chifu katika eneo hilo amesema kuwa Duncan Okinyi alichoma nyumba hiyo jioni ya jana wakati ambapo mpenziwe hakuwa na chumba hicho kuchomeka na kila kitu.
English: A deputy chief in the area said that Duncan Okinyi burned the house last night when the victim was not in the room and everything burned.

Swahili: Uchunguzi zaidi unaendelea kuhusiana na kisa hicho.
English: Further investigation is underway.

Swahili: Serikali imeambiwa kutoa jina la kampuni ya sukari ya Sony kwa majina ya kampuni ambayo serikali ina nia ya kuwiwreka katika umiliki wa kibinafsi.
English: The government has been told to name Sony's sugar company after the names of companies that the government intends to sell into private ownership.

Swahili: Mbunge wa Awendo Walter Owino Sirawa amesema kuwa kampuni hiyo inahitaji tu usaidizi wa kifedha ili ianze rasmi kusaga miwa.
English: Awendo MP Walter Owino Sirawa said the company only needs financial support to officially start the palm mill.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo la Awendo  Mheshimiwa Owino alisema kuuza kampuni za serikali si jambo rahisi.
English: Speaking in Awendo area Mr Owino said selling state-owned companies is not an easy thing.

Swahili: Amewaeleza wanasiasa kutoka Mihori kutoweka siasa katika masuala ya kambi hiyo.
English: He has told Mihori politicians to disappear from the camp's affairs.

Swahili: Ameahidi kuinua maslahi ya vijana na kina mama iwapo atachaguliwa kama gavana wa kaunti ya Homabay.
English: He has promised to raise the interest of young people and mothers if he is elected governor of Homabay county.

Swahili: Bajeti hiyo ilipata uungwaji mkono kule seneti licha ya kuwa wabunge wa Republican waliipinga.
English: The budget won support in the Senate despite opposition from Republicans.

Swahili: Jumanne wiki ijayo wabunge wa Democrats ambayo inamuunga mkono rais Biden wanatarajiwa kuipitisha bajeti hiyo
English: Next Tuesday, Democrats who support President Biden are expected to pass the budget.

Swahili: Rais Biden amesema hatua ya kuiunga mkono bajeti hiyo katika seneti ni mwanzo wa kuanza kipiga vita ugonjwa wa korona ambao kufikia sasa imewaua watu elfu mia tano ishirini na tatu.
English: President Biden has said the Senate's vote to support the budget is the beginning of a new battle against the coronavirus pandemic that has killed 5,233,000 people so far.

Swahili: Rashid Echesa ametiwa mbaroni tena.
English: Rashid Echesa has been arrested again.

Swahili: Mkewe rais Bi.  Margaret ameeleza kuweka bidii zaidi kuhakikisha kuwa wananchi zaidi wanachaguliwa katika uchaguzi mkuu ujao wa 2022, amewapongeza wanawake asilimia ishirini na tatu ambaoni wabunge waliochaguliwa.
English: His wife, Mrs Margaret, has expressed her commitment to ensuring that more citizens are elected in the next general election in 2022, and has praised 23 percent of women in parliament.

Swahili: Bi Kenyatta alisema kuwa kina mama wanaweza kuleta maendeleo humu nchini iwapo watachaguliwa.
English: Ms Kenyatta said that if they are elected, they can make progress in this country.

Swahili: Akizungumza kupitia mtandaoni katika siku ya kuadhimisha siku ya wanawake duniani katika sherehe ambayo lengo lake ni kuongeza idadi ya wanawake wakati huu wa ugonjwa wa korona.
English: Speaking online on the occasion of the International Women's Day celebration in a celebration that aims to increase the number of women during this pandemic.

Swahili: Bi Kenyatta amewarai kina dada kutokimya wakati wa kupigania haki zao akisema kuwa fedha tayari zimetengwa kuendesha shughuli hiyo.
English: Ms Kenyatta has expressed her concern over the sisters' silence in their fight for their rights, saying that funds have already been allocated to run the operation.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa uchaguzi wa mwanamke wa kwanza kama naibu wa rais nchini Marekani inaonyesha kuwa kina dada wana uwezo na hivyo basi wanafaa kutumia nafasi zao kuboresha maisha ya wananchi.
English: She said that the election of the first woman as vice president of the United States shows that the sisters are capable and therefore should use their opportunities to improve the lives of citizens.

Swahili: Kwa upande wake waziri wa jinsia Maegaret Kobia amesema kuwa licha ya pandashuka za hapa mna pale hatua hiyo imezaa matunda.
English: For her part, gender minister Maegaret Kobia said that despite the local pandemic, the move has paid off.

Swahili: Katibu mkuu wa afya Susan Mwachache ameendelea kuwarai wananchi kuzidi kufuata sheria za korona kwa kuwa ugonjwa huo bado upo.
English: Health Secretary General Susan Mwachache has continued to urge citizens to follow the coronavirus rules as the disease persists.

Swahili: Serikali imeiomba mahakama ya Kiambu kumzuia aliyekuwa waziri wa michezo Rashid Echesa kwa siku saba ili ifanye uchunguzi zaidi.
English: The government has asked Kiambu court to suspend former sports minister Rashid Echesa for seven days to investigate further.

Swahili: Patricia Gichoni ambaye ni kiongizi wa mashtaka  ndiye alitoa sheria hiyo.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa polisi wa Gigiri wanafaa kuendelea kumzuia Echesa hadi kesho saa tano.
English: He said that Gigiri police should continue to detain Echesa until tomorrow at five o'clock.

Swahili: Echesa anahusishwa na shtaka la kumzaba kofi afisa wa tume ya uchaguzi katika eneo bunge la Matungu shtaka ambalo alikanusha.
English: Echesa is linked to the allegation of beating up an election commission official in the Matungu parliamentary district.

Swahili: Wakili wa Echesa ambaye ni Cliff Ombeta ameikashifu serikali kwa kutaka Echesa aendelee kuzuiwa.
English: Echesa's lawyer Cliff Ombeta has criticized the government for demanding Echesa continue to be blocked.

Swahili: Ombeta ameiambia mahakama hiyo kuwa hakuna haja ya kuendelea kumzuilia Echesa kwani alijisalimisha kwa maafisa wa polisi mwenyewe jambo linaloonyesha kuwa Echesa anatii sheria.
English: Ombeta has told the court that there is no need to continue detaining Echesa as he has surrendered himself to police officers himself, which shows that Echesa is complying with the law.

Swahili: Ameiomba mahakama hiyo kumwachilia Echesa kwa dhamana baada ya kukanuha mashtaka hayo.
English: He has asked the court to release Echesa on bail after denying the charges.

Swahili: Hii inafanyika wakati ambapo mbunge wa Mugirango Sylvanus Osoro amewachilia kwa dhamana ya shilingi elfu hamsini au pesa taslimu elfu mia moja.

Swahili: Kutokana na kesi inayomhusisha na uharibifu wa mali pamoja na kuwachochea wananchi katika uchaguzi mdogo katika wadi ya Kiamokama.
English: Due to a case involving property damage as well as inciting citizens in a by-election in the Jamokama ward.

Swahili: Mali isiyopungua thamani ya milioni mbili nukta sita iliharibika katika wadi ya Matingu
English: At least two million items of property were damaged in the Clouds ward

English: Led by MP Mathira Gachagua and MP Kiharu Ndidi Nyoro have said Odinga is known for destroying political parties

Swahili: Viongozi wameendelea kusema kuwa vita vinavyotokea ni kutokana na matumizi yz pesa za kampeni za BBI.
English: Leaders have continued to say that the war is happening because of the BBI's campaign money spending.

English: Speaking last week in Rarieda, the senator from Siaya Orengo said that there are government leaders who are drawing up a plan to prevent some of the leaders from taking over the presidency in the country in the next general election.

Swahili: Kaunti ya Kisumu leo hii imeanzisha rasmi bima ya afya ya Marwa Solidarity.
English: Kisumu County today officially introduced Marwa Solidarity health insurance.

Swahili: Gavana wa Kisumu Profesa Anyang` Nyong`o alisema kuwa bima hiyo inawalenga wananchi wenye mapato ya chini huku akisema sehemu ya bima hiyo watalipiwa kila mwezi
English: The governor of Kisumu, Professor Anyang` Nyong`o, said the insurance is aimed at low-income citizens, saying that part of the insurance will be paid monthly.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa mpango huu itachukua fedha nyingi.
English: He said that this plan would cost a lot of money.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika hafla hiyo gavana wa Nyeri Mutahi Kahiga, alisema kuwa bima hiyo ni muhimu sana na wananchi wanafaa kuikumbatia.
English: Speaking at the event, Nyeri governor Mutahi Kahiga said the insurance is very important and citizens should embrace it.

Swahili: Kahiga alieleza mipango ya magavana ya kuhakikisha wanaboresha afya ya wananchi.
English: Kahiga explained the governors' plans to ensure they improve the health of the citizens.

Swahili: Kwa upande wake Peter Kamunyo ambaye ni mkuu katika bima ya afya ya NHIF ameeleza nia yake ya kufanya kazi pamoja na kaunti ya Kisumu.
English: For his part, Peter Kamunyo, head of NHIF health insurance, has expressed his intention to work with Kisumu County.

Swahili: Mvutano kuhusiana na salamu almaarufu handshake baina ya Uhuru Kenyatta na Raila imesemwa kuwa haina uzito wowote.
English: Tensions over the popular greeting between Uhuru Kenyatta and Raila have been described as unimportant.

Swahili: Koyoo ameeleza kuwa tofauti za kifikra ni jambo la kawaida na hata hutokea katika ndoa na kuwa maneno magumu husuluhishwa watu kwa mazungumzo.
English: Koyoo has explained that differences of opinion are common and even occur in marriage and that difficult words are resolved by conversation.

Swahili: Akizungumza katika eneo bunge la Muhoroni wakati wa kugawa pesa za maendeleo kwa vijana Koyoo amewarai wakenya kuiombea handisheki (salamu hiyo)
English: Speaking in the Muhoroni parliament area during the distribution of development funds to youth Koyoo has warned Kenya to pray for a handisheki (the salute)

Swahili: Amesema kuwa amani inahitajika ili BBI itimize malengo yake.
English: He said that peace is necessary for the BBI to achieve its goals.

English: Vice President William Ruto continues his formal meeting with the citizens in the parliamentary area of the Central Embassy in Nairobi where he officially opened the hotel built by the Theuri MP.

Swahili: Ruto ambaye ndio amewasili katika shule hiyo anatarajiwa kuanzisha shughuli za maendeleo huko.
English: Ruto, who is the newest student at the school, is expected to start development activities there.

English: Orengo, who is a senator from Siaya speaking to Rarieda, said there are serikslini officials who are putting in place a plan to ensure that some politicians will not be allowed to take the presidency.

English: Twenty high-ranking police officers have been promoted to the highest rank in the department.

English: The change in the department was announced by Hillary Mutambai.

English: Wanga wants the commission to tell him his mistakes while saying that the commission wants to bring Kenya back into the colonial era.

English: He said that announcing that the leaders would be brought before the commission would not seek the obvious evidence that some politicians violated election laws while others were innocent.

Swahili: Wanga amesema haya wakati ambapo mbunge wa Kasipul Charles Were alifika mbele ya tume hiyo na kukosa kujibu swali lolote aliloulizwa.
English: Wanga said this when the MP for Kasipul Charles Were came before the commission and did not answer any question asked.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa maneno yaliyofanya aitwe na tume hiyo hayaelewi.
English: He said the words that led to the call of the commission are not understood.

English: The health ministry in this county of the country has officially launched a vaccine program against coronavirus.

English: He said that by 7pm today, about 80 health workers had received the vaccine.

Swahili: Gichui amewaambia wahudumu wa afya kuwa wapuuzilie mbali uvumi unaoenea kuwa chanjo hiyo inasababisha kuganda kwa damu mwilini
English: Gichui has told health officials to ignore the rumors that the vaccine causes blood clots in the body

English: The National Security Committee in parliament has backed the plan of Minister of Security Fred Matiangi to strip the licenses of gun ownership of immoral leaders

English: The committee's chairman Paul Koinange said the plan would help bring peace to the northeastern parts of Kenya.

English: Moreover, Matiangi said that they will go to court to ensure that leaders with such behavior will not be allowed to hold any office in the next government.

English: The chairperson of the union, Ms. Muthoni, said that women should be present to express their views at events such as the BBI report, she continued to urge women to step aside and run for political seats

English: He asked other politicians to include women in various political seats in the 2022 general election

English: The two leaders said strategies had already been put in place to ensure the political agreement between Kenya and the West African nations is followed

Swahili: Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu imekuwa kaunti ya kwanza kutopiga kura kupinga au kuunga mkono vuguvugu la BBI

Swahili: Wawakilishi wadi hao walisema hawaoni haja ya kupinga wala kuunga mkono BBI wakisema kuwa wakenya wataamua wenyewe
English: The representatives of the ward said they did not see the need to oppose or support the BBI saying that Kenyans will decide for themselves

Swahili: Spika wa kaunti hiyo David Kiplagat alisema kuwa wawakilishi hao walifuata sheria zote za kujadili ripoti hiyo ya BBI

Swahili: Wawakilishi wadi hao wameweka historia kutokana na tendo hilo la kutopinga wala kuunga mkono

Swahili: Tume ya uchaguzi humu nchini inapanga kuandaa uchaguzi mdogo katika eneo la Matungu kaunti ya Kakamega

Swahili: Kanisa la Katoliki humu nchini limejitokeza waziwazi kupinga ripoti inayosema wanapinga chanjondhidi ya korona

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na askofu mkuu Anyolo walisema kuwa hatua iliyochukuliwa na madaktari wa kanisa hilo ni lao wenyewe bali siyo la kanisa hilo
English: Led by Archbishop Anyolo, they said that the church doctors' actions were their own, not the church's.

Swahili: Katika ujumbe kwa vyombo vya habari maaskofu hao wamesema sasa inafaaa ibainike wazi kuwa ripoti iliyotolewa na madaktari hao ni lao wenyewe bali si la kanisa hilo
English: In a press release, the bishops said it was now appropriate to make it clear that the report by the doctors was their own, not the church's.

Swahili: Maaskofu hao sasa wamewasihi wakenya kujitokeza kwa wingi ili wapewa chanjo hiyo dhidi ya korona
English: The bishops have now urged Kenya to make a greater appearance to get the corona vaccine

Swahili: Hata hivyo maaskofu hao wamewasihi wahudumu wa afya na serikali kujitokeza wazi na kuwaambia wananchi umuhimu wa chanjo hiyo
English: However, the bishops have urged health officials and the government to stand up and tell the public about the importance of the vaccine.

Swahili: Kamiti ya bunge  na seneti waliopewa jukumu la kuchukua maoni ya wananchi kuhusiana na kubadilishwa kwa sheria kupitia BBI wanakutana siku ya kesho
English: The parliamentary and senate committees tasked with taking citizens' views on the change of laws through the BBI are meeting tomorrow

Swahili: Kamiti hiyo ya usawa na haki inatarajiwa kuanza kuchukua maoni ya wananchi Alhamisi juma hii kuhusu ripoti ya BBI
English: The Equality and Justice Committee is expected to start taking citizens' views on Thursday this week on the BBI report

Swahili: Ripoti hiyo ilitolewa wazi bungeni na mwenyekiti wa kamati hiyo ya usawa na haki  akizungumza na wanahabari mjini Nairobi
English: The report was presented to parliament by the chairman of the equality and justice committee speaking to reporters in Nairobi.

Swahili: Karua amesema kuwa ripoti ya mageuzi ya sheria si sawa
English: Karua said the report on legal reforms is not accurate

Swahili: Karua amesema kuwa wawakilishi wadi waliahidiwa pesa za kununua magari jambo ambalo ni ufisadi mkubwa
English: Karua said that the ward representatives were promised money to buy cars which is a big corruption

Swahili: Karua amekashifu sana mageuzi ya sheria akiema ataipinga mahakamani kwani ni kinyume na sheria za humu nchini
English: Karua has strongly criticized the reform of the law, saying he will oppose it in court because it is against the laws of this country

Swahili: Karua akizungumza kwa niaba ya vuguvugu la Linda Katiba alimkashifu sana Uhuru Kenyatta kwa kuingilia utendakazi wa mahakama baada ya kutupilia mbali uchaguzi wa 2017
English: Karua speaking on behalf of Linda Constitution's warmth, he strongly criticized Uhuru Kenyatta for interfering in the judicial process after she overruled the 2017 election

Swahili: Karua amesema kuwa tatizo kuu humu nchini hutokea uchaguzi unapokaribia kwani wanaomiliki viti vikuu hawataki kung`atuka mamlakani jambo ambalo si sawa
English: Karua said that the main problem in this country is that the elections are coming because the people who hold the seats do not want to leave power which is not right

Swahili: Karua pamoja na David Ndii wamesem kuwa serikali sasa i taabani kutokana na suala la BBI ambalo liliwaahidi wanasiasa vyeo katika uchaguzi wa 2022
English: Karua and David Ndii have said that the government is now in trouble due to the BBI issue that promised politicians positions in the 2022 elections.

Swahili: Kwa  upande wake David Ndii amewasihi wakenya kujitokeza kupinga mageuzi ya sheria jambo ambalo anasema hawatakubali
English: David Ndii has urged Kenyans to stand up against the reform of the law, something he says they will not accept.

Swahili: Mbunge wa Malindi Aisha Jumwa amemkashfu gavana wa Mombasa Hassan Joho akisema Joho anataka abembelezwe na wanaotoka eneo hilo ndiposa wafaulu

Swahili: Kaunti ya Migori ilianza mpango wa kuwapa chanjo wahudumu wa afya katika eneo hilo na kuwaambia wananchi wasubiri kwani hata hao watapewa chanjo

Swahili: Waziri wa afya katika kaunti hiyo Kephas Nyamita alionyesha kufurahishwa kwake akisema kuwa watu kutoka eneo hilo la Migori sasa watapata chanjo hiyo
English: The county's health minister Kephas Nyamita expressed his satisfaction that people from the Migori area will now get the vaccine

Swahili: Akizungumza katika hafla hiyo ya kuanzisha chanjo hiyo rasmi alisema kuwa hadi sasa  wamepata chanjo elfu tisa
English: Speaking at the official launch event, he said that they have received 9,000 vaccines so far.

Swahili: Baada ya kupata chanjo hiyo wamepanga kuipeana kwa maafisa wa afya,walinda usalama pamoja na wale wanaoweza kuenezaa ugonjwa huo kwa haraka
English: After receiving the vaccine, they plan to give it to health officials, to protect the safety of those who can spread the disease quickly.

Swahili: Wakati huo huo Christopher Rusana amekuwa mttu wa kwanza kupata chanjo hoyo Migori huku akiwasihi kuwa wasisikilize porojo kuhusu chanjo hiyo
English: Meanwhile, Christopher Rusana has become the first person to receive a vaccine against Migori while urging them not to listen to gossip about the vaccine.

Swahili: Kaunti hiyo ya Migori inawania kuwapa chanji angalau asilimia thelathini ya watu katika eneo hilo
English: The Migori county is fighting to vaccinate at least 30 percent of the population in the area

Swahili: Wakaazi wa kaunti ya Kisumu wamesifu sana makubaliano yaliyowekwa kati ya Raila Odinga na rais Uhuru Kenyatta huku ikifikia miaka mitatu tangu salamu hiyo
English: Residents of Kisumu County have praised the agreement between Raila Odinga and President Uhuru Kenyatta, which is now three years since the greeting.

Swahili: Wakiongozwa na Askofu Winnie Owiti ambaye ndiye mwenyekiti wa wahubiri hao wa Voice Of Salvation wamesem kuwa usalama pamoja hali ya utulivu ambao umekuwa nchini ni kutokana na makubaliano hayo.
English: Led by Bishop Winnie Owiti who is the chairman of the Voice of Salvation preachers, they have said that the security and stability that the country has experienced is due to this agreement.

Swahili: Amesema kuwa kama wakristo matakwa yao ni kuona kuwa Kenya imekuwa na umoja bila vurugu wakati wa uchaguzi
English: He said that as Christians, their wish is to see Kenya united without violence during the elections.

Swahili: Winnie alizungumza leo katika eneo la Kibos walikotoa misaada ya vyakula kwa jamii ya wanubi wanaoishi kwenye vyandarua
English: Winnie spoke today in the Kibos area who provided food aid to the nuns living in the slums

Swahili: Askofu Owiti alisema kuw wakati huu waakenya wanafaa kuangalia maisha yao pamoja na kudumisha amani
English: Bishop Owiti said there is a time when Kenyans should look at their lives together and maintain peace.

Swahili: Askofu Winnie aliimiminia sifa sana BBI akisema kuwa itaiipa Kenya maendeleo huku akisema dukuduku lake ni kwa wale viongozi wanaoipinga
English: Bishop Winnie praised the BBI for its progress, saying that its support is for the opposition leaders.

Swahili: Mpango wa kuchukua maoni ya wakaazi wa Nyalenda kuhusiana na barua waliomwandikia gavana unaendelea
English: The plan to take the views of the Nyalenda residents regarding their letter to the governor is ongoing

Swahili: Rais Uhuru Kenyatta ametoa ilani kwa wote wanaofanya kazi katika makao yake kupata chanjo ya Astra Zeneca kujikinga dhidi ya korona.
English: President Uhuru Kenyatta has announced that all those working in his residence will get the Astra Zeneca vaccine to protect themselves against the coronavirus.

Swahili: Nzioka Waita amesema kuwa hatua hiyo ni ya kuwapa wakenya motisha wakati huu ambapo chanjo hiyo imeanza kupeanwa huko.
English: Nzioka Waita said the move is to give Kenyans an incentive at a time when the vaccine has been rolled out there.

Swahili: Waita aliweka picha yake katika mtandao wa Twitter alipokuwa akipokea chanjo hiyo
English: Waita posted a photo of herself on Twitter while receiving the vaccine

Swahili: Hii inafanyika baada ya wiki moja tu ya serikali kuleta chanjo hiyo kwa wananchi wa Kenya

English: Karen's mother reported to the police station and when the officers began the search, they found her in a liquor store in Machakos County in Kangundo

Swahili: Mwanamke huyo alikuwa na rafiki yake Muthoni ambaye simu yake ilitumiwa kumpiga picha pamoja na mwanaume fulani ambaye uhusiano wao haujulikani, watatu hao wanazuiliwa ili wasaidie katika uchunguzi zaidi
English: The woman had a friend in the South whose phone was used to take pictures with a man whose relationship is unknown, and the three are detained to assist in further investigation

English: Police say the phone was used to take the photo, and they are now all detained to assist in further investigation

Swahili: Baada ya hiyo mwanamke huyo alituma picha nyingine kwa mamake huku akiwa amefungwa na kamba na kisu kuwekwa karibu na yeye huku akisema pesa taslimu shilingi elfu thelathini inahitajika ili awachwe
English: The woman then sent another photo to her mother, tied to a rope and a knife placed next to her, saying that she needed $30,000 in cash to be released.

Swahili: Katika barabara ya Nyahururu Nyeri watu wawili wamepoteza maisha yao huku wengine wawili wakiuguza majeraha baada ya kupatwa na ajali mbaya ya barabarani
English: On Nyahururu Nyeri road, two people lost their lives while two others were injured after a serious road accident

Swahili: Tukio hili lilitokea baada ya pikipiki moja iliyobeba abiria wanne kugongana ana kwa ana na matatu moja iliyokuwa imetoka Nyeri ikielekea Nyahururu

Swahili: Mamake mtoto huyo aliyeaga anasema kuwa mwanafunzi huyo alikuwa mwenye heshima na mwenye bidii shuleni
English: The mother of the child says that the student was respectful and hardworking at school

English: The KNEC exam board has said that the fourth stage exam currently underway is not without controversy.

Swahili: Hii ni taarifa iliyotolewa na mwenyekiti wa kamati hiyo Profesa John Onsati
English: This is a statement made by the chairman of the committee, Professor John Onsati.

Swahili: Profesa Onsati alisema kuwa wataahiniwa hawafai kuwa na woga wowote kuhusu mtihani huo

Swahili: Nduku Kilonzo ndiye msimamazi mkuu wa bodi ya kutoa na kupataa damu humu nchini

Swahili: Amewaomba wananchi kuendelea kutoa damu ili kunusuru maisha ya wenzao

Swahili: Akizungumza Kayole jijini Nairobi Ruto alisema kuwa wasiofurahishwa na siasa yake ni wale wasiowajali wananchi
English: Speaking to Kayole in Nairobi, Ruto said that those who are unhappy with his politics are those who are indifferent to citizens

Swahili: Aliendelea kuwarai wananchi kuwachagua wananachi kuwachagua kinadada ambao wako tayari kuwafanyia wananchi kazi
English: He went on to urge citizens to choose natives to choose cadets who are willing to work for the citizens.

English: He said that making health insurance mandatory will ensure that citizens do not spend a lot of money on medical care.

English: Dr Oluoch speaking to DALA radio station said the vaccine is valid and citizens should not be worried

Swahili: Amezidi kuwarai wananchi kufuata hatua  zakujikinga dhidi ya korona

English: ODM chairman John Mbadi has said Raila will fly the party's flag for the presidential race

Swahili: Ombi hilo limetolewa na aliyekuwa mbunge wa huko Sylvance Osele.

English: Mr. Obado said that women should not just wait to be elected but should fight for seats elected by men

Swahili: Amesema kuwa wanawake wengi wana uwezo wa kuongoza humu nchini wakipata nafasi
English: She said that many women are capable of leading the country if they get a chance.

Swahili: Alizungumza jana akiwa Migori katika sherehe ya kuadhimisha siku ya wanawake nchini
English: She spoke yesterday at a Migori celebration of the country's Women's Day

English: Oburu Odinga, a member of parliament representing East Africa and his brother Raila, gave the news about Raila's life.

Swahili: Mheshimiwa Oburu alisema wananchi hawafai kuwa na uwoga wowote kwani ni uchovu tu kutokana na ziara ambazo Raila amekuwa nazo
English: Mr. Oburu said the citizens should not be any more timid because they are just tired from the visits Raila has had

Swahili: Wananchi kutoka eneo la Kisumu wamemwombea Raila Odinga uponyaji wa haraka
English: Residents from Kisumu region have prayed for Raila Odinga's immediate recovery

English: The meeting will discuss the challenges facing counties and the obstacles to development in the county.

Swahili: Mkutano huo uliungwa mkono na mwenyekiti wa magavana ambaye ni gavaana wa Embu Martin Wambora.

English: Students at Moi Eldoret University have organized a rally against the delay in funding of HELB

English: The students expressed their regret that some other universities have been given HELB while theirs has not yet arrived

Swahili: Hii inafanyika baada ya kupatikana na kosa la kuleta vurugu pamoja na uharibifu wa mali

English: This is related to his alleged assault of an election commission official at the Buloba polling station.

English: The General Committee on Justice and the Law in the National Parliament and the Senate will meet today to formulate strategies that will be followed in taking citizens' views on BBI

English: The move by Uasin Gishu County ward representatives to not oppose or support BBI was highly criticized by local residents

Swahili: Waakazi hao wa Uasin Gishu wanalalamika kuwa wawakilishi wadi hao walichukua maoni yao na hivyo basi hawakufaa kuongozwa na hisia zao wenyewe
English: The Uasin Gishu residents complain that the ward representatives took their views and therefore were not fit to be guided by their own feelings

Swahili: Wakaazi hao wanasema kuwa maoni yao kuhusu BBI yalichukuliwa wiki jana lakini hakuna hata moja lililojadiliwa wamesema kuwa maoni yao yanajulikana wazi na wanangoja kura ya maoni
English: The residents say their views on BBI were taken last week but none were discussed. They said their views are public and await a vote.

Swahili: Hata hivyo baadhi ya wakaazi wa huko walikubalianaa na wazo hilo wakisema BBI haifai kupewa uzito wowote humu nchini

English: Dr Oluoch said that they are opposed to your BBI and their own interests
