English: People there are now increasingly affected, not only mentally and physically, but even some people are self-loathing when they see their families sweeping the world with every hatred.

Swahili: Tena korona imetuathiri pakubwa mno kwani imetuulia wakulima ambao huleta vyakula ambavyo hutupa viini kama vile vitamini ambavyo huweza kupambana na maradhi.
English: The coronavirus has also had a major impact on us, leaving farmers who bring in food that is free of germs such as resistant vitamins to disease.

Swahili: Imeathiri pia uajiri wa kazi, kazi sasa zimeadimika kama kaburi la buriani kwa sababu watu wengi wamepigwa kalamu na waliobaki, wanalipwa mshahara nusu ama kidogo.
English: It has also affected employment, jobs are now settled like a dead end because many people are penciled and the rest are paid half or less.

Swahili: Katika mwaka wa elfu mbili kumi na tisa, Benki kuu ya Dunia kulikuwa na asilimia sabini na tano ya wakenya walikuwa wamemjiriwa lakini idadi ya waajiriwa lilipungua kuwa asilimia hamsini na sita mwezi wa Aprili mwaka jana.
English: In the year two thousand and nineteen, the World Bank had seventy-five percent of Kenyans employed but the number of employees dropped to fifty-six percent in April last year.

Swahili: Ama kweli, fisi akimla muwele mzima funga mlango.
English: In fact, if a cat eats a whole chicken, close the door.

Swahili: Licha ya korona kutuathiri, ni lazima tutafute namna na njia za kupunguza makali ya korona.
English: Despite the coronavirus affecting us, we must find ways and means to reduce the severity of the coronavirus.

Swahili: Baadhi ya njia hizi ni kukaa mita moja mbali na watu wenye dalili za corona, kuepuka kushika sehemu zilizo majimaji ya mwili kwa mfano, macho, pua kwa mikono isiyo safi kuepukana na sehemu zenye watu wengi na kuvaa barakoa kila wakati.
English: Some of these methods include staying one meter away from people with corona symptoms, avoiding holding fluid body parts such as eyes, nose with unclean hands, avoiding crowded areas and wearing a bra.

Swahili: Mwisho, kila kibaya kina uzuri wake.
English: In the end, every bad thing has its beauty.

Swahili: Waama, baniani mbaya kiatu chake dawa.
English: Mom, the bad boy is wearing his medication shoe.

Swahili: Licha ya changamoto tunazokumbana na shetani huyu aitwae korona, tunapata faida.
English: Despite the challenges we face with this demon - the crown - we are benefitting.

Swahili: Je faida hiyo tunaipata kivipi?
English: How do we benefit from this?

Swahili: Watu ambao walikuwa hawana biashara sasa wamepata biashara ya kuuza barakoa na kutokana na biashara hiyo, wanaweza kukidhi mahitaji yao na familia zao.
English: People who had no business now have a business of selling cattle and, as a result, can provide for themselves and their families.

Swahili: Mwisho kabisa ningependa kutoa onyo ya kwamba lazima tufwate masharti yaliyowekwa na shirika la afya duniani na wizara ya afya.
English: Finally, I would like to warn that we must follow the guidelines set by the World Health Organization and the health ministry.

Swahili: MATUMIZI YA PESA VYUO VIKUU SASA YAANZE KUMULIKWA
English: How to Use Your Money Now

Swahili: MUDA umefika kwa serikali sasa kuanza kumulika jinsi vyuo vikuu vya umma vinatumia pesa ambazo vinapewa ili kufanikisha masomo ya juu, kufuatia habari za majuzi kuhusu madai ya wizi wa mamilioni ya pesa katika Chuo Kikuu cha Maasai Mara.
English: IT IS time for the government to begin to shed light on how public universities spend their tuition fees on higher education, following the recent news of claims of millions of dollars stolen from the University of Maasai Mara.

Swahili: Ripoti hiyo ilipeperushwa na runinga ya Citizen Jumapili ilisema naibu Chansela wa Chuo hicho amekuwa akiongoza ufujaji wa mamilioni ya pesa kujinufaisha kibinafsi, wakati chuo chenyewe bado kinakumbwa na changamoto.
English: The report, broadcast on Citizen television Sunday, said the vice chancellor of the college has been leading the fundraising of millions of dollars for personal gain, while the college itself is still facing challenges.

Swahili: Ni ukweli ulio waazi kuwa vyuo vikuu vya umma nchini vimekuwa vikikumbwa na matatizo mengi, hasa ya ukosefu wa pesa na rasilimali za kuwezesha masomo na utafiti kuendeshwa ifaavyo.
English: It is a clear fact that public universities in the country have been plagued by many problems, especially the lack of funds and resources to facilitate proper education and research.

Swahili: Matatizo haya, mara kwa mara yamesababisha viwango vya elimu kudorora, vyuo kuwasomesha wanafunzi madarasani tu, wakati mwishowe watafuzu bila kupata ujuzi wa moja kwa moja wa kazi wanazosomea.
English: These problems have occasionally led to lower education standards, making colleges teach students only in classrooms, where they will eventually graduate without direct knowledge of the work they are studying.

Swahili: Katika vingi vya vyuo vikuu vya umma nchini, wanafunzi kusoma hadi kumaliza bila kuwahi kushiriki tafiti za kisayansi, kiteknolojia ama zingine zinazowiana na kozi wanazosomea ni jambo la kawaida, hali ambayo imesemekana kuwa ni kutokana na uchache wa rasilimali.
English: In many of the public universities in the country, students studying to graduate without ever engaging in scientific, technological or other studies related to the courses they are studying is common, a condition that has been said to be due to a lack of resources.

Swahili: Hii ni hali ambayo imehatarisha ubora wa elimu ya vyuo vikuu nchini.
English: This is a situation that has jeopardized the quality of higher education in the country.

Swahili: Matatizo hayo ni kando na changamoto nyingine zinazovikumba kama migomo ya mara kwa mara ya wafanyikazi wakilalamikia mazingira mabovu kazini, na ya wanafunzi wanaponyimwa huduma muhimu ambazo zinafaa kutolewa.
English: These problems are besides other challenges such as the frequent strike of workers complaining of bad work conditions, and of students being denied essential services that deserve to be provided.

Swahili: Mara nyingi, kiini cha migomo hii huwa kukosekana kwa pesa za kufanya jambo fulani, ndipo waathirika wanaamua kutatiza huduma kwa mbinu ya kupigania haki zao.
English: Often, the heart of these strikes is the lack of funds to do something, and the victims decide to interfere with the ministry in a way that fights for their rights.

Swahili: Serikali haina budi ila kuanzisha uchunguzi wa kina katika usimamizi wa vyuo nchini na kuunyoosha, ili wanafunzi na wafanyakazi wasiwe wakiteseka kila mara, wakati rasilimali zinaporwa na wasimamizi.
English: The government has to initiate a thorough investigation into the administration of the country's colleges and straighten them out, so that students and staff do not suffer constantly, when resources are being plundered by the administrators.

Swahili: Inachukiza sana wakati maafisa ambao wamepewa jukumu la kulinda pesa za umma wanakuwa wa kwanza kuziiba, licha ya kuwa wanalipwa mishahara minono na kuwa kazi zao zinawahitaji kuwa waadilifu kwa kiwango kikubwa.
English: It is disgusting when officials who are entrusted with protecting public funds are the first to steal them, despite their high wages and the high degree of integrity they require in their jobs.

Swahili: Serikali isimsaze yeyote anayepatikana na hatia ya kuporapesa, kwani matunda ya wizi huo yamekuwa kudorora kwa viwango vya elimu, na zaidi ya yote kuathiri uchumi wa taifa.
English: The government should not condemn anyone found guilty of corruption, as the fruits of the theft have been a drop in education, and above all a detrimental economic impact on the nation.

Swahili: AMSUTA DADAKE KUHUSU 'FISI' WADONDOKWA MATE RUAI, NJIRU
English: AMSUTA SORRER REPORTING 'FIS' Abducted by the RAI, NJIRU

Swahili: VIPUSA wanaoishi nyumba moja mtaani hapa walitofautiana vikali mmoja alipoanza kukaribisha barobaro kila jioni akidai walikuwa rafiki zake wa dhati.
English: THE people who lived in the same house on the street here were very different when one started to welcome a barber every evening claiming to be his true friends.

Swahili: Kidosho wa kwanza aliyekuwa na ajira alialika mwenzake kuja kusomea katika chuo kimoja mjini.
English: The first employee invited a colleague to study at a university in the city.

Swahili: Yasemekana baada ya wiki mbili chuoni, alipata marafiki walioanza kuandamana naye hadi chumbani.
English: It is said that after two weeks at the college, he found friends who began to accompany him to his room.

Swahili: Inasemekana bajeti ya kidosho aliyekuwa akifanya kazi ilienda juu ghafla mwenzake akiwapikia mabarobaro hao.
English: It is said that the budget of the worker's errand went up suddenly when his partner was cooking the dishes.

Swahili: Hapo ndipo kidosho aliamua kumkabili mwenzake akimtaka kuachana na marafiki hao.
English: That was when the mistake was made to confront the other person and to break up with the friends.

Swahili: "Samahani dada, hapa ni mjini na kila mtu anafaa kupambana na hali yake ya maisha.
English: "Sorry sister, this is a city and everyone deserves to fight their way of life.

Swahili: Siwezi kukupa makao kisha nilishe hao wanaume wako," dada alifoka.
English: I cannot give you a place to live and then feed your men", the sister sobbed.

Swahili: Inasemekana demu hakuwa na budi ila kuwatema majamaa hao ili kupata amani.
English: It is said that the demu had to only cut the relatives to get peace.

Swahili: MABWENI 3 KATIKA SHULE MBILI YACHOMEKA NA KUZUA HOFU KUU
English: PART 3 IN TWO SCHOOLS FIRMED and GROWING in Fear

Swahili: SHULE mbili zilichomeka mnamo Alhamisi katika Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi na kuzua taharuki ya kurejea kwa wimbi la visa vya moto shuleni, wanafunzi wanapoanza muhula wa tatu.
English: TWO schools burned down on Thursday in Tharaka Nithi County and raised alarm about the return of the wave of school fires, as students begin their third term.

Swahili: Moto kwa kwanza ulichoma sehemu ya bweni la Shule ya Msingi ya Wasichana ya Chogoria katika Kauntindogo ya Maara huku mabweni mawili yakichomeka katika Shule ya Upili ya Mseto ya Iriaini, Kaunti ndogo ya Tharaka Kaskazini.
English: The fire first burned part of the hostel of Chogoria Girls' Primary School in Maara County while two hostels were burned in Iriaini Hybrid High School, North Tharaka County.

Swahili: Hilo liliwafanya zaidi ya wavulana 200 kulala nje usiku kucha.
English: This left over 200 boys sleeping out all night.

Swahili: Hakuna aliyejeruhiwa kwenye visa hivyo viwili, lakini mali yenye thamani ya mamilioni ya pesa iliharibiwa.
English: No one was injured in the two incidents, but millions of dollars worth of property was damaged.

Swahili: "Hakuna yeyote aliyejeruhiwa kwenye moto huo ambao ulianza wakati wanafunzi walipokuwa madarasani kwa masomo yao ya jioni.
English: "No one was injured in the fire that started when the students were in class for their evening classes.

Swahili: Hakuna chochote kilichookolewa," akasema Naibu Kamishna wa Kaunti wa Tharaka Kaskazini Bw Maina Chege.
English: Nothing was saved", said Deputy County Commissioner for Northern Emergency Mr. Maina Chege.

Swahili: Alisema polisi tayari wameanza uchunguzi kubaini chanzo cha moto huo.
English: He said the police have already started an investigation to determine the cause of the fire.

Swahili: Bw John Mutegi, mzazi, aliwaambia wanahabari kwamba bweni moja kati ya mawili yaliyochomeka lilikarabatiwa majuzi baada ya kuchomwa na moto mwingine 2018.
English: Mr. John Mutegi, the parent, told reporters that one of the two burned apartments was recently repaired after another fire in 2018.

Swahili: WANANDOA WENGI BADO HAWAJASAJILIWA KADHI  ZAIDI ya asilimia 60 ya ndoa za Kiislamu zinazo fungwa Lamu hazija sajiliwa.
English: THE MOST MARRIAGES ARE UNREGISTED OVER 60 percent of marriages performed by Muslims are not registered.

Swahili: Kulingana na afisi ya mahakama ya  kadhi, Kaunti ya Lamu, ni asilimia 40 pekee ya ndoa ambazo zimesajiliwa rasmi katika afisi hiyo.
English: According to the district court's office, Lamu County, only 40 percent of marriages are officially registered in the office.

Swahili: Katika kikao na wanahabari afisini mwake jana, Kadhi Mkuu Mkazi, Swaleh Mohamed, alisema hulka ya wakazi kukosa kusajili ndoa zao inafanya wanandoa wengi kutalakiana.
English: In a press conference in his office yesterday, the Chief Justice, Swaleh Mohamed, said the fact that the population does not register their marriages makes many couples divorce.

Swahili: Bw Mohamed aliwataka wakazi kutilia maanani usajili wa ndoa eneo hilo kwa manufaa yao.
English: Mr. Mohamed urged residents to consider marriage registration in the area for their own benefit.

Swahili: Aliwasisitizia wanawake kuwa mstari wa mbele katika kuwahimiza mabwana zao kufika katika afisi ya kadhi ili kusajili ndoa zao.
English: He urged women to take the lead in urging their masters to come to the caste office to register their marriages.

Swahili: Alisema ni jambo la kusikitisha kuona akina mama na watoto wanateseka wanandoa wanapotalikiana.
English: He said that it is sad to see mothers and children suffer when a couple divorce.

Swahili: Alisema kukosa kusajili ndoa eneo hilo ni jambo ambalo limechochea wanaume kuruka ndoa zao.
English: He said that the lack of registration of marriage in the area is what has prompted men to abandon their marriages.

Swahili: Zaidi ya asilimia 60 ya ndoa za Kiislamu kwenye mji wa Lamu hazijasajiliwa.
English: More than 60 percent of Muslim marriages in the city of Lamu are not registered.

Swahili: Hii ni hatari.
English: This is dangerous.

Swahili: Nimeona wanandoa wanaofika hapa afisini kutaka kutalakiana lakini unapata mwishowe mwanamume anaruka ndoa yake kiurahisi akidai yeye hajaoa.
English: I've seen couples who come here to file for divorce but you end up with a man who jumps over his marriage easily claiming he's single.

Swahili: Utampeleka wapi na cheti cha kuthibitisha ndoa hakuna?
English: Where will you take her with no marriage certificate?

Swahili: Utapata wanawake na watoto wanateseka bure wakati wa migogoro kama hii.
English: You will find women and children suffering in vain during such conflicts.

Swahili: Ni vyema wakazi, hasa wanawake kuwahimiza waume wao waje afisini kusajili ndoa ili wapate haki yao iwapo kutakuwa na kutalakiana au kufariki kwa mmoja wa wanandoa hao,Akasema Bw MohamedNaye Ustadh Mohamed Abdulkadir alisema, tayari wamejadiliana na ofisi ya kadhi na kuondoa faini zote zinazohitajika kwa wanandoa kusajili ndoa zao.
English: It is good for the residents, especially women, to urge their husbands to come to the register of marriages so that they can have their rights if there is a divorce or death of one of the couples, said Mr. MohamedNaye Ustadh Mohamed Abdulkadir, they have already discussed with the card office and removed all fines required for couples to register their marriages.

Swahili: Katika harakati za kuwahimiza wanandoa Lamu kusajili ndoa zao, tumejadiiliana na ofisi ya kadhi na kuafikiana kwamba hakuna faini au ada zozoteambazo watu wetu watahitajika kulipa ili wasajiliwe.
English: In an effort to encourage Lamu couples to register their marriages, we have negotiated with the clerk's office and agreed that no fines or fees will be paid by our people to register.

Swahili: Hatua hiyo tumeichukua ili kuwahimiza watu kusajili ndoa zao kwa sasa, akasema Bw Abdulkadir.
English: We have taken this step to encourage people to register their marriages now, said Mr. Abdulkadir.

Swahili: Kwa upande wake, Mwenyekiti wa baraza la Maimamu na Wahubiri wa Kiislamu(CIPK) tawi la Lamu, Bw Abubakar Shekuwe, aliwahimiza wanandoa kuheshimiana na kuepuka matumizi ya mihadarati aliyodai inachangia pakubwa kuvunjika kwa ndoa Lamu.
English: For his part, the Chairman of the Council of Imams and Preachers of the Islamic Church (CIPK) of Lamu's branch, Mr. Abubakar Shekuwe, urged the couple to respect each other and avoid the use of drugs which he claimed contributed greatly to the breakdown of Lamu's marriage.

Swahili: DPP aagiza polisi waachilie huru mwanaume aliyemchinja mbwa
English: DPP orders the police to release the man who killed the dog

Swahili: MKURUGENZI wa Mashtaka ya Umma (DPP) Noordin Haji aliguswa na habari za mwanamume kutoka Tharaka Nithi aliyechinja mbwa ale na akaamuru polisi kumwachilia huru.
English: PROSCUSER Noordin Haji was touched by the news of a man from Tharaka Nithi who killed a dog and ordered the police to release him.

Swahili: Mwanamume huyo alikamatwa kwa kumchinja mbwa kupika nyama yake baada ya kuzidiwa na njaa.
English: The man was arrested for killing a dog to cook his meat after he was overwhelmed with hunger.

Swahili: Katika ujumbe aliotuma kupitia akaunti yake ya twitter, Haji pia aliagiza Mkurugenzi George Kinoti kuhakikisha jamaa huyo anapata chakula cha kutosha.
English: In a message posted via her Twitter account, Haji also instructed Director George Kinoti to ensure the relative gets enough food.

Swahili: Bw John Munene alikamatwa nyumbani kwake katika kijiji cha Karimba, Kaunti ndogo ya Maara na mafisa wa polisi kwa kumchinja mbwa na kupika nyama yake ili apate chakula.
English: Mr. John Munene was arrested at his home in the small village of Karimba, Maara County by police officers for killing a dog and cooking its meat for food.

Swahili: Bw Munene alisema alichukua hatua hiyo kwa kukaa siku tatu bila chakula.
English: Mr Munene said he took this step by staying three days without food.

Swahili: Alieleza kuwa aliona aibu kuomba chakula kila mara kutoka kwa majirani zake.
English: He explained that he felt ashamed to ask his neighbors for food.

Swahili: Mwanamume huyo mwenye umri wa makamu alizuiliwa katika Kituo cha Polisi cha Chogoria kabla ya kuwasilishwa mahakamani mjini Chuka Ijumaa.
English: The deputy was detained at Chogoria Police Station before being brought to trial in Chuka on Friday.

Swahili: Maji ya mvua yahifadhiwe Ni kinaya kwamba kwa sasa mvua inaendelea kushuhudiwa maeneo mengi nchini ikisababisha mafuriko na mauti, ilhali miezi michache ijayo tutashuhudia ukame na njaa.
English: Rainwater is being stored. It is sad that rainfall is still being witnessed in many parts of the country causing flooding and death, while in the next few months we will witness drought and famine.

Swahili: Ni vyema kwa serikali kuweka mipango ya kuhakikisha maji ya sasa yanahifadhiwa vyema, na kutumiwa kunyunyiza mashamba wakati wa ukame badala ya kuyaacha yapotee vivi hivi tu.
English: It is better for governments to put in place measures to ensure that current water is properly stored, and used to spray fields during drought rather than just letting them go to waste.

Swahili: Kwa mfano, katika eneobunge la Nyando ambako mafuriko yamesababisha uharibifu na maafa, bwawa kubwa lingejengwa kuhifadhi maji hayo kisha yatumiwe kwa kilimo cha mpunga msimu wa upanzi utakapowadia.
English: For example, in the region of Nyando where floods have caused devastation and disaster, a large pond would be built to store the water and then be used for rice growing when the growing season comes.

Swahili: Kando na kuhifadhi maji, serikali kwa ushirikiano na wanasiasa kutoka maeneo yaliyoathirika, inafaa kuhakikisha inafikishia waathiriwa chakula cha msaada, maji safi na neti za kuwakinga dhidi ya mbu.
English: Apart from water conservation, the government, in cooperation with politicians from affected areas, should ensure that it provides the victims with food supplies, clean water and nets to protect them from mosquitoes.

Swahili: Dawa za kuacha mihadarati zawasili Watumizi wa dawa za kulevya jijini Mombasa, wana matumaini baada ya Kaunti hiyo kupokea furushi la Methadone ljumaa.
English: Drug users in Mombasa, have high hopes after the county received a Methadone package on Friday.

Swahili: Dawa hizo ambazo hupunguza hamu ya kutumia mihadarati zilikuwa zimepungua hivyo kuzua hali ya wasiwasi miongoni mwa walio katika safari ya kujinasua kutokana na janga hilo.
English: The decreased appetite on the drugs had caused anxiety among those on a suicide trip.

Swahili: Akizungumza na Taifa Leo hapo jana, afisa mkuu wa afya katika kaunti, Dkt Khadija Shikely alisema furushi hilo lililetwa na shirika la kudhibiti ukimwi na magonjwa ya zinaa nchini.
English: Speaking to Nation Today yesterday, the county's chief health official, Dr. Khadija Shikely, said the package was brought in by the country's AIDS and STD control agency.

Swahili: Mkurugenzi wa mawasiliano katika kaunti ya Mombasa Richard Chacha alisema vituo vya kurekebisha tabia kwa watumizi wa dawa za kulevya sasa viko tayari.
English: Mombasa County Communications Director Richard Chacha said the drug rehabilitation centers are now open.

Swahili: "Tuko na Methadone za kutosha.
English: "We have enough Methadone.

English: The Miritini Central Centre is also ready and Governor Hassan Joho will launch it anytime from now on", said Mr Chacha.

English: The production of plentiful strawberries will help the recovery of Mumias' strawberries farmers from the Mumias area have asked the new CEO of Mumias Sugar Company (MSC), appointed by the project manager appointed by KCB Bank Ponangapalli Venkata Ramana Rao, to launch a plan to strengthen their cultivation of the strawberries.

Swahili: Wamemshauri Bw Francis Wabuke ambaye alianza kuhudumu katika wadhifa huo mnamo Novemba 28 kuanzisha mchakato huo kabla kufufuliwa kwa kiwanda hicho ili kiweze kupata malighafi ya kutosha kuendesha shughuli zake bila tatizo lolote.
English: Advisors to Mr Francis Wabuke who took office on 28 November set up the process before the factory was restored so that it could get enough raw materials to run its operations without any problems.

English: The farmers commended his appointment but expressed fear that he might not be able to revive the factory if he did not invest in the "Biggest problem facing the Sugar Mumia company is not poor management, lack of machinery or workers but raw materials.

Swahili: Shughuli za kiwanda haziwezi kufufuliwa ikiwa hakuna miwa ya  kutosha kusagwa, akasema Bw Josephat Waburaka, ambaye ni mkulima kutoka uteuzi eneo la Matawa, Mumias Magharibi.
English: Factory operations cannot be resumed if there are not enough thorns to grind, said Mr Josephat Waburaka, a farmer from the elected area of Matawa, Mumias West.

Swahili: Bw Waburaka alisema kuna ushindani  mkubwa kutoka kwa kampuni ndogo za  kibinafsi kwa sababu huwa zinawalipa vizuri wakulima ambao huwasilisha miwa  yao tena baada ya muda mfupi.
English: Mr. Waburaka said there is a lot of competition from small private companies because they tend to pay well to farmers who return their berries after a short time.

Swahili: Hofu Bondeni mamilioni ya nzige wakivamia mimea
English: Fear of millions of locusts invading plants.

Swahili: Hali ya wasiwasi imewakumba wakulima katika eneo la Kaskazini mwa Bonde la Ufa, baada ya mamilioni ya nzige kulivamia eneo hilo, huku wakijitayarisha kwa msimu wa upanzi.
English: Concern has gripped farmers in the Northern Ufa Valley, after millions of locust have invaded the area, preparing for the growing season.

Swahili: Baadhi ya wakulima katika eneo la Moiben, Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu, wameiomba serikali kuchukua hatua za haraka kuwasaidia kuwakabili wadudu hao.
English: Some farmers in the area of Moiben, Uasin Gishu County, have appealed to the government to take immediate action to help them deal with the pests.

Swahili: "Wadudu hao walifika katika eneo hili Jumanne  jioni kutoka Cherangany, ambapo tuna hofu kwamba wataharibu mazao yetu, ikiwa watataga mayai na kuongeza idadi yao, akasema Bw Eias Kiptoo, anayekuza mboga na nyanya katika eneo la Meibeki, Moiben.

Swahili: Aina hii ya mahojiano hulishughulikia suala katika vina vyake.
English: This type of interview addresses the issue in its own way.

Swahili: Dhima ya mahojiano Kuna aina nyingi za mahojiano kila mmoja huwa na dhima moja mahususi au shima kadhaa.
English: Interview liability There are many types of interviews each have one specific liability or several liabilities.

Swahili: a.       Kueleza na kupasha habariYapo mahojiano ambayo lengo lake ni kuwapasha watu habari na kueleza jambo. Kutetea msimamo fulaniYapo mahojiano ambapo watu wa pande mbili zilizo na mitazamotofauti kuhusu suala fulani huweza kuhojiwa na hapa kila mmoja hupata fursa kutetea mtazamo anaoupendelea.
English: a. Explaining and communicating information. An interview that aims to inform and explain a subject. Defending a position. An interview where people from two sides with different views on a subject can be interviewed and each has the opportunity to defend his or her preferred view.

Swahili: c.       Kudadisi jambo au mtu .Mahojiano yanaweza kulenga kulidadisi jambo au mtu kwa kina. Kwa mfano, maisha ya mtu au matendo yake n.k. huweza kufanyiwa uduhushi.  Aidha,jambo huweza kudadisiwa kwa mapana kama vile kwa nini vitendo vya kigaidi hutekelezwa.
English: c. Curiosity about a subject or person.Interviews can aim to investigate a subject or person in depth. For example, a person's life or actions etc. can be deceived. Furthermore, a subject can be questioned extensively such as why terrorist acts are carried out.

Swahili: d.      Kuburudisha.Baadhi ya mahojiano huwa yanalenga tu kuburudisha. Kwa mfano msanii fulani anaweza kualikwa kwa mahojiano kwa nia ya kuiburudisha hadhira.
English: d. Refrigeration. Some interviews are aimed at simply refreshing. For example, an artist may be invited to an interview with the intention of refreshing the audience.

Swahili: Dhima hizi mbalimbali huweza kujitokeza katika mahojiano ingawa mahojiano mengi hujumuisha dhima kadha katika utekelezaji wake.
English: These various obligations may arise in interviews although many interviews involve some obligations in its implementation.

Swahili: Mahojiano ya Vyombo vya Habarikuna mambo yanayoweza kumsaidia anayehoji na anayehojiwa kufanikisha mahojiano.
English: Interviews with the Media have some information that can help the interviewer and the interviewee to have a successful interview.

Swahili: Tutayajadili mambo hayo.
English: We will discuss these matters.

Swahili: Mhoji anavyoweza kufanikisha mahojianojambo mojawapo muhimu kwa mwanahabari ni kujiandaa kwa kulitafitia jambo analolenga kumhoji mtu kulihusu.
English: One of the most important ways an interviewer can make an interview successful is by preparing for it by considering the subject of the interview.

Swahili: Hili litamwezesha kupata maarifa zaidi kuhusu mada anayoilenga na hivyo pia kumsaidia kuandaa maswali yanayofaa ambayo atamuuliza mhojiwa na pia kutoa mwelekeo wa mazungumzo wakati wa mahojiano.
English: This will enable him to gain more knowledge of the subject and thus help him to prepare the appropriate questions to ask the interviewee and to give direction to the conversation during the interview.

Swahili: Aidha, uteuzi mzuri wa maneno wakati wa mahojiano ni muhimu.
English: Moreover, good choice of words during an interview is important.

Swahili: Lugha sahili na isiyo na kauli zenye  utata inafaa.
English: Simple and uncontroversial language is appropriate.

Swahili: Unahitaji kuandaa maswali utakayouliza lakini usiyategemee katika mahojiano.
English: You need to prepare questions to ask but not rely on them in an interview.

Swahili: Si lazima kuyafuata.
English: You do not have to follow them.

Swahili: Unahitaji pia kuuliza maswali yanayochipuza akilini mwako wakati wa mahojiano.
English: You also need to ask questions that pop into your mind during the interview.

Swahili: Sikiliza majibu unayopewa kwa makini na kuziratili hoja ili kubaini hoja mpya zinazoibuka.
English: Listen carefully to the answers and keep the arguments to yourself to identify new arguments.

Swahili: Mahojiano ya vyombo vya habari huhitaji maswali yanayoulizwa kuwa yenye kudadisi na labda kumdara anayehojiwa pamoja na yaliyo sahili na ambayo atafurahikia.
English: Interviews with the media require curious and perhaps casual questions along with simple and enjoyable ones.

Swahili: Mahojiano yako yatakuwa yana usawazisho kwa kufanya hivi.
English: Your interviews will be balanced by doing this.

Swahili: Unapoanza mahojiano gonga ndipo moja kwa moja.
English: When you start an interview, you're right on the line.

Swahili: Mhojiwa anahitaji kupewa fursa ya kuzungumza bila kukawia.
English: The interviewee needs to be given the opportunity to speak out immediately.

Swahili: Jibu sahili na fupi linahitaji k wala mwanzo kabisa.
English: A simple and concise answer requires k and no beginning at all.

English: For example, where are you from?

English: Then continue with the question you prefer that is unimportant or that you find most weighty.

Swahili: Huenda pasiwepo muda wa kuyajibu maswali hata muhimu baadaye.
English: There may not be enough time to answer even important questions later.

Swahili: Jaribu kuwa mtulivu na mvumilivu wakati wote wa mahojiano.
English: Try to be calm and patient throughout the interview.

Swahili: Huenda unayemhoji atakwepa swali uliloliuliza mara kadha lakini utahitajika kudumisha utulivu wako na kuliuliza tena.
English: The interviewer may ask the question you asked several times, but you will need to remain calm and ask it again.

Swahili: Daima kuwa mkarimu kabla na wakati wa mahojiano.
English: Always be hospitable before and during interviews.

Swahili: Unaweza kudumisha tabasamu na pia kuhakikisha kuwa unaonekana kuwa unaifahamu na kuimudu mada inayojadiliwa.
English: You can keep smiling and make sure that you seem familiar with the topic and can afford it.

Swahili: Onyesha kuwa unavutiwa na jambo unalolidadisi.
English: Show that you are interested in what you are interested in.

Swahili: Ni muhimu kuonyesha kuwa kwa kweli unazihitaji habari unazozitafuta.
English: It is important to show that you really need the information you are looking for.

Swahili: Hakikisha kuwa sauti yako inasikika vizuri kwamba inapendeza.
English: Make sure that your voice is sound good enough to be pleasant.

Swahili: Pamoja na hili, ikiwa ni televisheni, mavazi nadhifu yafaa.
English: In addition, if it is television, smart clothing is appropriate.

English: Radio InterviewsIn addition to the above, remember that radio interviews rely heavily on sound.

Swahili: Lugha yako yafaa kuwa yenye mvuto na yenye kushawishi.
